blocks.title: Tuần 1 · Mở khóa: bài đầu vào, ôn quét từ của khóa trước

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 1. Mở khóa · Bài đầu vào phần 1 – ôn quét Seedling U1–6

web.label: Ngày 1. Mở khóa · Ôn quét Seedling U1–3: chào hỏi, tên tuổi, gia đình

en.tu: Ôn: hello, goodbye, teacher, friend, morning, name, how old, nice, mother, aunt, uncle, baby, photo
en.cum: Ôn: good morning / see you tomorrow / my name is / six years old / my family / take a photo
en.cau: Ôn: Hello, teacher! Good morning! / What's your name? My name is Anna. / How old are you? I'm six years old. / Who is she? She is my mother. / I love my family.
en.truyen: Hello, Bông! — Leo: Hello, Anna! Good morning! Anna: Good morning, Leo! This is my friend Bông. Bông: Hello! My name is Bông. I'm six years old. Leo: Nice to meet you, Bông! Look, this is a photo of my family.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "hello song for kids what's your name"

zh.tu: Ôn: 你好 nǐ hǎo, 您好 nín hǎo, 老师 lǎoshī, 再见 zàijiàn, 朋友 péngyou, 名字 míngzi, 岁 suì, 认识 rènshi, 高兴 gāoxìng, 妈妈 māma, 爸爸 bàba, 照片 zhàopiàn
zh.cum: Ôn: 老师好 lǎoshī hǎo / 明天见 míngtiān jiàn / 我叫 wǒ jiào / 几岁 jǐ suì / 我的家人 wǒ de jiārén
zh.cau: Ôn: 老师好！(Lǎoshī hǎo!) / 你叫什么名字？(Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?) 我叫Anna。(Wǒ jiào Anna.) / 你几岁？(Nǐ jǐ suì?) 我六岁。(Wǒ liù suì.) / 她是谁？她是我妈妈。(Tā shì shéi? Tā shì wǒ māma.) / 我爱我的家人。(Wǒ ài wǒ de jiārén.)
zh.truyen: 你好，Bông！— Leo：Anna，你好！Anna：Leo，你好！这是我的朋友Bông。Bông：你好！我叫Bông，我六岁。Leo：认识你很高兴！你看，这是我家人的照片。(Leo: Anna, nǐ hǎo! Anna: Leo, nǐ hǎo! Zhè shì wǒ de péngyou Bông. Bông: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Bông, wǒ liù suì. Leo: Rènshi nǐ hěn gāoxìng! Nǐ kàn, zhè shì wǒ jiārén de zhàopiàn.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "你好歌 儿歌 你叫什么名字"

web.label: Ngày 2. Mở khóa · Ôn quét Seedling U4–6: cơ thể, cảm xúc, đồ dùng học tập

en.tu: Ôn: arm, leg, hair, finger, happy, sad, hungry, tired, pencil, crayon, book, board, ruler
en.cum: Ôn: clap your hands / touch your ears / open your book / close your book / how do you feel
en.cau: Ôn: Clap your hands! Touch your ears! / How do you feel? I'm happy. / Are you hungry? Yes, I am. / What is this? This is a pencil. / Open your book, please.
en.truyen: Bông's Pencil — Teacher: Good morning, class! Open your books, please. Bông: Oh no! Where is my pencil? I'm sad. Anna: Look! It's under your book. Bông: Thank you, Anna! Now I'm happy. Teacher: Clap your hands, class!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "head shoulders knees and toes kids song"

zh.tu: Ôn: 头发 tóufa, 口 kǒu, 手 shǒu, 开心 kāixīn, 难过 nánguò, 累 lèi, 书 shū, 书包 shūbāo, 铅笔 qiānbǐ, 写 xiě, 读 dú, 学校 xuéxiào
zh.cum: Ôn: 拍拍手 pāipai shǒu / 摸摸耳朵 mōmo ěrduo / 我很开心 wǒ hěn kāixīn / 这是什么 zhè shì shénme / 排队 páiduì
zh.cau: Ôn: 拍拍手！(Pāipai shǒu!) / 你感觉怎么样？(Nǐ gǎnjué zěnmeyàng?) 我很开心。(Wǒ hěn kāixīn.) / 你累吗？(Nǐ lèi ma?) / 这是什么？这是书包。(Zhè shì shénme? Zhè shì shūbāo.) / 我们排队去学校。(Wǒmen páiduì qù xuéxiào.)
zh.truyen: Bông的铅笔 — 老师：同学们好！Bông：老师好！哎呀，我的铅笔呢？我很难过。Anna：你看，铅笔在书下面。Bông：谢谢你，Anna！我很开心。老师：大家拍拍手！(Lǎoshī: Tóngxuémen hǎo! Bông: Lǎoshī hǎo! Āiyā, wǒ de qiānbǐ ne? Wǒ hěn nánguò. Anna: Nǐ kàn, qiānbǐ zài shū xiàmiàn. Bông: Xièxie nǐ, Anna! Wǒ hěn kāixīn. Lǎoshī: Dàjiā pāipai shǒu!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "身体歌 儿歌 拍拍手"

en.flash: Ôn: hello, goodbye, teacher, friend, name, mother, baby, family, arm, leg, hair, happy, sad, hungry, pencil, crayon, book, board
en.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào phần 1 – Nghe chạm tranh (8 câu): hello / goodbye / mother / baby / arm / leg / pencil / crayon; cô ghi từ con chưa chọn đúng vào Hộp ôn của con. 2) Nghe và tô màu khuôn mặt cảm xúc (4 câu): I'm happy. / I'm sad. / I'm hungry. / I'm tired. 3) Hỏi – đáp nhanh từng con với cô (đầu vào nói): What's your name? / How old are you? / How do you feel?
en.truyen: Hello, Bông! — Leo: Hello, Anna! Good morning! Anna: Good morning, Leo! This is my friend Bông. Bông: Hello! My name is Bông. I'm six years old. Leo: Nice to meet you! How do you feel today? Bông: I'm happy! Let's go to class!
en.baihat: Hello Again (giai điệu: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star – dân gian) — Hello, hello, how are you? / I'm happy, how about you? / Clap your hands and touch your toes, / Touch your ears and touch your nose. / Hello, hello, friends so new, / Canopy class, I'm here with you!

zh.flash: Ôn: 你好 nǐ hǎo, 老师 lǎoshī, 再见 zàijiàn, 朋友 péngyou, 名字 míngzi, 岁 suì, 妈妈 māma, 爸爸 bàba, 头发 tóufa, 口 kǒu, 开心 kāixīn, 难过 nánguò, 累 lèi, 书包 shūbāo, 铅笔 qiānbǐ, 学校 xuéxiào
zh.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào phần 1 – Nghe chạm tranh (8 câu): 妈妈 / 爸爸 / 朋友 / 老师 / 头发 / 口 / 书包 / 铅笔. 2) Nghe chọn khuôn mặt: 我很开心。/ 我很难过。/ 我累了。/ 我很害怕。 3) Hỏi – đáp nhanh từng con (đầu vào nói): 你叫什么名字？/ 你几岁？/ 你感觉怎么样？
zh.truyen: 你好，Bông！— Leo：Anna，你好！Anna：Leo，你好！这是我的朋友Bông。Bông：你好！我叫Bông，我六岁。Leo：认识你很高兴！你感觉怎么样？Bông：我很开心！我们一起去上课吧！(Leo: Anna, nǐ hǎo! Anna: Leo, nǐ hǎo! Zhè shì wǒ de péngyou Bông. Bông: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Bông, wǒ liù suì. Leo: Rènshi nǐ hěn gāoxìng! Nǐ gǎnjué zěnmeyàng? Bông: Wǒ hěn kāixīn! Wǒmen yìqǐ qù shàngkè ba!)
zh.baihat: 你好歌 (giai điệu: 两只老虎 Two Tigers – dân gian) — 你好你好，你好你好，(Nǐ hǎo nǐ hǎo, nǐ hǎo nǐ hǎo,) / 好朋友，好朋友，(hǎo péngyou, hǎo péngyou,) / 拍拍手，拍拍手，(pāipai shǒu, pāipai shǒu,) / 我很开心，我很开心！(wǒ hěn kāixīn, wǒ hěn kāixīn!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 2. Mở khóa · Bài đầu vào phần 2 – ôn quét Seedling U7–12

web.label: Ngày 3. Mở khóa · Ôn quét Seedling U7–9: ngôi nhà, con vật, đồ ăn

en.tu: Ôn: door, window, lamp, bed, table, duck, frog, fish, bird, bread, fruit, juice, noodles
en.cum: Ôn: on the table / under the bed / can swim / can fly / like eating / want to drink
en.cau: Ôn: Where is the cat? The cat is on the bed. / Birds can fly. Fish can't run. / I like eating bread. / I don't like eating bananas. / I want to drink juice.
en.truyen: Where Is the Duck? — Anna: Where is my toy duck? Leo: Is it on the table? Anna: No, it isn't. Leo: Look! It's under the bed. Anna: Thank you! Ducks can swim. Let's have some juice and bread!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "animals can run fly swim song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 门 mén, 桌子 zhuōzi, 床 chuáng, 猫 māo, 狗 gǒu, 鸟 niǎo, 鱼 yú, 面条 miàntiáo, 好吃 hǎochī, 苹果 píngguǒ, 牛奶 niúnǎi
zh.cum: Ôn: 在桌子上 zài zhuōzi shang / 在床下面 zài chuáng xiàmiàn / 能飞 néng fēi / 不能跑 bù néng pǎo / 喜欢吃 xǐhuan chī
zh.cau: Ôn: 猫在哪儿？(Māo zài nǎr?) 猫在床上。(Māo zài chuáng shang.) / 鸟能飞。鱼不能跑。(Niǎo néng fēi. Yú bù néng pǎo.) / 我喜欢吃面条。(Wǒ xǐhuan chī miàntiáo.) / 我想喝牛奶。(Wǒ xiǎng hē niúnǎi.)
zh.truyen: 猫在哪儿？— Xiaomei：我的猫在哪儿？Leo：在桌子上吗？Xiaomei：不在。Leo：你看！猫在床下面。Xiaomei：谢谢！我们吃面条吧，面条真好吃！(Xiaomei: Wǒ de māo zài nǎr? Leo: Zài zhuōzi shang ma? Xiaomei: Bú zài. Leo: Nǐ kàn! Māo zài chuáng xiàmiàn. Xiaomei: Xièxie! Wǒmen chī miàntiáo ba, miàntiáo zhēn hǎochī!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "动物儿歌 小鸟飞 小鱼游"

web.label: Ngày 4. Mở khóa · Ôn quét Seedling U10–12: thời tiết, màu sắc, số – giờ – ngày

en.tu: Ôn: sunny, rainy, coat, umbrella, red, blue, brown, count, how many, today, eight o'clock, hooray
en.cum: Ôn: it's sunny / a red apple / how many / let's count / what colour
en.cau: Ôn: How's the weather today? It's sunny. / What colour is it? It's red. / How many apples are there? There are two apples. / What time is it? It's eight o'clock. / Let's count! One, two, three, hooray!
en.truyen: Let's Count! — Leo: It's sunny today! Let's count the apples. Anna: One, two, three red apples! How many brown cakes? Leo: Two cakes! What time is it? Anna: It's eight o'clock. Leo and Anna: Hooray! Let's go to school!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how's the weather song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 天气 tiānqì, 下雨 xià yǔ, 穿 chuān, 颜色 yánsè, 红 hóng, 蓝 lán, 黄 huáng, 两 liǎng, 点 diǎn, 号 hào, 现在 xiànzài, 星期 xīngqī, 月 yuè
zh.cum: Ôn: 今天天气怎么样 jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng / 红色的苹果 hóngsè de píngguǒ / 两个苹果 liǎng gè píngguǒ / 现在几点 xiànzài jǐ diǎn / 几月几号 jǐ yuè jǐ hào
zh.cau: Ôn: 今天天气怎么样？今天下雨。(Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng? Jīntiān xià yǔ.) / 苹果是红色的。(Píngguǒ shì hóngsè de.) / 有两个苹果。(Yǒu liǎng gè píngguǒ.) / 现在几点？现在八点。(Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Xiànzài bā diǎn.) / 今天几月几号？今天六月一号。(Jīntiān jǐ yuè jǐ hào? Jīntiān liùyuè yī hào.)
zh.truyen: 数一数 — Xiaomei：今天下雨，我穿红色的衣服。Leo：有几个苹果？Xiaomei：有两个苹果，一个红色的，一个黄色的。Leo：现在几点？Xiaomei：现在八点。我们去学校吧！(Xiaomei: Jīntiān xià yǔ, wǒ chuān hóngsè de yīfu. Leo: Yǒu jǐ gè píngguǒ? Xiaomei: Yǒu liǎng gè píngguǒ, yí gè hóngsè de, yí gè huángsè de. Leo: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Xiaomei: Xiànzài bā diǎn. Wǒmen qù xuéxiào ba!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "颜色歌 儿歌 红色 黄色 蓝色"

en.flash: Ôn: door, window, bed, table, duck, frog, fish, bird, bread, juice, noodles, sunny, coat, umbrella, red, blue, brown, eight o'clock
en.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào phần 2 – Nghe chọn tranh đúng vị trí (4 câu): The cat is on the bed. / The ball is under the table. / The duck is on the chair. / The book is under the bed. 2) Đúng hay sai? (6 câu): Birds can fly. / Fish can run. / It's sunny. / The apple is blue. / There are two cakes. / It's eight o'clock. 3) Nói theo tranh (đầu vào nói): mỗi con chọn 1 tranh, nói 2 câu về màu, số hoặc thời tiết; từ con quên vào Hộp ôn.
en.truyen: Where Is the Duck? — Anna: Where is my toy duck? Leo: Is it on the table? Anna: No, it isn't. Leo: Look! It's under the bed. Anna: Thank you! It's a yellow duck. Leo: It's sunny today. Let's go out! Anna: Take your umbrella, Leo. Hooray!
en.baihat: Colours and Numbers (giai điệu: London Bridge Is Falling Down – dân gian) — Red and yellow, green and blue, / green and blue, green and blue, / One, two, three, I count with you, / Hooray, hooray! / Sunny, rainy, what's today? / What's today? What's today? / Eight o'clock, let's go and play, / Hooray, hooray!

zh.flash: Ôn: 门 mén, 桌子 zhuōzi, 床 chuáng, 猫 māo, 狗 gǒu, 鸟 niǎo, 鱼 yú, 面条 miàntiáo, 好吃 hǎochī, 天气 tiānqì, 下雨 xià yǔ, 红 hóng, 蓝 lán, 黄 huáng, 两 liǎng, 点 diǎn, 号 hào, 星期 xīngqī
zh.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào phần 2 – Nghe chọn tranh (4 câu): 猫在床上。/ 球在桌子下面。/ 鱼能游泳。/ 鸟能飞。 2) Nghe chọn đáp án (4 câu): 有几个苹果？– 两个 / 三个; 现在几点？– 八点 / 九点; 今天星期几？– 星期一 / 星期二; 苹果是什么颜色的？– 红色 / 蓝色. 3) Nói theo tranh: con tự nói 1 câu tiếng Trung về con vật hoặc đồ ăn; từ quên vào Hộp ôn.
zh.truyen: 猫在哪儿？— Xiaomei：我的猫在哪儿？Leo：在桌子上吗？Xiaomei：不在。Leo：你看！猫在床下面。Xiaomei：谢谢你！今天下雨，猫不出去。我们吃面条吧！Leo：好！面条真好吃！(Xiaomei: Wǒ de māo zài nǎr? Leo: Zài zhuōzi shang ma? Xiaomei: Bú zài. Leo: Nǐ kàn! Māo zài chuáng xiàmiàn. Xiaomei: Xièxie nǐ! Jīntiān xià yǔ, māo bù chūqu. Wǒmen chī miàntiáo ba! Leo: Hǎo! Miàntiáo zhēn hǎochī!)
zh.baihat: 颜色数字歌 (giai điệu: 两只老虎 Two Tigers – dân gian) — 红色黄色，红色黄色，(Hóngsè huángsè, hóngsè huángsè,) / 一二三，一二三，(yī èr sān, yī èr sān,) / 现在几点？八点！(xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Bā diǎn!) / 现在几点？八点！(xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Bā diǎn!) / 去学校，去学校！(qù xuéxiào, qù xuéxiào!)

blocks.title: Unit 1 · Time & Date 1 · 星期和时间

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 3. Unit 1 · Time & Date 1 – Thứ trong tuần; quy luật 星期 + số; tô 日

web.label: Ngày 5. Unit 1 · Time & Date 1 · Thứ trong tuần (1): Monday – Thursday

en.tu: Mới: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, week | Ôn: day, hello, friend, morning, class
en.cum: Mới: on Monday / on Tuesday / what day / this week | Ôn: good morning / see you
en.cau: What day is it today? It's Monday. / [Ngữ pháp: on + thứ] On Tuesday, I see my friend. / There are seven days in a week.
en.truyen: Monday Morning — Bông: Good morning, Mom! What day is it today? Mom: It's Monday. Bông: Monday? Hello, class! Hello, teacher! On Tuesday, I see my friend Leo.
en.video: Days Of The Week – Super Simple Songs – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vcMmiR7jWQc

zh.tu: Mới: 星期一 xīngqīyī, 星期二 xīngqī'èr, 星期三 xīngqīsān, 星期四 xīngqīsì, 星期几 xīngqī jǐ | Ôn: 星期 xīngqī, 老师 lǎoshī, 大家 dàjiā
zh.cum: Mới: 今天星期几 jīntiān xīngqī jǐ / 今天星期一 jīntiān xīngqīyī / 星期二见 xīngqī'èr jiàn | Ôn: 老师好 lǎoshī hǎo
zh.cau: 今天星期几？(Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ?) / 今天星期一。(Jīntiān xīngqīyī.) / [Ngữ pháp: 星期 + số] 星期三，我去学校。(Xīngqīsān, wǒ qù xuéxiào.)
zh.truyen: 星期一 — Bông：妈妈好！今天星期几？妈妈：今天星期一。Bông：星期一！我去学校。老师好！大家好！(Bông: Māma hǎo! Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? Māma: Jīntiān xīngqīyī. Bông: Xīngqīyī! Wǒ qù xuéxiào. Lǎoshī hǎo! Dàjiā hǎo!)
zh.video: 星期歌 – KidsMusicTime – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NWKDy67BbwA

web.label: Ngày 6. Unit 1 · Time & Date 1 · Thứ trong tuần (2): Friday – Sunday, cuối tuần

en.tu: Mới: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, weekend, pool | Ôn: Monday, Wednesday, week, kid, lesson
en.cum: Mới: at the weekend / on Sunday / by the pool / play by the pool | Ôn: on Monday / what day
en.cau: It's Saturday. It's the weekend! / On Sunday, I play by the pool. / [Ngữ pháp: at the weekend] At the weekend, there are no lessons.
en.truyen: The Weekend — Leo: It's Saturday! It's the weekend! Bông: No lessons today! Leo: On Sunday, let's play by the pool. Bông: Hooray! See you on Sunday, Leo!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Saturday Sunday weekend song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 星期五 xīngqīwǔ, 星期六 xīngqīliù, 星期天 xīngqītiān, 星期日 xīngqīrì | Ôn: 星期一 xīngqīyī, 星期三 xīngqīsān, 爸爸 bàba
zh.cum: Mới: 星期六和星期天 xīngqīliù hé xīngqītiān / 一个星期 yí gè xīngqī / 有七天 yǒu qī tiān / 星期天见 xīngqītiān jiàn | Ôn: 今天星期几 jīntiān xīngqī jǐ
zh.cau: 今天星期六。(Jīntiān xīngqīliù.) / 星期天，爸爸妈妈陪我玩。(Xīngqītiān, bàba māma péi wǒ wán.) / [Ngữ pháp: không có 星期七] 一个星期有七天：星期一到星期天。(Yí gè xīngqī yǒu qī tiān: xīngqīyī dào xīngqītiān.)
zh.truyen: 星期六 — Xiaomei：今天星期六！Bông：今天不去学校！Xiaomei：星期天，我们一起玩吧。Bông：好！爸爸妈妈也陪我们玩。星期天见！(Xiaomei: Jīntiān xīngqīliù! Bông: Jīntiān bú qù xuéxiào! Xiaomei: Xīngqītiān, wǒmen yìqǐ wán ba. Bông: Hǎo! Bàba māma yě péi wǒmen wán. Xīngqītiān jiàn!)
zh.video: 星期歌 – KidsMusicTime – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NWKDy67BbwA

en.flash: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, week, weekend, pool | Ôn: day, friend, lesson
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tờ lịch của Bông, chọn thứ (5 câu): Monday / Tuesday / Wednesday / Friday / Sunday. 2) Xếp thẻ thứ đúng thứ tự (trò Lịch sống trên slide): Monday → Sunday, cô gọi bằng tiếng Anh. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo lịch trên bảng: What day is it today? – It's Thursday. / Is it the weekend? – Yes, it's Saturday.
en.truyen: Bông's Calendar — Bông has got a red calendar. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday: school, school, school! Saturday and Sunday: it's the weekend. On Sunday, Bông plays by the pool with Leo. What day is it today? It's Monday. Hello, school!

It is Monday! (đếm ngón theo từng ngày) · Vè: Monday, Tuesday, school, school, school, / Saturday, Sunday – play by the pool!

zh.tu: Ôn: 一点 yī diǎn, 两点 liǎng diǎn, 七点 qī diǎn, 十二点 shí'èr diǎn, 几点 jǐ diǎn, 星期一 xīngqīyī, 星期天 xīngqītiān, 分钟 fēnzhōng
zh.cum: Ôn: 星期一七点 xīngqīyī qī diǎn / 星期天十二点 xīngqītiān shí'èr diǎn / 看日历 kàn rìlì
zh.cau: 今天星期一，现在七点。(Jīntiān xīngqīyī, xiànzài qī diǎn.) / 现在不是两点，是一点。(Xiànzài bú shì liǎng diǎn, shì yī diǎn.) / [Phiên dịch nhí] Xiaomei问：现在几点？(Xiànzài jǐ diǎn?) – con nói lại cho Leo bằng tiếng Anh.
zh.truyen: 今天星期几？(二) — Bông：今天星期几？Xiaomei：今天星期天！妈妈：不对，今天星期一。你看日历。Bông：现在是几月？妈妈：现在十月。Bông：现在几点？妈妈：现在七点。Bông：哎呀！(Bông: Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? Xiaomei: Jīntiān xīngqītiān! Māma: Bú duì, jīntiān xīngqīyī. Nǐ kàn rìlì. Bông: Xiànzài shì jǐ yuè? Māma: Xiànzài shíyuè. Bông: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Māma: Xiànzài qī diǎn. Bông: Āiyā!)
zh.video: 星期歌 – KidsMusicTime – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NWKDy67BbwA

en.flash: Ôn cả unit: Monday – Sunday, week, weekend, pool, January, March, June, October, December, month, calendar, clock, now, o'clock, at, look at, well done
en.slide: 1) Đọc truyện 1 theo vai, chọn tranh đúng (3 câu): What day is it today? (Monday) / What time is it? (seven o'clock) / Who says “It's Sunday!”? (Leo). 2) PS-2 trên lớp: lịch tuần của Leo bằng tiếng Anh (Monday: pool, Wednesday: painting, Saturday: monkeys) – câu hỏi tiếng Trung ở phần zh. 3) Hỏi – đáp xoay vòng NL6: Leo hỏi EN – What day is it today? / What month is it? / What time is it?
en.truyen: What Day Is It? — Bông: What day is it today? Leo: It's Sunday! No school! Mom: No, it's Monday. Look at the calendar. Bông: What time is it? Mom: It's seven o'clock. Bông: Oh no! (Đọc theo vai Bông – Leo – Mom, diễn với tờ lịch và đồng hồ thật.)
en.baihat: Seven Days cả bài: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, / Friday, Saturday and Sunday, / Seven days and then again, / What day is it? It is Monday! / What time is it? What time is it? / It is seven, seven o'clock! / Time to get up, time to get up, / Tick-tock, tick-tock, tick-tock-tock! · Biểu diễn vè: Monday, Tuesday, school, school, school, / Saturday, Sunday – play by the pool!

zh.flash: Ôn cả unit: 星期一 – 星期六 xīngqīyī – xīngqīliù, 星期天 xīngqītiān, 星期日 xīngqīrì, 一月 yīyuè, 十月 shíyuè, 十二月 shí'èryuè, 年 nián, 日历 rìlì, 时间 shíjiān, 一点 yī diǎn, 两点 liǎng diǎn, 七点 qī diǎn, 分钟 fēnzhōng
zh.slide: 1) PS-2: nghe lịch tuần của Leo (EN), trả lời “Leo星期三做什么？” – chọn tranh. 2) Hỏi – đáp xoay vòng NL6: Xiaomei hỏi ZH – 今天星期几？/ 现在是几月？/ 现在几点？, con đáp đúng tiếng. 3) Chép 日 月 vào ô; gạch ngày hôm nay trên lịch lớp và đọc to 今天星期__。
zh.truyen: 今天星期几？— Bông：今天星期几？Xiaomei：今天星期天！妈妈：不对，今天星期一。你看日历。Bông：现在几点？妈妈：现在七点。Bông：哎呀！(Bông: Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? Xiaomei: Jīntiān xīngqītiān! Māma: Bú duì, jīntiān xīngqīyī. Nǐ kàn rìlì. Bông: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Māma: Xiànzài qī diǎn. Bông: Āiyā!) (Đọc theo vai có pinyin, diễn: Bông ngái ngủ, mẹ chỉ lịch.)
zh.baihat: 一个星期七天 cả bài: 星期一二三四五，星期六和星期天，一个星期有七天，今天星期几？星期一！/ 现在几点？现在几点？现在七点，七点钟！起床啦，起床啦，滴答滴答滴答滴！(Xīngqī yī èr sān sì wǔ, xīngqīliù hé xīngqītiān, yí gè xīngqī yǒu qī tiān, jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? Xīngqīyī! / Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Xiànzài qī diǎn, qī diǎn zhōng! Qǐchuáng la, qǐchuáng la, dīdā dīdā dīdā dī!) · Biểu diễn vè: 星期一到星期五，天天上学好好读；星期六，星期天，爸爸妈妈陪我玩！(Xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, tiāntiān shàngxué hǎohǎo dú; xīngqīliù, xīngqītiān, bàba māma péi wǒ wán!)

blocks.title: Unit 2 · Time & Date 2 · 日期和生日

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 7. Unit 2 · Time & Date 2 – Hỏi – đáp ngày; hôm qua, hôm nay, ngày mai; tô 天

web.label: Ngày 13. Unit 2 · Time & Date 2 · Hôm qua, hôm nay, ngày mai; ngày mấy

en.tu: Mới: yesterday, 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 8th | Ôn: today, tomorrow, number, again, really
en.cum: Mới: what's the date / the 3rd / the 8th / yesterday was / tomorrow is | Ôn: what day
en.cau: What's the date today? It's the 3rd today. / [Ngữ pháp: số thứ tự 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 8th] Yesterday was the 2nd. / Tomorrow is the 4th.
en.truyen: What's the Date? — Leo: What's the date today? Anna: It's the 3rd today. Leo: Yesterday was the 2nd. Anna: Yes! And tomorrow is the 4th. It's my birthday! Leo: Really? Wow!
en.video: Birthday Month Song – The Kiboomers – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EoekUrO1E14

zh.tu: Mới: 昨天 zuótiān, 日 rì, 几号 jǐ hào, 三号 sān hào, 八号 bā hào | Ôn: 今天 jīntiān, 明天 míngtiān, 号 hào, 生日 shēngrì
zh.cum: Mới: 今天几号 jīntiān jǐ hào / 昨天二号 zuótiān èr hào / 明天四号 míngtiān sì hào / 三日 sān rì | Ôn: 今天星期几 jīntiān xīngqī jǐ
zh.cau: 今天几号？(Jīntiān jǐ hào?) / 今天三号。(Jīntiān sān hào.) / [Ngữ pháp: số thường + 号; viết thì dùng 日] 昨天二号，明天四号。(Zuótiān èr hào, míngtiān sì hào.)
zh.truyen: 今天几号？— Leo：今天几号？Anna：今天三号。Leo：昨天二号。Anna：对！明天四号，是我的生日！Leo：真的吗？(Leo: Jīntiān jǐ hào? Anna: Jīntiān sān hào. Leo: Zuótiān èr hào. Anna: Duì! Míngtiān sì hào, shì wǒ de shēngrì! Leo: Zhēn de ma?)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "今天几号 儿歌 昨天今天明天"

web.label: Ngày 14. Unit 2 · Time & Date 2 · Hỏi ngày, hỏi khi nào: When…?

en.tu: Mới: when, say, 4th, 5th, 31st | Ôn: yesterday, tomorrow, month, how old, name
en.cum: Mới: what's the date (date) / say the date / when is / thirty-one days | Ôn: the 3rd / tomorrow is
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: When…?] When is your birthday? / Say the date, please: December 4th. / How many days are there in June? Thirty days.
en.truyen: Say the Date — Teacher: Leo, say the date, please. Leo: It's December 3rd. Teacher: Well done! Anna, when is your birthday? Anna: It's tomorrow, December 4th! Teacher: How many days are there in December? Leo: Thirty-one!
en.video: When is your birthday? – Loonytricky – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4NGo0iMis-c

zh.tu: Mới: 多少 duōshao, 告诉 gàosu, 时候 shíhou, 几月几号 jǐ yuè jǐ hào | Ôn: 昨天 zuótiān, 号 hào, 名字 míngzi, 岁 suì
zh.cum: Mới: 什么时候 shénme shíhou / 告诉我 gàosu wǒ / 多少天 duōshao tiān / 三十一天 sānshíyī tiān | Ôn: 今天几号 jīntiān jǐ hào
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 什么时候 hỏi thời gian] 你的生日是什么时候？(Nǐ de shēngrì shì shénme shíhou?) / 告诉我今天几月几号。(Gàosu wǒ jīntiān jǐ yuè jǐ hào.) / 十二月有多少天？三十一天。(Shí'èryuè yǒu duōshao tiān? Sānshíyī tiān.)
zh.truyen: 告诉我 — 老师：Leo，告诉我今天几月几号。Leo：今天十二月三号。老师：很好！Anna，你的生日是什么时候？Anna：明天，十二月四号！老师：十二月有多少天？Leo：三十一天！(Lǎoshī: Leo, gàosu wǒ jīntiān jǐ yuè jǐ hào. Leo: Jīntiān shí'èryuè sān hào. Lǎoshī: Hěn hǎo! Anna, nǐ de shēngrì shì shénme shíhou? Anna: Míngtiān, shí'èryuè sì hào! Lǎoshī: Shí'èryuè yǒu duōshao tiān? Leo: Sānshíyī tiān!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "几月几号 儿歌 日期"

en.flash: yesterday, today, tomorrow, 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 8th, 31st, when, say | Ôn: December, Tuesday, calendar
en.slide: 1) Trò Hôm qua – hôm nay – ngày mai trên slide: nghe từ, chạm ô đúng (6 lượt): yesterday / today / tomorrow. 2) Nối số với số thứ tự (5 cặp): 1 – 1st, 2 – 2nd, 3 – 3rd, 8 – 8th, 31 – 31st (âm cuối -st, -nd, -rd, -th). 3) Nhìn tờ lịch tháng Mười hai khoanh ngày, hỏi – đáp: What's the date today? – It's the 3rd. / When is Anna's birthday? – It's the 4th.
en.truyen: December Calendar — Look at the calendar. It's December. Yesterday was Monday, the 2nd. Today is Tuesday, the 3rd. Tomorrow is Wednesday, the 4th. When is Anna's birthday? It's tomorrow! How many days are there in December? Thirty-one days.
en.baihat: Vè: Thirty days has September, / April, June and November. (vè dân gian Anh) · Nghe: When Is Your Birthday? (giai điệu: For He's a Jolly Good Fellow – dân gian) — đoạn Hỏi: When is your birthday, my friend? / When is your birthday, my friend? / When is your birthday, my friend? / Tell me the month and the day!

zh.flash: 昨天 zuótiān, 今天 jīntiān, 明天 míngtiān, 日 rì, 几号 jǐ hào, 三号 sān hào, 八号 bā hào, 多少 duōshao, 告诉 gàosu, 时候 shíhou | Ôn: 号 hào, 十二月 shí'èryuè
zh.slide: 1) Xếp vào nhóm theo chữ chung: có 天 (今天, 明天, 昨天) / không có 天 (三号, 八号). 2) Nghe chọn ngày trên lịch (4 câu): 今天三号。/ 昨天二号。/ 明天四号。/ 十二月三十一号。 3) Tô 天: người dang tay (大), trên đầu là bầu trời – 4 nét: ngang, ngang, phẩy, mác.
zh.truyen: 十二月的日历 — 你看日历，现在是十二月。昨天星期一，二号。今天星期二，三号。明天星期三，四号。Anna的生日是什么时候？是明天！十二月有多少天？三十一天。(Nǐ kàn rìlì, xiànzài shì shí'èryuè. Zuótiān xīngqīyī, èr hào. Jīntiān xīngqī'èr, sān hào. Míngtiān xīngqīsān, sì hào. Anna de shēngrì shì shénme shíhou? Shì míngtiān! Shí'èryuè yǒu duōshao tiān? Sānshíyī tiān.)
zh.baihat: Nghe: 你的生日是几月几号？(giai điệu: For He's a Jolly Good Fellow) — đoạn Hỏi: 你的生日是几月几号？/ 你的生日是几月几号？/ 你的生日是几月几号？/ 告诉我几月几号！(Nǐ de shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? ×3 / Gàosu wǒ jǐ yuè jǐ hào!) · Ôn hát Seven Days đoạn Thứ (Unit 1)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 8. Unit 2 · Time & Date 2 – Nói sinh nhật; sinh nhật ở Trung Quốc; chép 天, tô 星

web.label: Ngày 15. Unit 2 · Time & Date 2 · Sinh nhật (1): thiệp, quà, nến

en.tu: Mới: card, present, candle, kite, robot | Ôn: December, June, which, calendar, birthday, cake
en.cum: Mới: make a card / a birthday present / six candles / a kite for Leo / a robot for Bông | Ôn: Happy birthday! / which month
en.cau: Bông makes a card for Anna. / [Ngữ pháp: a / some] There are six candles on the cake. / My present is a kite. / Which month is your birthday? It's June.
en.truyen: A Card for Anna — Bông: Tomorrow is Anna's birthday. Let's make a card! Leo: OK! My present is a kite. Bông: Look at the cake! There are six candles. Leo: Anna is six years old. Happy birthday, Anna!
en.video: Birthday Month Song – The Kiboomers – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EoekUrO1E14

zh.tu: Mới: 卡片 kǎpiàn, 做 zuò, 礼物 lǐwù, 蜡烛 làzhú | Ôn: 十二月 shí'èryuè, 六月 liùyuè, 日历 rìlì, 生日 shēngrì, 蛋糕 dàngāo, 快乐 kuàilè
zh.cum: Mới: 做卡片 zuò kǎpiàn / 一张卡片 yì zhāng kǎpiàn / 生日礼物 shēngrì lǐwù / 六根蜡烛 liù gēn làzhú | Ôn: 生日快乐 shēngrì kuàilè
zh.cau: Bông做卡片。(Bông zuò kǎpiàn.) / [Ngữ pháp: lượng từ 张, 根] 蛋糕上有六根蜡烛。(Dàngāo shang yǒu liù gēn làzhú.) / 这是我的生日礼物。(Zhè shì wǒ de shēngrì lǐwù.)
zh.truyen: 给Anna的卡片 — Bông：明天是Anna的生日。我们做卡片吧！Leo：好！这是我的礼物。Bông：你看蛋糕，有六根蜡烛。Leo：Anna六岁了。生日快乐，Anna！(Bông: Míngtiān shì Anna de shēngrì. Wǒmen zuò kǎpiàn ba! Leo: Hǎo! Zhè shì wǒ de lǐwù. Bông: Nǐ kàn dàngāo, yǒu liù gēn làzhú. Leo: Anna liù suì le. Shēngrì kuàilè, Anna!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "生日快乐歌 中文 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 16. Unit 2 · Time & Date 2 · Sinh nhật (2): sinh nhật ở Trung Quốc, mì trường thọ

en.tu: Mới: China, long, guitar, football, soccer | Ôn: Tuesday, Sunday, October, o'clock, noodles
en.cum: Mới: long noodles / in China / play football (soccer) / a guitar present / we eat | Ôn: at seven o'clock / on Sunday
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: we + động từ] In China, we eat long noodles on birthdays. / Leo's present is a football. / On Sunday, we play football at four o'clock.
en.truyen: Long Noodles — Xiaomei: In China, we eat long noodles on birthdays! Bông: Long noodles? Wow! Leo: My present for Anna is a football. Anna: And I've got a guitar! On Sunday, we eat noodles at twelve o'clock.
en.video: When is your birthday? – Loonytricky – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4NGo0iMis-c

zh.tu: Mới: 中国 Zhōngguó, 长寿面 chángshòumiàn, 过生日 guò shēngrì, 足球 zúqiú | Ôn: 星期二 xīngqī'èr, 星期天 xīngqītiān, 十月 shíyuè, 两点 liǎng diǎn, 面条 miàntiáo
zh.cum: Mới: 在中国 zài Zhōngguó / 吃长寿面 chī chángshòumiàn / 过生日的时候 guò shēngrì de shíhou / 踢足球 tī zúqiú | Ôn: 星期天十二点 xīngqītiān shí'èr diǎn
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 过生日的时候 + việc làm] 在中国，过生日的时候我们吃长寿面。(Zài Zhōngguó, guò shēngrì de shíhou wǒmen chī chángshòumiàn.) / 长寿面很长。(Chángshòumiàn hěn cháng.) / 星期天两点，我们踢足球。(Xīngqītiān liǎng diǎn, wǒmen tī zúqiú.)
zh.truyen: 长寿面 — Xiaomei：在中国，过生日的时候我们吃长寿面！Bông：长寿面很长吗？Xiaomei：对，很长！Leo：我的礼物是一个足球。星期天十二点，我们一起吃长寿面吧！(Xiaomei: Zài Zhōngguó, guò shēngrì de shíhou wǒmen chī chángshòumiàn! Bông: Chángshòumiàn hěn cháng ma? Xiaomei: Duì, hěn cháng! Leo: Wǒ de lǐwù shì yí gè zúqiú. Xīngqītiān shí'èr diǎn, wǒmen yìqǐ chī chángshòumiàn ba!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "长寿面 过生日 中国 儿童"

en.flash: card, present, candle, kite, robot, China, long, guitar, football, soccer | Ôn: birthday, cake, June, December
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (6 câu): card / present / candle / kite / robot / guitar. 2) Kéo thả câu vào tranh: Happy birthday! / In China, we eat long noodles. / My present is a football. 3) Hỏi sinh nhật từng con, xếp hàng theo tháng trên slide: When is your birthday? – My birthday is June 8th.
en.truyen: Happy Birthday, Leo! — It's June 8th. It's Leo's birthday! Anna makes a card. Bông's present is a robot. There are six candles on the cake. Xiaomei says: "In China, we eat long noodles." Leo says: "Thank you! I love my birthday!"
en.baihat: When Is Your Birthday? (giai điệu: For He's a Jolly Good Fellow – dân gian) — đoạn Hỏi: When is your birthday, my friend? / When is your birthday, my friend? / When is your birthday, my friend? / Tell me the month and the day! / đoạn Đáp: My birthday is June the eighth, / my birthday is June the eighth, / my birthday is June the eighth, / June the eighth – hooray! (từng con hát sinh nhật thật của mình)

zh.flash: 卡片 kǎpiàn, 做 zuò, 礼物 lǐwù, 蜡烛 làzhú, 中国 Zhōngguó, 长寿面 chángshòumiàn, 过生日 guò shēngrì, 足球 zúqiú | Ôn: 生日 shēngrì, 快乐 kuàilè, 蛋糕 dàngāo
zh.slide: 1) Trật tự lớn → nhỏ: kéo thẻ thành câu đúng 我的生日是 / 六月 / 八号 (nhiễu: 八号六月). 2) Văn hóa: bát mì trường thọ và bánh kem – nghe câu, chạm tranh: 在中国，过生日吃长寿面。/ 生日蛋糕上有蜡烛。 3) Đếm khớp ngón tay tìm tháng 31 ngày theo vè; chép 天, tô 星 (9 nét: sổ, ngang gập, ngang, ngang, phẩy, ngang, ngang, sổ, ngang).
zh.truyen: Leo的生日 — 今天六月八号，是Leo的生日！Anna做卡片。Bông的礼物是一个足球。蛋糕上有六根蜡烛。Xiaomei说：“在中国，过生日的时候我们吃长寿面。”Leo说：“谢谢大家！”(Jīntiān liùyuè bā hào, shì Leo de shēngrì! Anna zuò kǎpiàn. Bông de lǐwù shì yí gè zúqiú. Dàngāo shang yǒu liù gēn làzhú. Xiaomei shuō: “Zài Zhōngguó, guò shēngrì de shíhou wǒmen chī chángshòumiàn.” Leo shuō: “Xièxie dàjiā!”)
zh.baihat: Vè: 一三五七八十腊，三十一天永不差。(Yī sān wǔ qī bā shí là, sānshíyī tiān yǒng bú chà.) (đếm trên khớp ngón tay; 腊 ở đây chỉ tháng Mười hai) · 你的生日是几月几号？(giai điệu: For He's a Jolly Good Fellow) — đoạn Hỏi: 你的生日是几月几号？/ 你的生日是几月几号？/ 你的生日是几月几号？/ 告诉我几月几号！(Nǐ de shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? ×3 / Gàosu wǒ jǐ yuè jǐ hào!) / đoạn Đáp: 我的生日是六月八号，/ 我的生日是六月八号，/ 我的生日是六月八号，/ 六月八号，好呀！(Wǒ de shēngrì shì liùyuè bā hào ×3 / liùyuè bā hào, hǎo ya!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 9. Unit 2 · Time & Date 2 – Ngày đầy đủ trên lịch; limerick; chép 星

zh.cau: 昨天二号。(Zuótiān èr hào.) / 明天八号。(Míngtiān bā hào.) / [Ngữ pháp: 昨天 / 今天 / 明天 đứng đầu câu] 昨天星期一，今天星期二。(Zuótiān xīngqīyī, jīntiān xīngqī'èr.)
zh.truyen: Bông的猫 — 昨天星期一，二号。Bông的猫在哪儿？今天星期二，三号。你看，猫在床下面！明天四号，是Anna的生日。Bông说：“明天我们一起说生日快乐！”(Zuótiān xīngqīyī, èr hào. Bông de māo zài nǎr? Jīntiān xīngqī'èr, sān hào. Nǐ kàn, māo zài chuáng xiàmiàn! Míngtiān sì hào, shì Anna de shēngrì. Bông shuō: “Míngtiān wǒmen yìqǐ shuō shēngrì kuàilè!”)

en.flash: Ôn: Tuesday, December, June, Sunday, 3rd, 8th, yesterday, tomorrow, skateboard, sport, hockey, kick, hit, fishing
en.slide: 1) Lịch tháng của lớp: nghe ngày đầy đủ, chạm ô đúng (4 câu): Tuesday, December 3rd / Wednesday, December 4th / Sunday, June 8th / Monday, March 1st. 2) Nhìn tranh chọn cụm (4 câu): kick a football / hit the ball / go fishing / ride a skateboard. 3) Limerick nói theo nhịp, con thay tháng của mình: My birthday is in ___.
en.truyen: The Class Birthday Calendar — Look at our birthday calendar! Leo's birthday is June 8th. Anna's birthday is December 4th. Bông's birthday is March 1st. Xiaomei's birthday is October 2nd. When is your birthday? Tell me the month and the day!
en.baihat: Limerick: My birthday is in May, May, May, / Let's have a party – hip hooray! (May – hooray) · Hát cả bài: When Is Your Birthday? (giai điệu: For He's a Jolly Good Fellow – dân gian) — đoạn Hỏi: When is your birthday, my friend? / When is your birthday, my friend? / When is your birthday, my friend? / Tell me the month and the day! / đoạn Đáp: My birthday is June the eighth, / my birthday is June the eighth, / my birthday is June the eighth, / June the eighth – hooray!

zh.flash: Ôn: 星期二 xīngqī'èr, 十二月 shí'èryuè, 三号 sān hào, 四号 sì hào, 昨天 zuótiān, 明天 míngtiān, 滑板 huábǎn, 运动 yùndòng, 踢 tī, 足球 zúqiú
zh.slide: 1) 三号 và 3rd: nối số thường + 号 với số thứ tự (4 cặp): 三号 – 3rd, 八号 – 8th, 一号 – 1st, 二号 – 2nd. 2) Thanh điệu: 号 hào (4) ≠ 好 hǎo (3); 昨天 zuótiān (2–1); 生日 shēngrì (1–4) – nghe chọn đúng. 3) Chép 星 trong 星期 vào ô.
zh.truyen: 班级生日日历 — 你看我们的生日日历！Leo的生日是六月八号。Anna的生日是十二月四号。Bông的生日是三月一号。Xiaomei的生日是十月二号。你的生日是几月几号？告诉我！(Nǐ kàn wǒmen de shēngrì rìlì! Leo de shēngrì shì liùyuè bā hào. Anna de shēngrì shì shí'èryuè sì hào. Bông de shēngrì shì sānyuè yī hào. Xiaomei de shēngrì shì shíyuè èr hào. Nǐ de shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? Gàosu wǒ!)
zh.baihat: Limerick: 今天几号？今天三号，明天生日，真热闹！(Jīntiān jǐ hào? Jīntiān sān hào, míngtiān shēngrì, zhēn rènao!) (hào – nao) · Hát cả bài: 你的生日是几月几号？(giai điệu: For He's a Jolly Good Fellow) — đoạn Hỏi: 你的生日是几月几号？/ 你的生日是几月几号？/ 你的生日是几月几号？/ 告诉我几月几号！(Nǐ de shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? ×3 / Gàosu wǒ jǐ yuè jǐ hào!) / đoạn Đáp: 我的生日是六月八号，/ 我的生日是六月八号，/ 我的生日是六月八号，/ 六月八号，好呀！(Wǒ de shēngrì shì liùyuè bā hào ×3 / liùyuè bā hào, hǎo ya!)

zh.cum: Mới: 吃午饭 chī wǔfàn / 中午十二点 zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn / 先刷牙 xiān shuā yá / 一杯牛奶 yì bēi niúnǎi | Ôn: 吃早饭 chī zǎofàn
zh.cau: 我中午十二点吃午饭。(Wǒ zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn chī wǔfàn.) / [Ngữ pháp: 先……再…… làm trước, làm sau] 我先刷牙，再吃早饭。(Wǒ xiān shuā yá, zài chī zǎofàn.) / 中午我喝一杯牛奶。(Zhōngwǔ wǒ hē yì bēi niúnǎi.)
zh.truyen: 吃午饭 — 早上，Xiaomei先刷牙，再吃早饭。中午十二点，Xiaomei和Leo一起吃午饭。Leo喝一杯牛奶。Leo说：“午饭真好吃！”(Zǎoshang, Xiaomei xiān shuā yá, zài chī zǎofàn. Zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn, Xiaomei hé Leo yìqǐ chī wǔfàn. Leo hē yì bēi niúnǎi. Leo shuō: “Wǔfàn zhēn hǎochī!”)

en.flash: get up, wake up, wash, face, breakfast, noon, lunch, brush, teeth, cup | Ôn: morning, seven o'clock, twelve o'clock
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn việc làm (6 câu): get up / wash my face / eat breakfast / brush my teeth / eat lunch / wake up. 2) Trò Làm theo lệnh trên slide: cô nói, con làm động tác – Get up! / Wash your face! / Brush your teeth! 3) Kéo tranh việc vào đồng hồ: I get up at seven o'clock. / I eat lunch at twelve o'clock.
en.truyen: Leo's Morning — It's seven o'clock in the morning. Mom says: "Wake up, Leo!" Leo gets up. He washes his face and brushes his teeth. He eats breakfast and drinks a cup of milk. At noon, he eats lunch at school.
en.baihat: Time to Get Up (giai điệu: Frère Jacques – dân gian Pháp, mỗi dòng hát 2 lần) — đoạn Sáng: Time to get up! / It's seven! / Wash your face, eat breakfast, / Go to school! (vươn vai, rửa mặt, đeo cặp) · Vè: Seven o'clock, I get up, / Wash my face and fill my cup!

zh.flash: 起床 qǐchuáng, 洗脸 xǐ liǎn, 早饭 zǎofàn, 早上 zǎoshang, 中午 zhōngwǔ, 午饭 wǔfàn, 刷牙 shuā yá, 先 xiān | Ôn: 七点 qī diǎn, 十二点 shí'èr diǎn
zh.slide: 1) NL9 trật tự câu: kéo thẻ thành câu 我 / 早上 / 七点 / 起床 (nhiễu: 我起床早上七点). 2) Nghe chọn tranh (4 câu): 起床 / 洗脸 / 吃早饭 / 吃午饭. 3) Tô 早: mặt trời 日 nhô lên trên ngọn cỏ 十 – 6 nét: sổ, ngang gập, ngang, ngang, ngang, sổ.
zh.truyen: Leo的早上 — 早上七点，妈妈说：“Leo，快起床！”Leo起床了。他先洗脸，再刷牙。他吃早饭，喝一杯牛奶。中午十二点，他在学校吃午饭。(Zǎoshang qī diǎn, māma shuō: “Leo, kuài qǐchuáng!” Leo qǐchuáng le. Tā xiān xǐ liǎn, zài shuā yá. Tā chī zǎofàn, hē yì bēi niúnǎi. Zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn, tā zài xuéxiào chī wǔfàn.)
zh.baihat: 快起床啦 (giai điệu: Frère Jacques) — đoạn Sáng: 快起床啦！/ 七点了！/ 洗洗脸吃早饭，/ 去上学！(Kuài qǐchuáng la! / Qī diǎn le! / Xǐxi liǎn chī zǎofàn, / qù shàngxué!)

en.tu: Mới: evening, dinner, sleep, bath | Ôn: when, yesterday, say, present, nine o'clock, story

en.cau: What time do you get up? / I sleep at nine o'clock in the evening. / [Ngữ pháp: When…? (Unit 2)] When do you have a bath? In the evening.
en.truyen: Good Night, Bông — In the evening, Bông eats dinner at six o'clock. She has a bath. Mom tells a story. Bông says: "Good night, Mom!" She goes to sleep at nine o'clock. Yesterday was her birthday. Her present is a new story book!

zh.tu: Mới: 晚上 wǎnshang, 吃晚饭 chī wǎnfàn, 睡觉 shuìjiào, 洗澡 xǐzǎo | Ôn: 时候 shíhou, 昨天 zuótiān, 礼物 lǐwù, 九点 jiǔ diǎn, 读 dú
zh.cum: Mới: 晚上九点 wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn / 六点吃晚饭 liù diǎn chī wǎnfàn / 去睡觉 qù shuìjiào / 晚安 wǎn'ān | Ôn: 什么时候 shénme shíhou
zh.cau: 你几点起床？(Nǐ jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?) / 我晚上九点睡觉。(Wǒ wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn shuìjiào.) / [Ngữ pháp: 什么时候 (Unit 2)] 你什么时候洗澡？(Nǐ shénme shíhou xǐzǎo?)
zh.truyen: 晚安，Bông — 晚上，Bông六点吃晚饭。她洗澡。妈妈读书给她听。Bông说：“妈妈，晚安！”她九点睡觉。昨天是她的生日，她的礼物是一本新书！(Wǎnshang, Bông liù diǎn chī wǎnfàn. Tā xǐzǎo. Māma dú shū gěi tā tīng. Bông shuō: “Māma, wǎn'ān!” Tā jiǔ diǎn shuìjiào. Zuótiān shì tā de shēngrì, tā de lǐwù shì yì běn xīn shū!)

en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: his] Leo does his homework in his room. / It takes twenty minutes to go to school. / On the way to school, I see a long kite.
en.truyen: Leo's Room — Leo goes to school at eight o'clock. It takes twenty minutes. On the way to school, he sees a long kite. In the evening, he does his homework in his room. There is a robot on the rug and a clock on the wall.

zh.tu: Mới: 上学 shàngxué, 房间 fángjiān, 同学 tóngxué, 铅笔 qiānbǐ, 作业 zuòyè | Ôn: 做 zuò, 卡片 kǎpiàn, 分钟 fēnzhōng, 学校 xuéxiào
zh.cum: Mới: 去上学 qù shàngxué / 做作业 zuò zuòyè / 在房间 zài fángjiān / 二十分钟 èrshí fēnzhōng / 我的同学 wǒ de tóngxué | Ôn: 做卡片 zuò kǎpiàn
zh.cau: 我八点去上学。(Wǒ bā diǎn qù shàngxué.) / [Ngữ pháp: 在 + nơi chốn + việc làm] Leo在房间做作业。(Leo zài fángjiān zuò zuòyè.) / 去学校要二十分钟。(Qù xuéxiào yào èrshí fēnzhōng.)
zh.truyen: Leo的房间 — Leo八点去上学，要二十分钟。他和同学一起去学校。晚上，Leo在房间用铅笔做作业。他也做了一张卡片。(Leo bā diǎn qù shàngxué, yào èrshí fēnzhōng. Tā hé tóngxué yìqǐ qù xuéxiào. Wǎnshang, Leo zài fángjiān yòng qiānbǐ zuò zuòyè. Tā yě zuòle yì zhāng kǎpiàn.)

en.flash: evening, dinner, sleep, bath, go to sleep, school, homework, room, take, way | Ôn: get up, breakfast, lunch, when, yesterday
en.slide: 1) Trò Sáng, trưa hay tối? trên slide: nghe việc làm, chạm mặt trời mọc / mặt trời giữa trưa / mặt trăng (6 lượt): get up / eat lunch / eat dinner / have a bath / go to sleep / eat breakfast. 2) Phỏng vấn giờ dậy, giờ ngủ: What time do you get up? – I get up at … / What time do you go to sleep? 3) Điền chỗ trống: Leo does ___ homework in his ___. en.truyen: Bông's Evening — In the evening, Bông eats dinner at six o'clock. She does her homework in her room. She has a bath. Then she brushes her teeth. Mom says: "It's nine o'clock. Go to sleep, Bông!" Bông says: "Good night!"

zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn đồng hồ + tranh (4 câu): 我晚上九点睡觉。/ 我六点吃晚饭。/ 我八点去上学。/ Leo在房间做作业。 2) Phỏng vấn: 你几点起床？/ 你几点睡觉？– con ghi giờ của bạn vào bảng. 3) Chép 早 trong 早上 vào ô.
zh.truyen: Bông的晚上 — 晚上，Bông六点吃晚饭。她在房间做作业。她洗澡，刷牙。妈妈说：“九点了，去睡觉吧！”Bông说：“晚安！”(Wǎnshang, Bông liù diǎn chī wǎnfàn. Tā zài fángjiān zuò zuòyè. Tā xǐzǎo, shuā yá. Māma shuō: “Jiǔ diǎn le, qù shuìjiào ba!” Bông shuō: “Wǎn'ān!”)
zh.baihat: Vè: 早上起床洗洗脸，中午吃饭吃一碗，晚上九点睡得甜！(Zǎoshang qǐchuáng xǐxi liǎn, zhōngwǔ chīfàn chī yì wǎn, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn shuì de tián!) · đoạn Tối: 该睡觉啦！/ 九点了！/ 闭上眼睛晚安，/ 睡觉觉！(Gāi shuìjiào la! / Jiǔ diǎn le! / Bì shang yǎnjing wǎn'ān, / shuì jiàojiào!)

en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: on + Saturday morning] On Saturday, I get up at eight o'clock. / What time do you sleep? / Tomorrow is Sunday. / Every day, I say hello to my classmates.
en.truyen: Saturday Morning — Today is Saturday. Leo gets up at eight o'clock. He listens to the radio. Mom says: "No phone, no tablet in the morning!" Tomorrow is Sunday. Tomorrow morning, Leo gets up at nine o'clock.

zh.tu: Mới: 每天 měitiān, 汉语 Hànyǔ, 说话 shuōhuà, 星期六早上 xīngqīliù zǎoshang | Ôn: 星期六 xīngqīliù, 星期天 xīngqītiān, 明天 míngtiān, 八点 bā diǎn, 昨天 zuótiān, 长寿面 chángshòumiàn
zh.cum: Mới: 星期六早上 xīngqīliù zǎoshang / 明天早上 míngtiān zǎoshang / 每天 měitiān / 说汉语 shuō Hànyǔ / 不说话 bù shuōhuà | Ôn: 星期天 xīngqītiān
zh.cau: 星期六，我八点起床。(Xīngqīliù, wǒ bā diǎn qǐchuáng.) / 你几点睡觉？(Nǐ jǐ diǎn shuìjiào?) / 明天星期天。(Míngtiān xīngqītiān.) / [Ngữ pháp: 每天 đứng trước động từ] 我每天和同学说汉语。(Wǒ měitiān hé tóngxué shuō Hànyǔ.)
zh.truyen: 星期六早上 — 今天星期六。Xiaomei八点起床。她和妈妈说汉语。妈妈说：“吃早饭的时候不说话。”明天星期天，明天早上Xiaomei九点起床。(Jīntiān xīngqīliù. Xiaomei bā diǎn qǐchuáng. Tā hé māma shuō Hànyǔ. Māma shuō: “Chī zǎofàn de shíhou bù shuōhuà.” Míngtiān xīngqītiān, míngtiān zǎoshang Xiaomei jiǔ diǎn qǐchuáng.)

en.flash: Ôn: Saturday morning, tomorrow morning, every day, phone, tablet, radio, get up, wash, breakfast, lunch, go to school (nghe)
en.slide: 1) Thời gian biểu ngày thường và cuối tuần: nhìn hai đồng hồ, chọn câu đúng (4 câu): On Monday, I get up at seven o'clock. / On Saturday, I get up at eight o'clock. / On Sunday, I get up at nine o'clock. / Every day, I brush my teeth. 2) Trò Đồng hồ giấy: nghe câu, con quay kim – I eat lunch at twelve o'clock. / I go to sleep at nine o'clock. 3) Âm -s / -es: gets, washes, brushes – nghe và chọn.
en.truyen: Xiaomei's Timetable — On Monday, Xiaomei gets up at seven o'clock. She washes her face and eats breakfast. She goes to school at eight o'clock. At noon, she eats lunch. On Saturday morning, she gets up at eight o'clock and listens to the radio. In the evening, she goes to sleep at nine o'clock.
en.baihat: Limerick: At nine o'clock I go to bed, / I close my eyes and rest my head. (bed – head) · Hát cả bài: Time to Get Up (giai điệu: Frère Jacques – dân gian Pháp, mỗi dòng hát 2 lần) — đoạn Sáng: Time to get up! / It's seven! / Wash your face, eat breakfast, / Go to school! (vươn vai, rửa mặt, đeo cặp) / đoạn Tối: Time to sleep now! / It's nine! / Close your eyes, good night now, / Sleep, sleep, sleep! (áp má vào tay, nhắm mắt)

zh.flash: Ôn: 每天 měitiān, 汉语 Hànyǔ, 说话 shuōhuà, 星期六早上 xīngqīliù zǎoshang, 起床 qǐchuáng, 洗脸 xǐ liǎn, 早饭 zǎofàn, 午饭 wǔfàn, 上学 shàngxué
zh.slide: 1) Thanh điệu: 早 zǎo (3), 起床 qǐchuáng (3–2), 睡觉 shuìjiào (4–4) – nghe chọn đúng. 2) Nghe thời gian biểu của Xiaomei, quay kim đồng hồ giấy (4 câu): 星期一，她七点起床。/ 她八点去上学。/ 星期六早上，她八点起床。/ 她晚上九点睡觉。 3) Tô 口: việc dùng miệng thì chữ có 口 – tìm 口 trong 吃, 喝 (3 nét: sổ, ngang gập, ngang).
zh.truyen: Xiaomei的时间表 — 星期一，Xiaomei早上七点起床。她洗脸，吃早饭。她八点去上学。中午，她吃午饭。星期六早上，她八点起床。晚上，她九点睡觉。(Xīngqīyī, Xiaomei zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng. Tā xǐ liǎn, chī zǎofàn. Tā bā diǎn qù shàngxué. Zhōngwǔ, tā chī wǔfàn. Xīngqīliù zǎoshang, tā bā diǎn qǐchuáng. Wǎnshang, tā jiǔ diǎn shuìjiào.)
zh.baihat: Limerick: 早上七点起得早，八点上学心情好！(Zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐ de zǎo, bā diǎn shàngxué xīnqíng hǎo!) (zǎo – hǎo) · Hát cả bài: 快起床啦 (giai điệu: Frère Jacques) — đoạn Sáng: 快起床啦！/ 七点了！/ 洗洗脸吃早饭，/ 去上学！(Kuài qǐchuáng la! / Qī diǎn le! / Xǐxi liǎn chī zǎofàn, / qù shàngxué!) / đoạn Tối: 该睡觉啦！/ 九点了！/ 闭上眼睛晚安，/ 睡觉觉！(Gāi shuìjiào la! / Jiǔ diǎn le! / Bì shang yǎnjing wǎn'ān, / shuì jiàojiào!)

zh.cum: Ôn: 六点吃晚饭 liù diǎn chī wǎnfàn / 九点睡觉 jiǔ diǎn shuìjiào / 去上学 qù shàngxué / 做作业 zuò zuòyè
zh.cau: 我晚上六点吃晚饭。(Wǒ wǎnshang liù diǎn chī wǎnfàn.) / 你几点吃晚饭？(Nǐ jǐ diǎn chī wǎnfàn?) / [Ngữ pháp: 他 + giờ + việc làm] 他八点去上学。(Tā bā diǎn qù shàngxué.)
zh.truyen: Leo的一天 — Leo早上七点起床。他洗脸，吃早饭。他八点去上学。他中午十二点吃午饭。晚上，他六点吃晚饭，九点睡觉。(Leo zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng. Tā xǐ liǎn, chī zǎofàn. Tā bā diǎn qù shàngxué. Tā zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn chī wǔfàn. Wǎnshang, tā liù diǎn chī wǎnfàn, jiǔ diǎn shuìjiào.)

en.truyen: Leo's Day (2) — Leo gets up at seven o'clock in the morning. He washes his face and eats breakfast. He goes to school at eight o'clock. He eats lunch at twelve o'clock. In the evening, he eats dinner at six o'clock and sleeps at nine o'clock. On Saturday, Leo gets up at eight o'clock.

(vươn vai, rửa mặt, đeo cặp) / đoạn Tối: Time to sleep now! / It's nine! / Close your eyes, good night now, / Sleep, sleep, sleep! en.cau: What is your hobby? / [Ngữ pháp: like + V-ing] I like singing. / My favourite hobby is drawing. / I can draw a beautiful picture.

zh.cau: 你的爱好是什么？(Nǐ de àihào shì shénme?) / [Ngữ pháp: 喜欢 + việc làm, không đổi hình thức] 我喜欢唱歌。(Wǒ xǐhuan chànggē.) / 我会画画。(Wǒ huì huàhuà.)
zh.truyen: 我的爱好 — 老师：Bông，你的爱好是什么？Bông：我喜欢画画。你看我的画！老师：真好看！Anna：我喜欢唱歌。Leo：我喜欢跳舞，很开心！Xiaomei：我喜欢看书。(Lǎoshī: Bông, nǐ de àihào shì shénme? Bông: Wǒ xǐhuan huàhuà. Nǐ kàn wǒ de huà! Lǎoshī: Zhēn hǎokàn! Anna: Wǒ xǐhuan chànggē. Leo: Wǒ xǐhuan tiàowǔ, hěn kāixīn! Xiaomei: Wǒ xǐhuan kàn shū.)

zh.cau: 今天星期几？今天星期一。(Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? Jīntiān xīngqīyī.) / 现在是几月？现在十月。(Xiànzài shì jǐ yuè? Xiànzài shíyuè.) / 现在几点？现在两点。(Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Xiànzài liǎng diǎn.)
zh.truyen: 今天星期几？— Bông：今天星期几？Xiaomei：今天星期天！妈妈：不对，今天星期一。你看日历。Bông：现在几点？妈妈：现在七点。Bông：哎呀！(Bông: Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? Xiaomei: Jīntiān xīngqītiān! Māma: Bú duì, jīntiān xīngqīyī. Nǐ kàn rìlì. Bông: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Māma: Xiànzài qī diǎn. Bông: Āiyā!)
zh.video: 星期歌 – KidsMusicTime – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NWKDy67BbwA

web.label: Ngày 38. Ôn chặng 1 (Unit 1–4) · Quét Unit 2: ngày, sinh nhật

en.tu: Ôn: yesterday, today, tomorrow, 3rd, 8th, when, say, date, card, present, candle, China, long, kite, robot, guitar, football
en.cum: Ôn: what's the date / the 3rd / make a card / a birthday present / long noodles / in China / Happy birthday!
en.cau: What's the date today? It's the 3rd. / When is your birthday? My birthday is June 8th. / Today is Tuesday, December 3rd. / In China, we eat long noodles on birthdays.
en.truyen: Anna's Birthday — Today is Tuesday, December 3rd. Tomorrow is Anna's birthday. Anna's birthday is December 4th. Bông makes a card. Xiaomei says: "In China, we eat long noodles on birthdays!" Bông: Happy birthday, Anna! Anna: Thank you!
en.video: When is your birthday? – Loonytricky – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4NGo0iMis-c

zh.tu: Ôn: 昨天 zuótiān, 今天 jīntiān, 明天 míngtiān, 日 rì, 几号 jǐ hào, 多少 duōshao, 告诉 gàosu, 时候 shíhou, 做 zuò, 中国 Zhōngguó, 卡片 kǎpiàn, 长寿面 chángshòumiàn, 礼物 lǐwù
zh.cum: Ôn: 今天几号 jīntiān jǐ hào / 做卡片 zuò kǎpiàn / 生日快乐 shēngrì kuàilè / 过生日的时候 guò shēngrì de shíhou / 吃长寿面 chī chángshòumiàn
zh.cau: 今天几号？今天三号。(Jīntiān jǐ hào? Jīntiān sān hào.) / 你的生日是几月几号？我的生日是六月八号。(Nǐ de shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? Wǒ de shēngrì shì liùyuè bā hào.) / 在中国，过生日的时候我们吃长寿面。(Zài Zhōngguó, guò shēngrì de shíhou wǒmen chī chángshòumiàn.)
zh.truyen: Anna的生日 — 今天星期二，十二月三号。明天是Anna的生日。Anna的生日是十二月四号。Bông做了一张卡片。Xiaomei说：“在中国，过生日的时候我们吃长寿面！”(Jīntiān xīngqī'èr, shí'èryuè sān hào. Míngtiān shì Anna de shēngrì. Anna de shēngrì shì shí'èryuè sì hào. Bông zuòle yì zhāng kǎpiàn. Xiaomei shuō: “Zài Zhōngguó, guò shēngrì de shíhou wǒmen chī chángshòumiàn!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "生日快乐 儿歌 几月几号"

en.flash: Ôn Unit 1–2: Monday – Sunday, weekend, January, March, June, October, December, month, calendar, clock, o'clock, yesterday, tomorrow, 3rd, 8th, when, card, present, candle, China, long
en.slide: Kiểm tra chặng 1 – phần 1 (Unit 1–2), dạng Starters/YCT2: 1) Nghe và chọn tranh (6 câu): It's Thursday. / It's October. / It's two o'clock. / It's the 3rd today. / Bông makes a card. / There are six candles. 2) Nhìn lịch và đồng hồ, viết từ (chép từ có gợi ý, 4 câu): Monday / June / seven o'clock / birthday. 3) Nói (từng con với cô): What day is it today? / When is your birthday? / What time is it?
en.truyen: Bông's Busy Week — On Monday, Bông goes to school at eight o'clock. On Wednesday, December 3rd, she makes a card. Tomorrow is Anna's birthday! On Thursday, December 4th, the friends eat cake and long noodles. On Saturday, they play by the pool. It's the weekend!
en.baihat: Ôn liên khúc: Seven Days đoạn Thứ (giai điệu: Oh My Darling, Clementine): Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, / Friday, Saturday and Sunday, / Seven days and then again, / What day is it? It is Monday! + When Is Your Birthday? đoạn Hỏi (giai điệu: For He's a Jolly Good Fellow): When is your birthday, my friend? (×3) / Tell me the month and the day!

zh.flash: Ôn Unit 1–2: 星期一 – 星期天 xīngqīyī – xīngqītiān, 星期日 xīngqīrì, 一月 yīyuè, 十二月 shí'èryuè, 年 nián, 日历 rìlì, 时间 shíjiān, 两点 liǎng diǎn, 分钟 fēnzhōng, 昨天 zuótiān, 几号 jǐ hào, 多少 duōshao, 告诉 gàosu, 时候 shíhou, 做 zuò, 中国 Zhōngguó, 卡片 kǎpiàn, 日 rì, 长寿面 chángshòumiàn
zh.slide: Kiểm tra chặng 1 – phần 1 (Unit 1–2), dạng YCT2: 1) Nghe và phán đoán đúng – sai với tranh (5 câu): 今天星期三。/ 现在两点。/ 现在十月。/ 今天三号。/ Bông做了一张卡片。 2) Nghe và chọn tranh (3 câu): 我的生日是六月八号。/ 在中国，过生日吃长寿面。/ 你看日历。 3) Nói: 今天星期几？/ 你的生日是几月几号？/ 现在几点？; bẫy: 二点 hay 两点? 星期七 có không?
zh.truyen: Bông很忙的一个星期 — 星期一，Bông八点去学校。星期三，十二月三号，她做卡片。明天是Anna的生日！星期四，十二月四号，朋友们一起吃蛋糕和长寿面。星期六，他们一起玩。今天不上学！(Xīngqīyī, Bông bā diǎn qù xuéxiào. Xīngqīsān, shí'èryuè sān hào, tā zuò kǎpiàn. Míngtiān shì Anna de shēngrì! Xīngqīsì, shí'èryuè sì hào, péngyoumen yìqǐ chī dàngāo hé chángshòumiàn. Xīngqīliù, tāmen yìqǐ wán. Jīntiān bú shàngxué!)
zh.baihat: Ôn liên khúc: 一个星期七天 đoạn Thứ: 星期一二三四五，星期六和星期天，一个星期有七天，今天星期几？星期一！(Xīngqī yī èr sān sì wǔ, xīngqīliù hé xīngqītiān, yí gè xīngqī yǒu qī tiān, jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? Xīngqīyī!) + 你的生日是几月几号？đoạn Đáp: 我的生日是六月八号（×3），六月八号，好呀！(Wǒ de shēngrì shì liùyuè bā hào ×3, liùyuè bā hào, hǎo ya!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 20. Ôn chặng 1 (Unit 1–4) · Kiểm tra phần 2: Unit 3–4 (một ngày của em, sở thích) và trình bày

web.label: Ngày 39. Ôn chặng 1 (Unit 1–4) · Quét Unit 3: một ngày của em

en.tu: Ôn: get up, wake up, wash, face, breakfast, noon, lunch, brush, teeth, cup, evening, dinner, bath, sleep, go to sleep, school, homework, room, take, way
en.cum: Ôn: get up at seven / wash my face / eat breakfast / eat lunch at twelve / go to sleep at nine / do my homework / it takes twenty minutes
en.cau: I get up at seven o'clock in the morning. / What time do you go to sleep? / I sleep at nine o'clock in the evening. / Leo does his homework in his room.
en.truyen: Leo's Day — Leo gets up at seven o'clock in the morning. He washes his face and eats breakfast. He goes to school at eight o'clock. He eats lunch at twelve o'clock. In the evening, he eats dinner at six o'clock and sleeps at nine o'clock.
en.video: This Is The Way – Morning Routines Song – Fun Kids English – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9ji9K20U6ms

zh.tu: Ôn: 起床 qǐchuáng, 洗脸 xǐ liǎn, 早饭 zǎofàn, 早上 zǎoshang, 中午 zhōngwǔ, 午饭 wǔfàn, 晚上 wǎnshang, 吃晚饭 chī wǎnfàn, 睡觉 shuìjiào, 上学 shàngxué, 房间 fángjiān, 同学 tóngxué, 汉语 Hànyǔ, 说话 shuōhuà, 先 xiān, 铅笔 qiānbǐ
zh.cum: Ôn: 早上七点起床 zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng / 吃早饭 chī zǎofàn / 中午吃午饭 zhōngwǔ chī wǔfàn / 晚上九点睡觉 wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn shuìjiào / 先刷牙 xiān shuā yá
zh.cau: 我早上七点起床。(Wǒ zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng.) / 你几点睡觉？(Nǐ jǐ diǎn shuìjiào?) / 我先洗脸，再吃早饭。(Wǒ xiān xǐ liǎn, zài chī zǎofàn.) / Leo在房间做作业。(Leo zài fángjiān zuò zuòyè.)
zh.truyen: Leo的一天 — Leo早上七点起床。他洗脸，吃早饭。他八点去上学。他中午十二点吃午饭。晚上，他六点吃晚饭，九点睡觉。(Leo zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng. Tā xǐ liǎn, chī zǎofàn. Tā bā diǎn qù shàngxué. Tā zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn chī wǔfàn. Wǎnshang, tā liù diǎn chī wǎnfàn, jiǔ diǎn shuìjiào.)
zh.video: The Routine Song 作息歌 – Cool Panda Chinese Learning – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bwe270KKULY

web.label: Ngày 40. Ôn chặng 1 (Unit 1–4) · Quét Unit 4: sở thích; ôn trộn Unit 1–4

en.tu: Ôn: hobby, read, sing, dance, draw, drawing, picture, cook, watch, TV, listen, music, talent, comic, piano, bike, ride, catch, board game
en.cum: Ôn: like singing / watch TV in the evening / listen to music on Saturday / ride a bike / Talent Day / with my friend
en.cau: What is your hobby? I like drawing. / Leo likes dancing. / I don't like cooking. / On Sunday, at ten o'clock, I play a board game with my friend.
en.truyen: Talent Day — It's Talent Day! It's Friday, June 8th. At nine o'clock, Leo dances. Anna sings. Bông draws a picture. Xiaomei reads a comic. In the evening, they eat dinner and listen to music. What is your hobby?
en.video: What Do You Like To Do? – Finny The Shark – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YhBjeHg_wTw

zh.tu: Ôn: 爱好 àihào, 看书 kàn shū, 阅读 yuèdú, 唱歌 chànggē, 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 画 huà, 做饭 zuòfàn, 电视 diànshì, 听 tīng, 音乐 yīnyuè, 游戏 yóuxì, 才艺 cáiyì, 打电话 dǎ diànhuà, 觉得 juéde
zh.cum: Ôn: 你的爱好是什么 nǐ de àihào shì shénme / 喜欢唱歌 xǐhuan chànggē / 看电视 kàn diànshì / 听音乐 tīng yīnyuè / 玩游戏 wán yóuxì / 我觉得很好玩 wǒ juéde hěn hǎowán
zh.cau: 你的爱好是什么？我喜欢画画。(Nǐ de àihào shì shénme? Wǒ xǐhuan huàhuà.) / Leo喜欢跳舞。(Leo xǐhuan tiàowǔ.) / 我不喜欢做饭。(Wǒ bù xǐhuan zuòfàn.) / 星期天十点，我和朋友玩游戏。(Xīngqītiān shí diǎn, wǒ hé péngyou wán yóuxì.)
zh.truyen: 才艺日 — 今天是才艺日！星期五，六月八号。九点，Leo跳舞，Anna唱歌，Bông画画，Xiaomei看书。晚上，他们吃晚饭，听音乐。你的爱好是什么？(Jīntiān shì cáiyì rì! Xīngqīwǔ, liùyuè bā hào. Jiǔ diǎn, Leo tiàowǔ, Anna chànggē, Bông huàhuà, Xiaomei kàn shū. Wǎnshang, tāmen chī wǎnfàn, tīng yīnyuè. Nǐ de àihào shì shénme?)
zh.video: 我的爱好 – Hobbies in Chinese – Sunshine Corner – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TxB6Fk3BdnA

en.flash: Ôn Unit 3–4 và trộn Unit 1–4: get up, wash, face, breakfast, lunch, dinner, evening, sleep, school, homework, hobby, read, sing, dance, draw, cook, watch, TV, listen, music, bike, ride, Monday, June, o'clock, birthday
en.slide: Kiểm tra chặng 1 – phần 2 (Unit 3–4), dạng Starters: 1) Nghe và nối tên với tranh (5 bạn): Leo – gets up at seven / Anna – sings / Bông – draws / Xiaomei – reads / Mom – cooks. 2) Đọc và chọn Yes / No (5 câu) theo tranh thời gian biểu: Leo eats lunch at twelve o'clock. / Anna goes to sleep at six o'clock. … 3) Nói theo tranh dải 3 ô (dự án nhỏ): con kể một ngày của mình – I get up at… On Saturday, I like… My birthday is in…
en.truyen: My Day, My Hobby — Bông gets up at seven o'clock on Monday. She washes her face and eats breakfast. She goes to school at eight o'clock. In the evening, she does her homework in her room. On Saturday, she rides her bike and draws a picture. Her birthday is in March. What about you?
en.baihat: Ôn liên khúc: Time to Get Up đoạn Sáng (giai điệu: Frère Jacques): Time to get up! / It's seven! / Wash your face, eat breakfast, / Go to school! + What Is Your Hobby? đoạn Hát (giai điệu: Did You Ever See a Lassie?): What is your hobby, your hobby, your hobby? / What is your hobby? / I like singing, la la!

zh.flash: Ôn Unit 3–4 và trộn Unit 1–4: 起床 qǐchuáng, 洗脸 xǐ liǎn, 早饭 zǎofàn, 午饭 wǔfàn, 吃晚饭 chī wǎnfàn, 睡觉 shuìjiào, 上学 shàngxué, 房间 fángjiān, 爱好 àihào, 看书 kàn shū, 唱歌 chànggē, 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 画 huà, 电视 diànshì, 音乐 yīnyuè, 星期六 xīngqīliù, 六月 liùyuè, 生日 shēngrì
zh.slide: Kiểm tra chặng 1 – phần 2 (Unit 3–4), dạng YCT2: 1) Nghe và chọn tranh (5 câu): 我早上七点起床。/ 他中午吃午饭。/ 我晚上九点睡觉。/ Anna喜欢唱歌。/ 我不喜欢看电视。 2) Đọc có pinyin, nối câu hỏi – câu trả lời (4 cặp): 你几点起床？– 七点。/ 你的爱好是什么？– 我喜欢画画。/ 今天星期几？– 星期五。/ 你的生日是几月几号？– 三月一号。 3) Chữ Hán: nhận và chép 日 月 天 星 早 口 看 目 (chọn 4 chữ chép vào ô).
zh.truyen: 我的一天，我的爱好 — 星期一，Bông早上七点起床。她洗脸，吃早饭。她八点去上学。晚上，她在房间做作业。星期六，她骑自行车，画画。她的生日是三月。你呢？(Xīngqīyī, Bông zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng. Tā xǐ liǎn, chī zǎofàn. Tā bā diǎn qù shàngxué. Wǎnshang, tā zài fángjiān zuò zuòyè. Xīngqīliù, tā qí zìxíngchē, huàhuà. Tā de shēngrì shì sānyuè. Nǐ ne?)
zh.baihat: Ôn liên khúc: 快起床啦 đoạn Sáng: 快起床啦！七点了！洗洗脸吃早饭，去上学！(Kuài qǐchuáng la! Qī diǎn le! Xǐxi liǎn chī zǎofàn, qù shàngxué!) + 你的爱好是什么？đoạn Hát: 你的爱好是什么？是什么？是什么？你的爱好是什么？我喜欢唱歌！(Nǐ de àihào shì shénme? Shì shénme? Shì shénme? Nǐ de àihào shì shénme? Wǒ xǐhuan chànggē!)

blocks.title: Unit 5 · Places in town · 地方

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 21. Unit 5 · Places in town · 地方 – Hiểu: nơi chốn trong thành phố, đi đâu; tô 家

web.label: Ngày 41. Unit 5 · Nơi chốn 1: nhà, trường, công viên, sở thú, cửa hàng

en.tu: Mới: place, home, park, zoo, shop, store | Ôn: school, homework, way, all
en.cum: go home / go to school / go to the park / go to the zoo / a shop (UK) = a store (US)
en.cau: Where are you going? / I go to the park. / [Ngữ pháp: go home không có to] I go home. / Let's go to the zoo! / [Ngữ pháp: shop (UK) – store (US)] This place is a shop. In the US, it is a store.
en.truyen: Where Are You Going? — Leo: Where are you going, Xiaomei? Xiaomei: I go to the park. Leo: I go to the zoo! Bông: I go home. Goodbye, all!
en.video: Where Are You Going? Places Song – Fun Kids English – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FxRGkjkVTGA

zh.tu: Mới: 地方 dìfang, 家 jiā, 公园 gōngyuán, 动物园 dòngwùyuán | Ôn: 学校 xuéxiào, 商店 shāngdiàn, 一起 yìqǐ, 同学 tóngxué
zh.cum: 回家 huí jiā / 去学校 qù xuéxiào / 去公园 qù gōngyuán / 去动物园 qù dòngwùyuán
zh.cau: 你去哪儿？(Nǐ qù nǎr?) / 我去公园。(Wǒ qù gōngyuán.) / [Ngữ pháp: về nhà là 回家, không nói 去家] 我回家。(Wǒ huí jiā.) / 我和同学一起去动物园。(Wǒ hé tóngxué yìqǐ qù dòngwùyuán.)
zh.truyen: 你去哪儿？ — Leo：Xiaomei，你去哪儿？Xiaomei：我去公园。Leo：我去动物园！Bông：我回家。再见！（Leo: Xiaomei, nǐ qù nǎr? Xiaomei: Wǒ qù gōngyuán. Leo: Wǒ qù dòngwùyuán! Bông: Wǒ huí jiā. Zàijiàn!）
zh.video: 地方 Places Part 1 – Little Chinese Learners – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XAeEErUCojk

web.label: Ngày 42. Unit 5 · Nơi chốn 2: nhà hàng, rạp chiếu phim, thư viện, bệnh viện

en.tu: Mới: restaurant, cinema, library, hospital | Ôn: shop, store, park, write, understand
en.cum: go to the restaurant / go to the cinema / go to the library / a hospital on my street / a bookshop on my street
en.cau: Where is the library? It's on my street. / There is a cinema on my street. / [Ngữ pháp: go to the + nơi chốn] I go to the library. / Is it a hospital? No, it's a restaurant.
en.truyen: My Street — This is my street. There is a shop, a bookshop and a restaurant. There is a library, too. The cinema is big. The hospital is white.
en.video: Where Are You Going? Places Song – English Tree – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bp8wUmETBYU

zh.tu: Mới: 饭店 fàndiàn, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn, 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 门 mén | Ôn: 学校 xuéxiào, 商店 shāngdiàn, 汉语 Hànyǔ, 铅笔 qiānbǐ
zh.cum: 去饭店 qù fàndiàn / 去电影院 qù diànyǐngyuàn / 去图书馆 qù túshūguǎn / 去商店 qù shāngdiàn / 学校的门 xuéxiào de mén
zh.cau: 图书馆在哪儿？(Túshūguǎn zài nǎr?) / 我去图书馆。(Wǒ qù túshūguǎn.) / [Ngữ pháp: 是 / 不是] 这是饭店，不是商店。(Zhè shì fàndiàn, bú shì shāngdiàn.) / 这是学校的门。(Zhè shì xuéxiào de mén.)
zh.truyen: 这是什么地方？ — 这是学校，这是学校的门。这是饭店，不是商店。这是电影院。Bông去图书馆。（Zhè shì xuéxiào, zhè shì xuéxiào de mén. Zhè shì fàndiàn, bú shì shāngdiàn. Zhè shì diànyǐngyuàn. Bông qù túshūguǎn.）
zh.video: 你在家吗 Are You Home? – Little Chinese Learners – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VWLq7lY49F0

en.flash: place, home, park, zoo, shop, store, restaurant, cinema, library, hospital | Ôn: school, homework
en.slide: 1) Bản đồ thành phố trống: nghe tên, dán 6 nơi lên bản đồ: home / school / shop / park / restaurant / zoo. 2) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (6 câu): cinema / library / hospital / park / zoo / shop. 3) Trò Bản đồ trên sàn: cô nói "Go to the library!", "Go home!", con chạy đến đúng thẻ; con hỏi – đáp: Where are you going? – I go to the park.
en.truyen: Leo's Picture — Leo draws a picture of his town. "This is my home. This is my school. This is the park." Bông: "Where are you going, Leo?" Leo: "I go to the zoo!"
en.baihat: Where Are You Going? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — đoạn Park: Where are you going? / To the park! / I go to the park to play. / Play, play, play! · đoạn Home: Where are you going? / I am going home! / I am going home, going home. / Home, home, home! · Vè: Home, school, shop and park, I go home before it's dark!

zh.flash: 地方 dìfang, 家 jiā, 公园 gōngyuán, 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 饭店 fàndiàn, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn, 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 门 mén | Ôn: 学校 xuéxiào, 商店 shāngdiàn
zh.slide: 1) Nghe – chạm (6 câu): 家 / 学校 / 商店 / 公园 / 饭店 / 动物园. 2) Đúng hay sai: "go home" = 去家? (sai) → 回家 (đúng); "go to school" = 去学校 (đúng). 3) Tô 家: mái nhà 宀 và chú lợn 豕, 10 nét theo thứ tự (chấm, chấm, ngang móc; ngang, phẩy, cong móc, phẩy, phẩy, phẩy, mác).
zh.truyen: Leo的画 — Leo画他的家。“这是我家，这是学校，这是公园。”Bông：“Leo，你去哪儿？”Leo：“我去动物园！”（Leo huà tā de jiā. “Zhè shì wǒ jiā, zhè shì xuéxiào, zhè shì gōngyuán.” Bông: “Leo, nǐ qù nǎr?” Leo: “Wǒ qù dòngwùyuán!”）
zh.baihat: 你去哪儿？(giai điệu Frère Jacques) — đoạn Park: 你去哪儿？/ 去公园！/ 我去公园玩。/ 玩，玩，玩！ · đoạn Home: 你去哪儿？/ 我回家！/ 我回家，我回家。/ 家，家，家！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 22. Unit 5 · Places in town · 地方 – Hiểu: đi đâu để làm gì; chép 家, tô 门

web.label: Ngày 43. Unit 5 · Đi để làm gì 1: học, chơi, mua đồ

en.tu: Mới: study, English, play, buy, thing | Ôn (nối Unit 4): read, draw, music, comic, computer
en.cum: buy things / study English / play with friends / read comics at the library / play in the playground
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: to + việc làm] I go to the shop to buy things. / I go to the library to study English. / I go to the park to play with my friends. / I go to the library to read comics.
en.truyen: Anna's Things — Anna goes to the shop to buy things. She buys a comic. She goes to the library to study English. Then she plays with her friends in the playground.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "I go to the shop to buy kids song places and actions"

zh.tu: Mới: 学习 xuéxí, 玩 wán, 买 mǎi, 东西 dōngxi | Ôn (nối Unit 4): 看书 kàn shū, 画 huà, 唱歌 chànggē, 音乐 yīnyuè, 游戏 yóuxì
zh.cum: 买东西 mǎi dōngxi / 学习汉语 xuéxí Hànyǔ / 和朋友玩 hé péngyou wán / 去图书馆看书 qù túshūguǎn kàn shū
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: nơi chốn + việc làm liền nhau] 我去商店买东西。(Wǒ qù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi.) / 我去学校学习汉语。(Wǒ qù xuéxiào xuéxí Hànyǔ.) / 我去公园和朋友玩。(Wǒ qù gōngyuán hé péngyou wán.) / 我去图书馆看书。(Wǒ qù túshūguǎn kàn shū.)
zh.truyen: Anna买东西 — Anna去商店买东西。她买书和铅笔。她去图书馆看书。她去公园和朋友玩游戏。（Anna qù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi. Tā mǎi shū hé qiānbǐ. Tā qù túshūguǎn kàn shū. Tā qù gōngyuán hé péngyou wán yóuxì.）
zh.video: 你去哪里？Where are you going? – Coolong Chinese – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bh013yaanCo

web.label: Ngày 44. Unit 5 · Đi để làm gì 2: ăn, xem, đi dạo; trước – sau

en.tu: Mới: eat, see, walk, first, then, also | Ôn (nối Unit 4): ride, bike, watch, TV, sing, dance
en.cum: eat dinner / see animals / take a walk / ride my bike in the park / first … then …
en.cau: I go to the zoo to see animals. / [Ngữ pháp: first – then] First, I go to the shop. Then, I go to the park. / I go to the park to ride my bike. I also take a walk. / First, we eat dinner. Then, we watch TV.
en.truyen: Bông's Sunday — First, Bông goes to the park to take a walk. Then, she goes to the zoo to see animals. She also sings and dances with her friends. Then, she goes home to eat dinner.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "first then sequencing song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 散步 sànbù, 然后 ránhòu, 都 dōu | Ôn (nối Unit 4): 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 电视 diànshì, 听 tīng, 做饭 zuòfàn | Ôn: 先 xiān, 吃 chī, 看 kàn
zh.cum: 吃晚饭 chī wǎnfàn / 看动物 kàn dòngwù / 去公园散步 qù gōngyuán sànbù / 先……然后…… xiān……ránhòu……
zh.cau: 我去动物园看动物。(Wǒ qù dòngwùyuán kàn dòngwù.) / [Ngữ pháp: 先……然后……] 我先去商店，然后去公园。(Wǒ xiān qù shāngdiàn, ránhòu qù gōngyuán.) / [Ngữ pháp: 都] Leo和Bông都去公园散步。(Leo hé Bông dōu qù gōngyuán sànbù.) / 我回家吃晚饭，然后看电视。(Wǒ huí jiā chī wǎnfàn, ránhòu kàn diànshì.)
zh.truyen: Bông的星期天 — Bông先去公园散步。然后，她去动物园看动物。她和朋友唱歌、跳舞。然后，她回家吃晚饭。（Bông xiān qù gōngyuán sànbù. Ránhòu, tā qù dòngwùyuán kàn dòngwù. Tā hé péngyou chànggē, tiàowǔ. Ránhòu, tā huí jiā chī wǎnfàn.）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "去公园 散步 儿歌 动画"

en.flash: study, English, play, buy, thing, eat, see, walk, first, then, also | Ôn: read, ride, bike, watch, park, shop
en.slide: 1) Trò Đi đâu, làm gì: mỗi con giữ một thẻ nơi chốn, tìm bạn giữ thẻ việc làm đúng (shop – buy things / zoo – see animals / library – study English / park – play with friends). 2) Đối chiếu NL9: I go to the park to play. ↔ 我去公园玩。 – con chạm vào chữ "to" ở câu tiếng Anh. 3) Xếp 2 tranh theo thứ tự rồi nói: First, I go to the shop. Then, I go to the park.
en.truyen: Xiaomei at the Library — Xiaomei goes to the library to study English. She also reads comics. Then she goes to the shop to buy things. First she buys a pencil. Then she buys a book. She goes home to eat dinner.
en.baihat: Where Are You Going? — đoạn Shop: Where are you going? / To the shop! / I go to the shop to buy things. / Buy, buy, buy! · ôn đoạn Park: Where are you going? / To the park! / I go to the park to play. / Play, play, play!

zh.flash: 学习 xuéxí, 玩 wán, 买 mǎi, 东西 dōngxi, 散步 sànbù, 然后 ránhòu | Ôn: 看书 kàn shū, 吃 chī, 看 kàn, 先 xiān
zh.slide: 1) Nối nơi với việc: 公园 – 玩 / 商店 – 买东西 / 动物园 – 看动物 / 学校 – 学习. 2) Xếp câu: 我 / 去 / 商店 / 买东西 → 我去商店买东西。(phương án nhiễu: 我商店买东西 thiếu 去; 我买东西去商店 đảo trật tự). 3) Chép 家 vào ô; tô 门 3 nét: chấm, sổ, ngang gập móc (cánh cổng trường, cổng công viên).
zh.truyen: Xiaomei去图书馆 — Xiaomei去图书馆学习汉语。她也看书。然后，她去商店买东西。她先买铅笔，然后买书。她回家吃晚饭。（Xiaomei qù túshūguǎn xuéxí Hànyǔ. Tā yě kàn shū. Ránhòu, tā qù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi. Tā xiān mǎi qiānbǐ, ránhòu mǎi shū. Tā huí jiā chī wǎnfàn.）
zh.baihat: 你去哪儿？— đoạn Shop: 你去哪儿？/ 去商店！/ 我去商店买东西。/ 买，买，买！ · Vè ZH: 去公园，玩一玩；去商店，看一看；去饭店，吃晚饭；回家回家，家最暖！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 23. Unit 5 · Places in town · 地方 – Làm quen: thời gian + nơi + việc; truyện Leo's Saturday; nói theo vần; chép 门

web.label: Ngày 45. Unit 5 · Thời gian + nơi chốn + việc làm (nhóm 3, nối Unit 1, 3)

en.tu: Mới: afternoon, busy, dark, part | Ôn: morning, evening, week, Monday, Saturday, Sunday, family
en.cum: on Monday morning / on Saturday evening / on Sunday afternoon / every day / before it's dark / a busy part of town / play in the sand
en.cau: On Monday morning, I go to school to study. / On Saturday evening, my family goes to the restaurant to eat dinner. / On Sunday afternoon, I go to the park to play with my friends. / [Ngữ pháp: every / before] Every evening, I go home before it's dark. / This part of town is busy.
en.truyen: A Busy Afternoon — On Sunday afternoon, the park is busy. Leo plays in the sand in the playground. He sees a shell in the sand. At five o'clock, Leo goes home before it's dark.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "morning afternoon evening song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 上午 shàngwǔ, 下午 xiàwǔ, 家人 jiārén, 人 rén, 零 líng | Ôn: 早上 zǎoshang, 晚上 wǎnshang, 星期 xīngqī, 月 yuè, 数字 shùzì
zh.cum: 星期一早上 xīngqīyī zǎoshang / 星期六晚上 xīngqīliù wǎnshang / 星期天上午 xīngqītiān shàngwǔ / 一个人 yí ge rén / 两点零五分 liǎng diǎn líng wǔ fēn
zh.cau: 星期一早上，我去学校学习。(Xīngqīyī zǎoshang, wǒ qù xuéxiào xuéxí.) / 星期六晚上，我的家人去饭店吃晚饭。(Xīngqīliù wǎnshang, wǒ de jiārén qù fàndiàn chī wǎnfàn.) / 星期天下午，我去公园和朋友玩。(Xīngqītiān xiàwǔ, wǒ qù gōngyuán hé péngyou wán.) / [Ngữ pháp: 都 + động từ] 我的家人都去饭店。(Wǒ de jiārén dōu qù fàndiàn.) / Leo不是一个人去，他和朋友去。(Leo bú shì yí ge rén qù, tā hé péngyou qù.)
zh.truyen: 星期天下午 — 星期天下午，公园里人很多。两点零五分，Leo和家人去公园。Leo不是一个人，他和朋友玩。晚上，他们都回家吃晚饭。（Xīngqītiān xiàwǔ, gōngyuán lǐ rén hěn duō. Liǎng diǎn líng wǔ fēn, Leo hé jiārén qù gōngyuán. Leo bú shì yí ge rén, tā hé péngyou wán. Wǎnshang, tāmen dōu huí jiā chī wǎnfàn.）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "上午 下午 晚上 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 46. Unit 5 · Ôn không tranh, vòng Từ vựng + truyện 1 My week

en.tu: Ôn (không tranh): place, home, park, zoo, shop, store, restaurant, cinema, library, hospital, study, English, buy, thing, walk, first, then, also, afternoon, busy, dark, part
en.cum: go home / go to school / go to the zoo / buy things / eat dinner / see animals / play with friends / take a walk
en.cau: Where are you going? / I go to the shop to buy things. / [Ngữ pháp: every] Every evening, I go home to eat dinner. / First, I go to the zoo. Then, I go home.
en.truyen: My week — My name is Leo. On Monday morning, I go to school to study. On Tuesday afternoon, I go to the shop to buy things. On Wednesday afternoon, I go to the park to play with my friends. Every evening, I go home to eat dinner.

zh.tu: Ôn (không tranh, ẩn pinyin, chữ Hán có loa): 地方 dìfang, 家 jiā, 学校 xuéxiào, 商店 shāngdiàn, 公园 gōngyuán, 饭店 fàndiàn, 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn, 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 学习 xuéxí, 买 mǎi, 东西 dōngxi, 散步 sànbù, 然后 ránhòu, 上午 shàngwǔ, 下午 xiàwǔ, 家人 jiārén
zh.cum: 回家 huí jiā / 去学校 qù xuéxiào / 去动物园 qù dòngwùyuán / 买东西 mǎi dōngxi / 吃晚饭 chī wǎnfàn / 看动物 kàn dòngwù / 和朋友玩 hé péngyou wán
zh.cau: 你去哪儿？(Nǐ qù nǎr?) / 我去商店买东西。(Wǒ qù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi.) / 我去公园玩。(Wǒ qù gōngyuán wán.) / 我回家吃晚饭。(Wǒ huí jiā chī wǎnfàn.)
zh.truyen: 我的一个星期 — 我叫Leo。星期一早上，我去学校学习。星期二下午，我去商店买东西。星期三下午，我去公园和朋友玩。每天晚上，我回家吃晚饭。（Wǒ jiào Leo. Xīngqīyī zǎoshang, wǒ qù xuéxiào xuéxí. Xīngqī'èr xiàwǔ, wǒ qù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi. Xīngqīsān xiàwǔ, wǒ qù gōngyuán hé péngyou wán. Měi tiān wǎnshang, wǒ huí jiā chī wǎnfàn.）
zh.video: 地方 Places Part 1 – Little Chinese Learners – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XAeEErUCojk

en.flash: afternoon, busy, dark, part | Ôn: morning, evening, week, Monday, Saturday, Sunday, first, then
en.slide: 1) Xếp câu, thời gian đứng đầu: On Monday morning, / I go to school / to study. (3 câu của Ngày 45). 2) Nghe chọn tranh (6 câu): on Monday morning / on Saturday evening / on Sunday afternoon / every evening / before it's dark / a busy part of town. 3) Đọc Leo's Saturday trên bản đồ, một con đẩy xe đồ chơi qua từng nơi; hỏi bằng tiếng kia sau bản tiếng Trung: Where does Leo go first?
en.truyen: Leo's Saturday — It is Saturday. Leo goes to the park to play. Then he goes to the shop to buy things. In the evening, he goes to the restaurant to eat dinner. Then he goes home.
en.baihat: Limerick: Where are you going, little Lee? To the zoo, the zoo, to see, see, see! (vần Lee – see; con thay the zoo bằng nơi khác, tự tìm vần) · Where Are You Going? cả bài (Park, Shop, Home) · Ôn vè: Home, school, shop and park, I go home before it's dark!

zh.flash: 上午 shàngwǔ, 下午 xiàwǔ, 家人 jiārén, 人 rén, 零 líng | Ôn: 早上 zǎoshang, 晚上 wǎnshang, 星期 xīngqī, 然后 ránhòu
zh.slide: 1) 早上 và 上午 cùng nghĩa morning: nhìn đồng hồ chọn 早上 (7 giờ) hay 上午 (10 giờ); 下午 (3 giờ), 晚上 (8 giờ). 2) Thanh điệu: nghe chọn 商店 shāngdiàn (1–4) / 公园 gōngyuán (1–2) / 回家 huí jiā (2–1); thời gian đứng đầu câu ZH: 星期一早上，我去学校学习。 3) Chép 门 vào ô (chấm, sổ, ngang gập móc); câu hỏi sau bản tiếng Anh: Leo晚上去哪儿？
zh.truyen: Leo的星期六 — 今天星期六。Leo去公园玩。然后他去商店买东西。晚上，他去饭店吃晚饭。然后他回家。（Jīntiān xīngqīliù. Leo qù gōngyuán wán. Ránhòu tā qù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi. Wǎnshang, tā qù fàndiàn chī wǎnfàn. Ránhòu tā huí jiā.）
zh.baihat: Limerick: 你去哪儿？去公园，我去公园玩一天！(vần yuán – tiān; thay 公园 bằng nơi khác) · 你去哪儿？cả bài (Park, Shop, Home) · Ôn vè: 去公园，玩一玩；去商店，看一看；去饭店，吃晚饭；回家回家，家最暖！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 24. Unit 5 · Places in town · 地方 – Vận dụng: đọc, diễn My week; dẫn đường; tờ bản đồ đầu tiên

web.label: Ngày 47. Unit 5 · Truyện 2 My busy week + chuyển ngữ (NL5, NL7, PS-2)

en.tu: Ôn: zoo, restaurant, family, morning, evening, afternoon, Saturday, Sunday, busy, then, first
en.cum: go to school on Monday morning / eat dinner on Saturday evening / play with friends on Sunday afternoon / go to the zoo to see animals
en.cau: On Saturday morning, I go to the zoo to see animals. / [Ngữ pháp: thời gian đứng đầu câu] On Saturday evening, my family goes to the restaurant to eat dinner. / Every day is a good day! / Where does Leo go on Monday afternoon? He goes to the shop.
en.truyen: My busy week — My name is Leo. On Monday morning, I go to school to study. On Saturday morning, I go to the zoo to see animals. On Saturday evening, my family goes to the restaurant to eat dinner. On Sunday morning, I go to the park to play. Every day is a good day!

zh.tu: Ôn: 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 饭店 fàndiàn, 家人 jiārén, 早上 zǎoshang, 上午 shàngwǔ, 下午 xiàwǔ, 晚上 wǎnshang, 星期六 xīngqīliù, 星期天 xīngqītiān, 然后 ránhòu
zh.cum: 星期一早上去学校 xīngqīyī zǎoshang qù xuéxiào / 星期六晚上吃晚饭 xīngqīliù wǎnshang chī wǎnfàn / 星期天下午和朋友玩 xīngqītiān xiàwǔ hé péngyou wán / 去动物园看动物 qù dòngwùyuán kàn dòngwù
zh.cau: 星期六早上，我去动物园看动物。(Xīngqīliù zǎoshang, wǒ qù dòngwùyuán kàn dòngwù.) / 星期六晚上，我的家人去饭店吃晚饭。(Xīngqīliù wǎnshang, wǒ de jiārén qù fàndiàn chī wǎnfàn.) / 每天都是好日子！(Měi tiān dōu shì hǎo rìzi!) / [PS-2] 星期一上午Leo去学校，下午去商店。(Xīngqīyī shàngwǔ Leo qù xuéxiào, xiàwǔ qù shāngdiàn.)

Xīngqīliù wǎnshang, wǒ de jiārén qù fàndiàn chī wǎnfàn. Xīngqītiān shàngwǔ, wǒ qù gōngyuán wán. Měi tiān dōu shì hǎo rìzi!）
zh.video: 你去哪里？Where are you going? – Coolong Chinese – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bh013yaanCo

web.label: Ngày 48. Unit 5 · Phiên dịch nhí + ôn unit (NL6, PS-3)

en.tu: Ôn: place, cinema, library, hospital, English, part, thing, also, dark, walk, store, shop, buy, study
en.cum: go to the cinema / go to the library to study English / a busy part of town / before it's dark / play in the sand / take a walk
en.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí] Xiaomei: "我去图书馆看书。" → Xiaomei goes to the library to read. / Who goes to the zoo? Anna goes to the zoo. / Anna doesn't go to the park. / I also go to the cinema on Saturday afternoon.
en.truyen: Three Friends, Three Places — Leo, Anna and Bông go to three places: the park, the zoo and the library. Anna doesn't go to the park. Bông goes to the library to read. Where does Anna go? Anna goes to the zoo!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "places in town kids song library cinema hospital"

zh.tu: Ôn: 地方 dìfang, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn, 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 东西 dōngxi, 散步 sànbù, 人 rén, 零 líng, 学习 xuéxí, 买 mǎi, 门 mén
zh.cum: 去电影院 qù diànyǐngyuàn / 去图书馆学习 qù túshūguǎn xuéxí / 一个人 yí ge rén / 去公园散步 qù gōngyuán sànbù / 买东西 mǎi dōngxi
zh.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí] Leo: "I go to the cinema." → Leo去电影院。(Leo qù diànyǐngyuàn.) / 谁去动物园？Anna去动物园。(Shéi qù dòngwùyuán? Anna qù dòngwùyuán.) / Anna不去公园。(Anna bú qù gōngyuán.) / 去动物园的不是Leo。(Qù dòngwùyuán de bú shì Leo.)
zh.truyen: 三个朋友 — Leo、Anna和Bông去三个地方：公园、动物园和图书馆。Anna不去公园。去动物园的不是Leo。Bông去图书馆看书。Anna去哪儿？Anna去动物园！（Leo, Anna hé Bông qù sān ge dìfang: gōngyuán, dòngwùyuán hé túshūguǎn. Anna bú qù gōngyuán. Qù dòngwùyuán de bú shì Leo. Bông qù túshūguǎn kàn shū. Anna qù nǎr? Anna qù dòngwùyuán!）
zh.video: 你去哪里？Where are you going? – Coolong Chinese – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bh013yaanCo

en.flash: Ôn: place, home, shop, store, park, restaurant, zoo, cinema, library, hospital, study, English, play, buy, thing, eat, see, walk, first, then, also, afternoon, busy, dark, part
en.slide: 1) Đọc My week theo câu, mỗi con nói một ngày trong tuần của Leo. 2) Chuyền bóng hỏi đường (NL6): bạn cầm bóng hỏi "Where are you going?" – bạn nhận bóng đáp tiếng Anh: "I go to the library to study English."; hỏi bằng tiếng Trung thì đáp tiếng Trung. 3) PS-3 trên lớp: three friends, three places – "Anna doesn't go to the park." "Bông goes to the library." → Where does Anna go? 4) Vẽ tờ bản đồ đầu tiên (home, school, park, shop gần nhà), con nói 2 câu: On Saturday afternoon, I go to the park to play. Every evening, I go home.
en.truyen: My week — My name is Leo. On Monday morning, I go to school to study. On Tuesday afternoon, I go to the shop to buy things. On Wednesday afternoon, I go to the park to play with my friends. Every evening, I go home to eat dinner. (đọc và diễn, mỗi con một câu; cô hỏi: What does Leo do on Tuesday afternoon?)
en.baihat: Biểu diễn vè: Home, school, shop and park, I go home before it's dark! · Where Are You Going? cả bài — Park: … I go to the park to play. / Play, play, play! · Shop: … I go to the shop to buy things. / Buy, buy, buy! · Zoo: Where are you going? / To the zoo! / I go to the zoo to see animals. / See, see, see! · Home: Where are you going? / I am going home! / I am going home, going home. / Home, home, home!

zh.flash: Ôn: 地方 dìfang, 家 jiā, 学校 xuéxiào, 商店 shāngdiàn, 公园 gōngyuán, 饭店 fàndiàn, 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 学习 xuéxí, 玩 wán, 买 mǎi, 东西 dōngxi, 散步 sànbù, 然后 ránhòu, 上午 shàngwǔ, 下午 xiàwǔ, 家人 jiārén, 人 rén
zh.slide: 1) Đọc 我的一个星期 có pinyin, mỗi con một câu; trả lời: 星期二下午，Leo去哪儿？ 2) Xiaomei hỏi "你去哪儿？", con chỉ đường trên bản đồ và đáp tiếng Trung: 我去公园和朋友玩。 3) Chép 家 và 门 vào ô, dán lên tờ bản đồ (家 trên nhà con, 门 trên cổng trường).
zh.truyen: 我的一个星期 — 我叫Leo。星期一早上，我去学校学习。星期二下午，我去商店买东西。星期三下午，我去公园和朋友玩。每天晚上，我回家吃晚饭。（Wǒ jiào Leo. Xīngqīyī zǎoshang, wǒ qù xuéxiào xuéxí. Xīngqī'èr xiàwǔ, wǒ qù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi. Xīngqīsān xiàwǔ, wǒ qù gōngyuán hé péngyou wán. Měi tiān wǎnshang, wǒ huí jiā chī wǎnfàn.）
zh.baihat: Biểu diễn vè ZH: 去公园，玩一玩；去商店，看一看；去饭店，吃晚饭；回家回家，家最暖！ · 你去哪儿？cả bài — Park: 你去哪儿？/ 去公园！/ 我去公园玩。/ 玩，玩，玩！ · Shop: 你去哪儿？/ 去商店！/ 我去商店买东西。/ 买，买，买！ · Zoo: 你去哪儿？/ 去动物园！/ 我去动物园看动物。/ 看，看，看！ · Home: 你去哪儿？/ 我回家！/ 我回家，我回家。/ 家，家，家！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 25. Unit 6 · Job · 工作 – Hiểu: hỏi – đáp nghề của một người; tô 生

en.tu: Mới: job, student, doctor, chef, dentist, driver | Ôn: teacher, clock, Monday, Sunday
en.cum: is a teacher / is a doctor / is a chef / is a driver / a student at school
en.cau: What does he do? / He is a teacher. / [Ngữ pháp: a + nghề] She is a dentist. / I am a student. / What's your job? I am a chef.
en.truyen: Job Day — It's Job Day at school! Bông: "What does he do?" Anna: "He is a doctor." Xiaomei: "She is a dentist." Leo: "And I am a student!"

zh.tu: Mới: 工作 gōngzuò, 学生 xuéshēng, 医生 yīshēng, 厨师 chúshī, 牙医 yáyī, 司机 sījī | Ôn: 老师 lǎoshī, 房间 fángjiān, 星期天 xīngqītiān
zh.cum: 是老师 shì lǎoshī / 是医生 shì yīshēng / 是厨师 shì chúshī / 是司机 shì sījī / 做什么工作 zuò shénme gōngzuò
zh.cau: 他做什么工作？(Tā zuò shénme gōngzuò?) / 他是老师。(Tā shì lǎoshī.) / [Ngữ pháp: tiếng Trung không cần "a" trước nghề] 她是牙医。(Tā shì yáyī.) / 我是学生。(Wǒ shì xuéshēng.)
zh.truyen: 做什么工作？ — 今天在学校，Bông问：“他做什么工作？”Anna说：“他是医生。”Xiaomei说：“她是牙医。”Leo说：“我是学生！”（Jīntiān zài xuéxiào, Bông wèn: “Tā zuò shénme gōngzuò?” Anna shuō: “Tā shì yīshēng.” Xiaomei shuō: “Tā shì yáyī.” Leo shuō: “Wǒ shì xuéshēng!”）

en.tu: Mới: nurse, farmer, firefighter, employee | Ôn: Tuesday, week, calendar, which
en.cum: is a nurse / is a farmer / is a firefighter / is an employee
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: an trước nguyên âm] She is an employee. / He is a firefighter. / Is she a nurse? No, she is a doctor. / Is he a farmer? Yes, he is.
en.truyen: Who Is It? — Leo looks at a photo. "Is she a nurse?" "No, she is a doctor." "Is he a farmer?" "Yes, he is." "Is she an employee?" "Yes, she is!"

zh.tu: Mới: 员工 yuángōng, 护士 hùshi, 农民 nóngmín, 消防员 xiāofángyuán | Ôn: 汉语 Hànyǔ, 同学 tóngxué, 时候 shíhou, 照片 zhàopiàn
zh.cum: 是员工 shì yuángōng / 是护士 shì hùshi / 是农民 shì nóngmín / 是消防员 shì xiāofángyuán
zh.cau: 她是员工。(Tā shì yuángōng.) / [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi 吗] 他是消防员吗？(Tā shì xiāofángyuán ma?) / 她是护士吗？不是，她是医生。(Tā shì hùshi ma? Bú shì, tā shì yīshēng.) / 你喜欢什么工作？(Nǐ xǐhuan shénme gōngzuò?)
zh.truyen: 这是谁？ — Leo看照片。“她是护士吗？”“不是，她是医生。”“他是农民吗？”“是。”“她是员工吗？”“是！”（Leo kàn zhàopiàn. “Tā shì hùshi ma?” “Bú shì, tā shì yīshēng.” “Tā shì nóngmín ma?” “Shì.” “Tā shì yuángōng ma?” “Shì!”）

en.flash: job, student, doctor, chef, dentist, driver, nurse, farmer, firefighter, employee | Ôn: teacher
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (6 câu): doctor / chef / dentist / driver / nurse / firefighter. 2) Đối chiếu: a doctor ↔ 医生, an employee ↔ 员工 (tiếng Trung không có a / an) – kéo a hoặc an vào trước 4 nghề. 3) Trò Đoán nghề qua động tác: một con diễn, cả lớp hỏi "What does he do?" và đoán "He is a driver!".
en.truyen: Job Day at School — It is Job Day. Bông shows a photo. "This is a doctor. This is a chef. This is a firefighter." Leo asks, "What's your job, Miss?" "I am a teacher!"
en.baihat: What Does Dad Do? (giai điệu The Farmer in the Dell) — đoạn Bố: What does Dad do? / What does Dad do? / He's a doctor, he works at a hospital. / Dad is a doctor! · đoạn Mẹ: What does Mom do? / What does Mom do? / She's a teacher, she works at a school. / Mom is a teacher! · Vè: Driver, driver, drive the bus, Doctor, doctor, help all of us!

zh.flash: 工作 gōngzuò, 学生 xuéshēng, 医生 yīshēng, 厨师 chúshī, 牙医 yáyī, 司机 sījī, 员工 yuángōng, 护士 hùshi, 农民 nóngmín, 消防员 xiāofángyuán | Ôn: 老师 lǎoshī
zh.slide: 1) Nghe – chạm (6 câu): 老师 / 学生 / 医生 / 厨师 / 牙医 / 司机. 2) Hỏi – đáp theo tranh: 他做什么工作？— 他是司机。 3) Tô 生: mầm cây hai lá nhú lên khỏi mặt đất, 5 nét (phẩy, ngang, ngang, sổ, ngang); tìm 生 trong 学生, 医生.
zh.truyen: 老师做什么工作？ — 今天在学校，Bông看照片：“这是医生。这是厨师。这是消防员。”Leo问：“老师，您做什么工作？”“我是老师！”（Jīntiān zài xuéxiào, Bông kàn zhàopiàn: “Zhè shì yīshēng. Zhè shì chúshī. Zhè shì xiāofángyuán.” Leo wèn: “Lǎoshī, nín zuò shénme gōngzuò?” “Wǒ shì lǎoshī!”）
zh.baihat: 爸爸做什么工作？(giai điệu The Farmer in the Dell) — đoạn Bố: 爸爸做什么工作？/ 爸爸做什么工作？/ 他是医生，他在医院工作。/ 爸爸是医生！ · đoạn Mẹ: 妈妈做什么工作？/ 妈妈做什么工作？/ 她是老师，她在学校工作。/ 妈妈是老师！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 26. Unit 6 · Job · 工作 – Hiểu: nghề và nơi làm việc; chép 生, tô 工

web.label: Ngày 51. Unit 6 · Nơi làm việc (nhóm 2, nối Unit 5): làm ở trường, bệnh viện, nhà hàng, cửa hàng

en.tu: Mới: work, don't worry | Ôn (nối Unit 5): hospital, school, restaurant, shop, library, cinema
en.cum: work at a school / work at a hospital / work at a restaurant / work at a shop / start work at eight o'clock
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: he / she works – thêm s] He works at a school. / She is an employee. She works at a shop. / The doctor works at a hospital. / Don't worry! The nurse is here.
en.truyen: At the Hospital — Bông is at the hospital with her mum. She is sad. The nurse says, "Don't worry!" The doctor works at the hospital. He starts work at eight o'clock.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "where do they work jobs and places song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 医院 yīyuàn, 没关系 méi guānxi | Ôn (nối Unit 5): 学校 xuéxiào, 饭店 fàndiàn, 商店 shāngdiàn, 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn
zh.cum: 在学校工作 zài xuéxiào gōngzuò / 在医院工作 zài yīyuàn gōngzuò / 在饭店工作 zài fàndiàn gōngzuò / 在商店工作 zài shāngdiàn gōngzuò
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 在 + nơi chốn + 工作] 他在学校工作。(Tā zài xuéxiào gōngzuò.) / 她是员工，她在商店工作。(Tā shì yuángōng, tā zài shāngdiàn gōngzuò.) / 医生在医院工作。(Yīshēng zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.) / 对不起！——没关系！(Duìbuqǐ! — Méi guānxi!)
zh.truyen: 在医院 — 医生在医院工作，护士也在医院工作。Leo和妈妈去医院。Leo说：“对不起！”护士说：“没关系！”（Yīshēng zài yīyuàn gōngzuò, hùshi yě zài yīyuàn gōngzuò. Leo hé māma qù yīyuàn. Leo shuō: “Duìbuqǐ!” Hùshi shuō: “Méi guānxi!”）

en.tu: Mới: oh dear, love | Ôn (nối Unit 5): busy, afternoon, then, first, buy, thing
en.cum: love my job / oh dear! / whose photo? / live in this town / find the hospital
en.cau: Oh dear! The restaurant is busy! / I love my job! / Whose photo is this? It's Anna's photo. / [Ngữ pháp: from / her] Xiaomei is from China. This is her dad. He is a chef.
en.truyen: Oh Dear! — It is Saturday afternoon. The restaurant is busy. "Oh dear!" says the chef. His friend says, "Don't worry! I can cook, too." Then they cook dinner. The chef says, "I love my job!"
