zh.tu: Mới: 比 bǐ, 大家 dàjiā | Ôn (nối Unit 5): 下午 xiàwǔ, 然后 ránhòu, 买 mǎi, 人 rén | Ôn: 爱 ài, 觉得 juéde
zh.cum: 爱我的工作 ài wǒ de gōngzuò / 大家都工作 dàjiā dōu gōngzuò / 比我高 bǐ wǒ gāo / 谁的照片 shéi de zhàopiàn
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: A 比 B + tính từ] 哥哥比我高。(Gēge bǐ wǒ gāo.) / 饭店里人很多。(Fàndiàn lǐ rén hěn duō.) / 我爱我的工作！(Wǒ ài wǒ de gōngzuò!) / 这是谁的照片？(Zhè shì shéi de zhàopiàn?) / 我觉得医生很好。(Wǒ juéde yīshēng hěn hǎo.)
zh.truyen: 饭店里人很多 — 星期六下午，饭店里人很多。厨师说：“哎呀！”朋友说：“没关系！我也会做饭。”然后他们做饭。厨师说：“我爱我的工作！”（Xīngqīliù xiàwǔ, fàndiàn lǐ rén hěn duō. Chúshī shuō: “Āiyā!” Péngyou shuō: “Méi guānxi! Wǒ yě huì zuòfàn.” Ránhòu tāmen zuòfàn. Chúshī shuō: “Wǒ ài wǒ de gōngzuò!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我爱我的工作 儿歌 职业"

en.flash: work, don't worry, oh dear, love, employee | Ôn: hospital, school, restaurant, shop, doctor, chef, teacher
en.slide: 1) Trò Nghề ở đâu?: ghép thẻ nghề với thẻ nơi làm việc trên bản đồ Unit 5 (doctor – hospital / chef – restaurant / teacher – school / employee – shop). 2) Đối chiếu NL9: He works at a hospital. ↔ 他在医院工作。 – con kéo "at a hospital" ra sau, kéo 在医院 lên trước. 3) Đóng vai 2 câu: A: Oh dear! B: Don't worry! – rồi nói: I love my job!
en.truyen: Where Do They Work? — Mr Lee is a doctor. He works at a hospital. Miss Hoa is a teacher. She works at a school. Tom is an employee. He works at a shop. They all love their jobs.
en.baihat: What Does Dad Do? — đoạn Đầu bếp: What does he do? / What does he do? / He's a chef, he works at a restaurant. / He is a chef! · đoạn Con: What do you do? / What do you do? / I'm a student, I study at school. / I am a student! · ôn đoạn Bố

zh.flash: 工作 gōngzuò, 医院 yīyuàn, 没关系 méi guānxi, 员工 yuángōng, 比 bǐ, 大家 dàjiā | Ôn: 学校 xuéxiào, 饭店 fàndiàn, 商店 shāngdiàn
zh.slide: 1) Xếp câu: 他 / 在 / 医院 / 工作 → 他在医院工作。(phương án nhiễu: 他工作在医院。) 2) Nghe chọn nơi làm việc: 厨师在哪儿工作？→ 饭店 / 医院 / 学校. 3) Chép 生 trong 学生, 医生; tô 工: cái thước thợ, 3 nét (ngang, sổ, ngang); tìm 工 trong 工作, 员工.
zh.truyen: 在哪儿工作？ — Lee叔叔是医生，他在医院工作。Hoa老师在学校工作。Tom是员工，他在商店工作。大家都爱工作。（Lee shūshu shì yīshēng, tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò. Hoa lǎoshī zài xuéxiào gōngzuò. Tom shì yuángōng, tā zài shāngdiàn gōngzuò. Dàjiā dōu ài gōngzuò.）
zh.baihat: Vè ZH: 医生在医院，厨师在饭店，员工在商店，大家都上班！ · 爸爸做什么工作？— đoạn Đầu bếp: 他做什么工作？/ 他做什么工作？/ 他是厨师，他在饭店工作。/ 他是厨师！ · đoạn Con: 你做什么工作？/ 你做什么工作？/ 我是学生，我在学校学习。/ 我是学生！

en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: by + phương tiện, không có a] I go to school by bike. / I drive to work. / My dad is a driver. He drives a bus. / [Ngữ pháp: us] Sit on the bus with us!
en.truyen: Dad's Job — My dad is a driver. He drives a bus. Every morning, I sit on his bus. I go to school by bus. "Goodbye, Dad!"

zh.tu: Mới: 坐 zuò, 骑 qí, 开 kāi | Ôn (nối Unit 6): 司机 sījī, 工作 gōngzuò, 医生 yīshēng, 员工 yuángōng, 爸爸 bàba
zh.cum: 坐公共汽车 zuò gōnggòng qìchē / 骑摩托车 qí mótuōchē / 开车 kāichē / 骑自行车去上学 qí zìxíngchē qù shàngxué
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: phương tiện đứng trước 去] 我骑自行车去上学。(Wǒ qí zìxíngchē qù shàngxué.) / [Ngữ pháp: 坐 / 骑 / 开 đi đúng xe] 我爸爸是司机，他开公共汽车。(Wǒ bàba shì sījī, tā kāi gōnggòng qìchē.) / 妈妈骑摩托车。(Māma qí mótuōchē.) / 我坐火车。(Wǒ zuò huǒchē.)
zh.truyen: 爸爸的工作 — 我爸爸是司机，他开公共汽车。每天早上，我坐爸爸的公共汽车去上学。我说：“爸爸，再见！”（Wǒ bàba shì sījī, tā kāi gōnggòng qìchē. Měi tiān zǎoshang, wǒ zuò bàba de gōnggòng qìchē qù shàngxué. Wǒ shuō: “Bàba, zàijiàn!”）

en.tu: Mới: easy, round, yours | Ôn (nối Unit 6): nurse, chef, firefighter, employee, hospital, love | Ôn: walk
en.cum: walk to the park / go to work / the wheels go round and round / an easy trip / talk on the bus

zh.tu: Mới: 走路 zǒulù, 走 zǒu, 上班 shàngbān | Ôn: 上学 shàngxué | Ôn (nối Unit 6): 护士 hùshi, 厨师 chúshī, 医院 yīyuàn, 消防员 xiāofángyuán
zh.cum: 走路去公园 zǒulù qù gōngyuán / 去上班 qù shàngbān / 去上学 qù shàngxué / 开车去上班 kāichē qù shàngbān
zh.cau: 我开车去上班。(Wǒ kāichē qù shàngbān.) / 我走路去公园。(Wǒ zǒulù qù gōngyuán.) / [Ngữ pháp: 去学校 (đi đến đâu) – 去上学 (đi làm gì)] 我去学校。我去上学。(Wǒ qù xuéxiào. Wǒ qù shàngxué.) / 妈妈是护士，她走路去上班。(Māma shì hùshi, tā zǒulù qù shàngbān.)
zh.truyen: 妈妈去上班 — Bông的妈妈是护士，她在医院工作。每天早上，妈妈走路去上班。Bông坐公共汽车去上学。她们说：“再见！”（Bông de māma shì hùshi, tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò. Měi tiān zǎoshang, māma zǒulù qù shàngbān. Bông zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù shàngxué. Tāmen shuō: “Zàijiàn!”）

en.flash: sit, drive, by, easy, round, yours | Ôn: ride, walk, driver, bus, bike, car
en.slide: 1) Trò Ngồi, cưỡi hay lái?: cô nói phương tiện (bus / bike / car / motorbike), con làm động tác sit / ride / drive và nói: I take a bus. / I ride a bike. / I drive a car. 2) Đối chiếu NL9: I go to school by bike. ↔ 我骑自行车去上学。 – kéo "by bike" về cuối câu tiếng Anh. 3) Đúng hay sai: "I go to school by walk." (sai) → I walk to school. / "I go by a bike." (sai) → by bike.
en.truyen: How Do You Go? — Leo rides his bike to school. Anna takes a bus. Bông's mum walks to work. Leo's dad drives a car. "Is this bike yours, Leo?" "Yes, it is!"
en.baihat: How Do You Go to School? — đoạn Car · Dad: This is the way Dad drives a car, / drives a car, drives a car, / This is the way Dad drives a car, / Dad drives to work! · ôn đoạn Bike: This is the way I ride a bike, / ride a bike, ride a bike, / This is the way I ride a bike, / I go to school by bike!

zh.flash: 坐 zuò, 骑 qí, 开 kāi, 走路 zǒulù, 走 zǒu, 上班 shàngbān | Ôn: 上学 shàngxué, 司机 sījī
zh.slide: 1) Kéo động từ vào đúng xe: 坐 → 公共汽车, 火车, 飞机 / 骑 → 自行车, 摩托车 / 开 → 汽车. 2) Xếp vào nhóm "Đi đến đâu?" (去学校, 去公园, 去商店) / "Đi làm gì?" (去上学, 去上班). 3) Chép 车 trong 汽车, 火车 vào ô.
zh.truyen: 你怎么去？ — Leo骑自行车去上学。Anna坐公共汽车。Bông的妈妈走路去上班。Leo的爸爸开车。（Leo qí zìxíngchē qù shàngxué. Anna zuò gōnggòng qìchē. Bông de māma zǒulù qù shàngbān. Leo de bàba kāichē.）
zh.baihat: Vè ZH: 走路走路一二一，汽车汽车嘀嘀嘀，自行车，我会骑！ · 你怎么去上学？— đoạn Car · Dad: 爸爸开车，/ 开车，开车，/ 爸爸开车，/ 爸爸开车去上班！

zh.tu: Mới: 北京 Běijīng, 上海 Shànghǎi, 怎么 zěnme, 不客气 bú kèqi, 呢 ne | Ôn: 司机 sījī, 公园 gōngyuán, 商店 shāngdiàn, 怎么样 zěnmeyàng
zh.cum: 坐火车去北京 zuò huǒchē qù Běijīng / 坐飞机去上海 zuò fēijī qù Shànghǎi / 怎么去 zěnme qù / 你呢 nǐ ne
zh.cau: 他怎么去上班？(Tā zěnme qù shàngbān?) / 他坐公共汽车去上班。(Tā zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù shàngbān.) / 我坐火车去北京。(Wǒ zuò huǒchē qù Běijīng.) / [Ngữ pháp: 呢 hỏi lại] 我坐公共汽车，你呢？(Wǒ zuò gōnggòng qìchē, nǐ ne?) / 谢谢！——不客气！(Xièxie! — Bú kèqi!)
zh.truyen: 去北京 — 明天，Xiaomei和家人坐火车去北京。爸爸坐飞机去上海工作。Xiaomei问：“Bông，你呢？”Bông说：“我坐公共汽车去公园。”（Míngtiān, Xiaomei hé jiārén zuò huǒchē qù Běijīng. Bàba zuò fēijī qù Shànghǎi gōngzuò. Xiaomei wèn: “Bông, nǐ ne?” Bông shuō: “Wǒ zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù gōngyuán.”）

en.slide: 1) Đọc How Do We Go? theo câu; con vẽ đường đi của Leo, Anna, Bông lên bản đồ lớp và gắn thẻ phương tiện. 2) Hỏi – đáp: How does he go to work? – He takes a bus to work. (tranh: bác sĩ đi ô tô, đầu bếp đi xe buýt, cô giáo đi xe máy). 3) Âm /aɪ/ trong bike, ride, drive: nghe chọn từ có /aɪ/ (bike / bus / ride / drive / train).
en.truyen: How Do We Go? — Leo rides a bike to school. Anna takes a bus to school. Bông walks to school. Dad drives to work. On Sunday, Xiaomei takes a train to Beijing.

(vần bus – us) · How Do You Go to School? — đoạn Train: This is the way we take a train, / take a train, take a train, / This is the way we take a train, / We take a train to Beijing! · đoạn Plane: This is the way we take a plane, / take a plane, take a plane, / This is the way we take a plane, / We take a plane to Shanghai! · ôn vè: Train goes choo-choo, plane goes zoom, Bike goes ring-ring, car goes vroom!

zh.flash: 北京 Běijīng, 上海 Shànghǎi, 怎么 zěnme, 不客气 bú kèqi, 呢 ne | Ôn: 司机 sījī, 公园 gōngyuán, 商店 shāngdiàn, 火车 huǒchē, 飞机 fēijī
zh.slide: 1) Thanh điệu: 坐 zuò (4), 骑 qí (2), 开 kāi (1); bẫy 骑 qí ≠ 七 qī, 坐 zuò ≠ 走 zǒu – nghe chọn đúng. 2) Hỏi lại bằng 呢: 我坐公共汽车，你呢？ – bạn đáp cách đi thật của mình. 3) Tô 走: người vung tay, bàn chân đỏ đang bước; 7 nét (ngang, sổ, ngang, sổ, ngang, phẩy, mác); câu hỏi sau bản tiếng Anh: Xiaomei星期天去哪儿？

en.flash: Ôn: car, bus, bicycle, motorbike, train, plane, taxi, helicopter, ship, lorry, truck, sit, drive, easy, round, trip, boy, Beijing, Shanghai
en.slide: 1) Đọc và diễn How does my family go?, mỗi con một người trong nhà. 2) Khảo sát lớp (NL6): hỏi 5 bạn "How do you go to school?" – đánh dấu vào biểu đồ tranh (bus / bike / car / motorbike / walk); bạn hỏi tiếng Trung thì đáp tiếng Trung. 3) PS-3 trên lớp: three friends, three ways – "Bông walks to school." "Anna doesn't walk." "Leo doesn't ride a bike." → How does Anna go to school? 4) An toàn giao thông: chọn tranh đúng (đội mũ bảo hiểm khi ngồi xe máy, xe đạp; đi bộ trên vỉa hè, qua đường cùng người lớn) rồi nói: I walk with Mum. Vẽ đường từ nhà đến trường lên bản đồ thành phố.
en.truyen: How does my family go? — My dad is a driver. He drives to work. My mom is a teacher. She rides a motorbike to school. I take a bus to school. My older brother walks to the park. (đọc, diễn; cô hỏi: How does my mom go to school?)
en.baihat: Biểu diễn vè: Train goes choo-choo, plane goes zoom, Bike goes ring-ring, car goes vroom! · How Do You Go to School? cả bài — How Do You Go to School? (giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush) — đoạn Bike: This is the way I ride a bike, / ride a bike, ride a bike, / This is the way I ride a bike, / I go to school by bike! · đoạn Bus: This is the way I take a bus, / take a bus, take a bus, / This is the way I take a bus, / I take a bus to school! · đoạn Car · Dad: This is the way Dad drives a car, / drives a car, drives a car, / This is the way Dad drives a car, / Dad drives to work! · đoạn Train: This is the way we take a train, / take a train, take a train, / This is the way we take a train, / We take a train to Beijing! · đoạn Plane: This is the way we take a plane, / take a plane, take a plane, / This is the way we take a plane, / We take a plane to Shanghai!

zh.flash: Ôn: 汽车 qìchē, 公共汽车 gōnggòng qìchē, 自行车 zìxíngchē, 摩托车 mótuōchē, 火车 huǒchē, 飞机 fēijī, 坐 zuò, 骑 qí, 开 kāi, 走 zǒu, 走路 zǒulù, 上班 shàngbān, 北京 Běijīng, 上海 Shànghǎi, 不客气 bú kèqi
zh.slide: 1) Đọc 我家人怎么去？ có pinyin, hỏi chéo sau bản tiếng Trung: How does my mom go to school? 2) Khảo sát lớp bằng tiếng Trung: 你怎么去上学？ – 我……去上学。 rồi cảm ơn: 谢谢！– 不客气！ 3) Bắt bẫy NL4: 我坐自行车 (sai động từ → 骑) / 我去上学骑自行车 (sai trật tự → 我骑自行车去上学); chép 车 và 走 vào ô, dán lên đường đi trên bản đồ.
zh.truyen: 我家人怎么去？ — 我爸爸是司机。他开车去上班。我妈妈是老师。她骑摩托车去学校。我坐公共汽车去上学。我哥哥走路去公园。（Wǒ bàba shì sījī. Tā kāichē qù shàngbān. Wǒ māma shì lǎoshī. Tā qí mótuōchē qù xuéxiào. Wǒ zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù shàngxué. Wǒ gēge zǒulù qù gōngyuán.）
zh.baihat: Biểu diễn vè ZH: 走路走路一二一，汽车汽车嘀嘀嘀，自行车，我会骑！ · 你怎么去上学？cả bài — 你怎么去上学？(giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush) — đoạn Bike: 我骑自行车，/ 骑自行车，骑自行车，/ 我骑自行车，/ 我骑自行车去上学！ · đoạn Bus: 我坐公共汽车，/ 坐公共汽车，坐公共汽车，/ 我坐公共汽车，/ 我坐公共汽车去上学！ · đoạn Car · Dad: 爸爸开车，/ 开车，开车，/ 爸爸开车，/ 爸爸开车去上班！ · đoạn Train: 我们坐火车，/ 坐火车，坐火车，/ 我们坐火车，/ 坐火车去北京！ · đoạn Plane: 我们坐飞机，/ 坐飞机，坐飞机，/ 我们坐飞机，/ 坐飞机去上海！

blocks.title: Unit 8 · At the zoo · 在动物园

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 33. Unit 8 · At the zoo · 在动物园 – Hiểu: gọi tên con vật sở thú; hỏi đây là con gì; tô 高

web.label: Ngày 65. Unit 8 · Con vật sở thú 1: voi, hổ, hươu cao cổ, rắn, khỉ

en.tu: Mới: animal, elephant, tiger, giraffe, snake, monkey | Ôn: zoo, long, say, when
en.cum: go to the zoo / zoo animals / a small monkey / a big elephant
en.cau: What animal is this? / This is an elephant. / [Ngữ pháp: a / an] It's a tiger. It's an elephant. / Let's go to the zoo to see animals!
en.truyen: At the Zoo Gate — Leo and Xiaomei go to the zoo. "What animal is this?" asks Leo. "It's a tiger!" says Xiaomei. "And this is an elephant!" "Look! A monkey and a snake!"
en.video: Let's Go To The Zoo – Super Simple Songs – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OwRmivbNgQk

zh.tu: Mới: 动物 dòngwù, 大象 dàxiàng, 老虎 lǎohǔ, 长颈鹿 chángjǐnglù, 蛇 shé, 猴子 hóuzi | Ôn: 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 告诉 gàosu, 先 xiān
zh.cum: 去动物园 qù dòngwùyuán / 动物园的动物 dòngwùyuán de dòngwù / 小猴子 xiǎo hóuzi / 大大的大象 dàdà de dàxiàng
zh.cau: 这是什么动物？(Zhè shì shénme dòngwù?) / 这是大象。(Zhè shì dàxiàng.) / 那是老虎。(Nà shì lǎohǔ.) / Leo和Xiaomei去动物园看动物。(Leo hé Xiaomei qù dòngwùyuán kàn dòngwù.)
zh.truyen: 在动物园门口 — Leo和Xiaomei去动物园。Leo问：“这是什么动物？”Xiaomei说：“是老虎！”“这是大象！”“看！猴子和蛇！”（Leo hé Xiaomei qù dòngwùyuán. Leo wèn: “Zhè shì shénme dòngwù?” Xiaomei shuō: “Shì lǎohǔ!” “Zhè shì dàxiàng!” “Kàn! Hóuzi hé shé!”）
zh.video: Zoo Animals 动物园动物 – Galaxy Kids Chinese – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oMkR6NC7cz0

web.label: Ngày 66. Unit 8 · Con vật sở thú 2: gấu, ngựa vằn, sư tử, gấu trúc

en.tu: Mới: bear, zebra, lion, panda | Ôn: present, card, yesterday, date
en.cum: a big bear / a zebra and a lion / a black and white panda / a lot of animals
en.cau: Is it a lion? No, it's a bear. / The zebra is black and white. / [Ngữ pháp: a lot of] There are a lot of animals at the zoo. / Which animal do you like? I like the panda.
en.truyen: Which Animal? — Xiaomei likes the panda. Leo likes the lion. "Is it a bear?" "No, it's a panda!" The zebra is black and white, too. There are a lot of animals at the zoo!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "zoo animals bear zebra lion panda vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 熊猫 xióngmāo, 狮子 shīzi, 斑马 bānmǎ, 熊 xióng | Ôn: 中国 Zhōngguó, 卡片 kǎpiàn, 铅笔 qiānbǐ
zh.cum: 大熊猫 dà xióngmāo / 黑白的斑马 hēibái de bānmǎ / 一只狮子 yì zhī shīzi / 很多动物 hěn duō dòngwù
zh.cau: 这是熊吗？不是，这是熊猫。(Zhè shì xióng ma? Bú shì, zhè shì xióngmāo.) / 熊猫在中国。(Xióngmāo zài Zhōngguó.) / 动物园里有很多动物。(Dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō dòngwù.) / 你喜欢什么动物？我喜欢熊猫。(Nǐ xǐhuan shénme dòngwù? Wǒ xǐhuan xióngmāo.)
zh.truyen: 你喜欢什么动物？ — Xiaomei喜欢熊猫。Leo喜欢狮子。“这是熊吗？”“不是，这是熊猫！”斑马也是黑白的。动物园里有很多动物！（Xiaomei xǐhuan xióngmāo. Leo xǐhuan shīzi. “Zhè shì xióng ma?” “Bú shì, zhè shì xióngmāo!” Bānmǎ yě shì hēibái de. Dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō dòngwù!）
zh.video: 与动物一起唱歌学习 – Swoop Woops – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=usZcsXTK6vM

en.flash: animal, elephant, tiger, giraffe, snake, monkey, bear, zebra, lion, panda | Ôn: zoo
en.slide: 1) Cổng sở thú (nối Unit 5): Where are you going? – I go to the zoo to see animals. 2) Trò Bóng con vật: cô chiếu bóng đen, con đoán: It's an elephant! / It's a giraffe! (6 bóng: elephant, tiger, giraffe, snake, monkey, lion). 3) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (6 câu): bear / zebra / panda / lion / tiger / monkey; phương án nhiễu bear – panda.
en.truyen: Hello, Zoo! — Leo and Xiaomei are at the zoo. They see a lion and a tiger. They see a bear, a zebra and a panda. "What animal is this?" asks Xiaomei. "It's a giraffe!" says Leo.
en.baihat: đoạn 2: The tiger is big, the snake is long, / the monkey is small and cute, / the giraffe is tall, so very tall – / Hello, hello, zoo! · Vè: Elephant, elephant, big and grey, Swing your long nose and come and play!

zh.flash: 动物 dòngwù, 大象 dàxiàng, 老虎 lǎohǔ, 长颈鹿 chángjǐnglù, 蛇 shé, 猴子 hóuzi, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 狮子 shīzi, 斑马 bānmǎ, 熊 xióng | Ôn: 动物园 dòngwùyuán
zh.slide: 1) Nghe – chạm (6 câu): 大象 / 老虎 / 长颈鹿 / 蛇 / 猴子 / 熊猫. 2) Hỏi – đáp theo bóng con vật: 这是什么动物？— 这是长颈鹿。 3) Tô 高: ngôi tháp mái nhọn, cửa sổ và cổng; 10 nét (chấm, ngang, sổ, ngang gập, ngang, sổ, ngang gập móc, sổ, ngang gập, ngang).
zh.truyen: 你好，动物园！ — Leo和Xiaomei在动物园。他们看狮子和老虎。他们看熊、斑马和熊猫。Xiaomei问：“这是什么动物？”Leo说：“是长颈鹿！”（Leo hé Xiaomei zài dòngwùyuán. Tāmen kàn shīzi hé lǎohǔ. Tāmen kàn xióng, bānmǎ hé xióngmāo. Xiaomei wèn: “Zhè shì shénme dòngwù?” Leo shuō: “Shì chángjǐnglù!”）
zh.baihat: đoạn 2: 老虎很大，蛇很长，/ 小猴子很可爱，/ 长颈鹿很高，高又高——/ 你好，动物园！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 34. Unit 8 · At the zoo · 在动物园 – Hiểu: tả con vật bằng to, nhỏ, dài, ngắn, cao, thấp; chép 高, tô 长

web.label: Ngày 67. Unit 8 · Tả con vật 1 (nhóm 2, nối Unit 7): cao, thấp, rất, thật là

en.tu: Mới: tall, short, very, so | Ôn: big, small, long | Ôn (nối Unit 7): bus, car, train, plane
en.cum: very big / very long / very tall / very short / so tall
en.cau: The giraffe is tall. / The monkey is small. / [Ngữ pháp: is + tính từ] The tiger is very big. / The giraffe is so tall! / [Ngữ pháp: short = ngắn và thấp] The bus is long. The car is short. I am short. My older brother is tall.
en.truyen: Tall and Short — The giraffe is tall. The monkey is short. The bus is long. The car is short. "Wow! The giraffe is so tall!" says Leo. "It is very tall!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "tall short long big small opposites song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 矮 ǎi, 短 duǎn, 可是 kěshì | Ôn: 高 gāo, 长 cháng, 大 dà, 小 xiǎo, 真 zhēn | Ôn (nối Unit 7): 公共汽车 gōnggòng qìchē, 汽车 qìchē, 火车 huǒchē
zh.cum: 很大 hěn dà / 很长 hěn cháng / 很高 hěn gāo / 很矮 hěn ǎi / 很短 hěn duǎn
zh.cau: 长颈鹿很高。(Chángjǐnglù hěn gāo.) / 猴子很小。(Hóuzi hěn xiǎo.) / [Ngữ pháp: 很 + tính từ, không nói 是高] 老虎很大。(Lǎohǔ hěn dà.) / [Ngữ pháp: 短 ngắn – 矮 thấp] 公共汽车很长，汽车很短。(Gōnggòng qìchē hěn cháng, qìchē hěn duǎn.) 我很矮，哥哥很高。(Wǒ hěn ǎi, gēge hěn gāo.)
zh.truyen: 高和矮 — 长颈鹿很高。猴子很矮。公共汽车很长，汽车很短。Leo说：“哇！长颈鹿真高！”（Chángjǐnglù hěn gāo. Hóuzi hěn ǎi. Gōnggòng qìchē hěn cháng, qìchē hěn duǎn. Leo shuō: “Wa! Chángjǐnglù zhēn gāo!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "高 矮 长 短 反义词 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 68. Unit 8 · Tả con vật 2: cổ, đuôi, chân; its, but

en.tu: Mới: neck, swing | Ôn: nose, tail, leg, ear, head | Ôn (nối Unit 7): ride, drive, sit
en.cum: a long neck / a long nose / a long tail / swing its tail / swing on the swing
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: its] Its neck is long. / The elephant swings its long nose. / [Ngữ pháp: but] The monkey is small, but its tail is long. / The snake is long, but it is not tall.
en.truyen: The Monkey's Tail — The monkey is small, but its tail is long. It swings its tail. The giraffe is tall. Its neck is very long. The elephant swings its nose. "OK, let's go!" says Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "animal body parts neck tail trunk song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 脖子 bózi, 尾巴 wěiba, 腿 tuǐ, 它 tā | Ôn: 鼻子 bízi, 耳朵 ěrduo, 眼睛 yǎnjing, 头发 tóufa | Ôn (nối Unit 7): 骑 qí, 坐 zuò, 开 kāi
zh.cum: 长颈鹿的脖子 chángjǐnglù de bózi / 猴子的尾巴 hóuzi de wěiba / 大象的鼻子 dàxiàng de bízi / 四条腿 sì tiáo tuǐ
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 's ↔ 的] 大象的鼻子很长。(Dàxiàng de bízi hěn cháng.) / 它的脖子很长。(Tā de bózi hěn cháng.) / [Ngữ pháp: 可是] 猴子很小，可是它的尾巴很长。(Hóuzi hěn xiǎo, kěshì tā de wěiba hěn cháng.) / 老虎有四条腿。(Lǎohǔ yǒu sì tiáo tuǐ.)
zh.truyen: 猴子的尾巴 — 猴子很小，可是它的尾巴很长。长颈鹿很高，它的脖子很长。大象的鼻子也很长。老虎有四条腿。（Hóuzi hěn xiǎo, kěshì tā de wěiba hěn cháng. Chángjǐnglù hěn gāo, tā de bózi hěn cháng. Dàxiàng de bízi yě hěn cháng. Lǎohǔ yǒu sì tiáo tuǐ.）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "动物 身体 脖子 尾巴 儿歌"

en.flash: tall, short, very, so, neck, swing | Ôn: big, small, long, nose, tail, leg
en.slide: 1) Trò Cặp trái nghĩa: cô nói "tall", con nói "short"; cô nói "big", con nói "small"; cô nói "long", con nói "short". 2) Đố vật: một con tả "Its neck is long. It is very tall." – cả lớp đoán: It's a giraffe! 3) Kéo câu vào tranh (4 câu): The monkey is small, but its tail is long. / The elephant swings its nose. / The giraffe is so tall! / The snake is long.
en.truyen: Leo and the Giraffe — Leo is short. The giraffe is very tall. Its neck is long. Leo looks up. "You are so tall!" The giraffe swings its neck. "OK! Goodbye, giraffe!"
en.baihat: Long, Long, Long — Long, Long, Long (giai điệu Pop! Goes the Weasel) — đoạn 1: The elephant's nose is long, long, long, / the giraffe's neck is long, too, / the monkey's tail is long, long, long – / Hello, hello, zoo! · ôn đoạn 2: The tiger is big, the snake is long, / the monkey is small and cute, / the giraffe is tall, so very tall – / Hello, hello, zoo!

zh.flash: 矮 ǎi, 短 duǎn, 可是 kěshì, 脖子 bózi, 尾巴 wěiba, 腿 tuǐ, 它 tā | Ôn: 高 gāo, 长 cháng, 大 dà, 小 xiǎo
zh.slide: 1) Đối chiếu NL9: The giraffe is tall. ↔ 长颈鹿很高。 – chọn câu đúng (nhiễu: 长颈鹿是高。 / 长颈鹿很长。). 2) Ngắn hay thấp?: một chữ short, hai chữ Hán – tranh cây bút ngắn → 短, bạn nhỏ thấp → 矮 (6 tranh). 3) Chép 高 vào ô; tô 长: ông cụ tóc dài bay trong gió, 4 nét (phẩy, ngang, sổ hất, mác).
zh.truyen: Leo和长颈鹿 — Leo很矮。长颈鹿很高，它的脖子很长。Leo说：“你真高！”长颈鹿的尾巴很短。Leo说：“长颈鹿，再见！”（Leo hěn ǎi. Chángjǐnglù hěn gāo, tā de bózi hěn cháng. Leo shuō: “Nǐ zhēn gāo!” Chángjǐnglù de wěiba hěn duǎn. Leo shuō: “Chángjǐnglù, zàijiàn!”）
zh.baihat: Vè ZH: 大象大象鼻子长，长颈鹿呀脖子长，小猴子，尾巴长，大家一起晒太阳！ · 长长长 — 长长长 (giai điệu Pop! Goes the Weasel) — đoạn 1: 大象的鼻子长长长，/ 长颈鹿脖子也长，/ 小猴的尾巴长长长——/ 你好，动物园！ · ôn đoạn 2: 老虎很大，蛇很长，/ 小猴子很可爱，/ 长颈鹿很高，高又高——/ 你好，动物园！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 35. Unit 8 · At the zoo · 在动物园 – Làm quen: trò hướng dẫn viên; truyện đọc thêm; nói theo vần; chép 长

web.label: Ngày 69. Unit 8 · Sở thú và cửa hàng sở thú (nhóm 3, nối Unit 5): have got, tiền

en.tu: Mới: have got, has got, a lot of | Ôn (nối Unit 5): zoo, buy, first, then, thing | Ôn: hand, foot, arm
en.cum: have got a long neck / has got four legs / hasn't got legs / a lot of animals / buy things at the zoo shop
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: has got] The elephant has got a long nose. / [Ngữ pháp: hasn't got] The snake hasn't got legs. / I have got two hands. / First, we buy things at the zoo shop. Then, we see the lions. / Thanks! – OK!
en.truyen: The Zoo Shop — First, Leo and Xiaomei go to the zoo shop. They buy two things: a panda and a giraffe. The giraffe has got a long neck. "Thanks!" says Leo. Then they see a lot of animals.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "have got has got animals song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 钱 qián, 没有 méiyǒu | Ôn (nối Unit 5): 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 买 mǎi, 东西 dōngxi, 然后 ránhòu | Ôn: 多少 duōshao, 手 shǒu, 脚 jiǎo
zh.cum: 多少钱 duōshao qián / 没有腿 méiyǒu tuǐ / 买东西 mǎi dōngxi / 有很多动物 yǒu hěn duō dòngwù
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 有 / 没有] 蛇没有腿。(Shé méiyǒu tuǐ.) / 大象有长鼻子。(Dàxiàng yǒu cháng bízi.) / 这个熊猫多少钱？(Zhège xióngmāo duōshao qián?) / 我先买东西，然后看狮子。(Wǒ xiān mǎi dōngxi, ránhòu kàn shīzi.)
zh.truyen: 动物园的商店 — Leo和Xiaomei先去动物园的商店。Leo问：“这个熊猫多少钱？”他们买熊猫和长颈鹿。然后，他们去看很多动物。（Leo hé Xiaomei xiān qù dòngwùyuán de shāngdiàn. Leo wèn: “Zhège xióngmāo duōshao qián?” Tāmen mǎi xióngmāo hé chángjǐnglù. Ránhòu, tāmen qù kàn hěn duō dòngwù.）

web.label: Ngày 70. Unit 8 · Ôn không tranh, vòng Từ vựng + truyện 1 At the Zoo

It has got a long nose. 2) Âm /ʒ/ trong giraffe, âm /ɪ/ – /iː/ trong it's – tiger: nghe nhắc lại. 3) Có hay không có?: kéo has got / hasn't got vào 4 câu: The snake ___ legs. The giraffe ___ a long neck. The monkey ___ a long tail. The elephant ___ a long nose.
en.truyen: The Zoo Guide — Hello! This is the zoo. First, we see the elephants. They have got long noses. Then, we see the giraffe. It is very tall. The snake is long, but it hasn't got legs. Thanks!
en.baihat: Limerick: A tiger is big, a monkey is small, But a giraffe is the tallest of all! (vần small – all) · Long, Long, Long cả bài — Long, Long, Long (giai điệu Pop! Goes the Weasel) — đoạn 1: The elephant's nose is long, long, long, / the giraffe's neck is long, too, / the monkey's tail is long, long, long – / Hello, hello, zoo! · đoạn 2: The tiger is big, the snake is long, / the monkey is small and cute, / the giraffe is tall, so very tall – / Hello, hello, zoo! · ôn vè: Elephant, elephant, big and grey, Swing your long nose and come and play!

zh.flash: 钱 qián, 没有 méiyǒu | Ôn: 鼻子 bízi, 脖子 bózi, 尾巴 wěiba, 腿 tuǐ, 多少 duōshao, 动物园 dòngwùyuán
zh.slide: 1) Thanh điệu: 长 cháng (2), 短 duǎn (3), 高 gāo (1), 矮 ǎi (3) – nghe chọn đúng thanh. 2) 有 hay 没有?: 蛇___腿。(没有) / 长颈鹿___长脖子。(有) / 猴子___长尾巴。(有). 3) Chép 长 trong 长颈鹿 vào ô; hỏi sau bản tiếng Anh: 什么动物很高？
zh.truyen: 我们去看动物 — 你好！这是动物园。我们先看大象，它的鼻子很长。然后看长颈鹿，它很高。蛇很长，可是它没有腿。谢谢大家！（Nǐ hǎo! Zhè shì dòngwùyuán. Wǒmen xiān kàn dàxiàng, tā de bízi hěn cháng. Ránhòu kàn chángjǐnglù, tā hěn gāo. Shé hěn cháng, kěshì tā méiyǒu tuǐ. Xièxie dàjiā!）
zh.baihat: Limerick: 大象高，猴子矮，小蛇长长爬过来！(vần ǎi – lái) · 长长长 cả bài — 长长长 (giai điệu Pop! Goes the Weasel) — đoạn 1: 大象的鼻子长长长，/ 长颈鹿脖子也长，/ 小猴的尾巴长长长——/ 你好，动物园！ · đoạn 2: 老虎很大，蛇很长，/ 小猴子很可爱，/ 长颈鹿很高，高又高——/ 你好，动物园！ · ôn vè: 大象大象鼻子长，长颈鹿呀脖子长，小猴子，尾巴长，大家一起晒太阳！

zh.truyen: Leo去动物园 — Leo早上七点起床，吃早饭。然后他坐公共汽车去动物园。长颈鹿很高，大象很大。猴子很小，可是它的尾巴很长。Leo喜欢画画，他画动物。（Leo zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, chī zǎofàn. Ránhòu tā zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù dòngwùyuán. Chángjǐnglù hěn gāo, dàxiàng hěn dà. Hóuzi hěn xiǎo, kěshì tā de wěiba hěn cháng. Leo xǐhuan huàhuà, tā huà dòngwù.）

en.flash: Ôn Unit 5–8: home, school, shop, park, restaurant, zoo, cinema, library, hospital, doctor, chef, teacher, driver, nurse, employee, bus, bike, car, train, plane, taxi, elephant, giraffe, tiger, monkey, snake, tall, short | Ôn Unit 1–4: Monday, o'clock, get up, hobby
en.slide: 1) Ghép bản đồ: con dán nơi chốn (Unit 5), người làm việc (Unit 6), phương tiện và đường đi (Unit 7), sở thú (Unit 8) lên bản đồ lớn; mỗi con nói 1 câu: The doctor works at the hospital. / I take a bus to the zoo. 2) Nghe chọn tranh (8 câu, trộn 4 unit): Where are you going? / What does he do? / How do you go to school? / What animal is it? 3) Trò Chuyền bóng 4 câu hỏi: Where are you going? – What does your dad do? – How does he go to work? – What animal do you like?
en.truyen: Our Town — This is our town. There is a school, a hospital, a library and a zoo. Leo's dad is a driver. He drives a bus. Anna's dad is a doctor. He works at the hospital. On Saturday, we take a bus to the zoo to see the giraffe. It is very tall!
en.baihat: Ôn 4 bài hát Unit 5–8 — Where Are You Going?: Where are you going? / To the park! / I go to the park to play. / Play, play, play! · What Does Dad Do?: What does Dad do? / … He's a doctor, he works at a hospital. / Dad is a doctor! · How Do You Go to School?: This is the way I ride a bike, / … / I go to school by bike! · Long, Long, Long: The elephant's nose is long, long, long, / … / Hello, hello, zoo!

zh.flash: Ôn Unit 5–8: 家 jiā, 学校 xuéxiào, 商店 shāngdiàn, 公园 gōngyuán, 饭店 fàndiàn, 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 医院 yīyuàn, 医生 yīshēng, 厨师 chúshī, 司机 sījī, 员工 yuángōng, 公共汽车 gōnggòng qìchē, 自行车 zìxíngchē, 汽车 qìchē, 火车 huǒchē, 飞机 fēijī, 大象 dàxiàng, 长颈鹿 chángjǐnglù, 老虎 lǎohǔ, 猴子 hóuzi, 蛇 shé, 高 gāo, 矮 ǎi | Ôn Unit 1–4: 星期一 xīngqīyī, 几点 jǐ diǎn, 起床 qǐchuáng, 爱好 àihào
zh.slide: 1) Xếp vào nhóm theo chữ chung: 园 (公园, 动物园) / 店 (商店, 饭店) / 生 (学生, 医生) / 车 (汽车, 火车, 自行车) / 长 (长颈鹿). 2) Bắt bẫy tổng hợp (Đúng hay sai, 6 câu): 去家 / 他工作在医院 / 我坐自行车 / 长颈鹿是高 / 男孩很短 / 我去公园玩 (chỉ câu cuối đúng). 3) Chép lại 8 chữ Hán chặng 2: 家 门 生 工 车 走 高 长, mỗi chữ 1 ô.
zh.truyen: 我们的地方 — 这儿有学校、医院、图书馆和动物园。Leo的爸爸是司机，他开公共汽车。Anna的爸爸是医生，他在医院工作。星期六，我们坐公共汽车去动物园看长颈鹿。它很高！（Zhèr yǒu xuéxiào, yīyuàn, túshūguǎn hé dòngwùyuán. Leo de bàba shì sījī, tā kāi gōnggòng qìchē. Anna de bàba shì yīshēng, tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò. Xīngqīliù, wǒmen zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù dòngwùyuán kàn chángjǐnglù. Tā hěn gāo!）
zh.baihat: Ôn 4 bài hát Unit 5–8 — 你去哪儿？: 你去哪儿？/ 去公园！/ 我去公园玩。/ 玩，玩，玩！ · 爸爸做什么工作？: 他是医生，他在医院工作。/ 爸爸是医生！ · 你怎么去上学？: 我骑自行车，/ … / 我骑自行车去上学！ · 长长长: 大象的鼻子长长长，/ … / 你好，动物园！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 38. Tuần 19 · Ôn và kiểm tra chặng 2 (Unit 5–8) – Kiểm tra chặng 2 (Unit 5–8) và nói theo cặp

web.label: Ngày 75. Ôn chặng 2 · Luyện dạng đề Starters và YCT2 (nghe – đọc, mỗi phần ≤30 phút)

en.tu: Ôn (từ trong đề): shop, park, zoo, library, hospital, doctor, nurse, chef, driver, bus, car, bike, train, plane, giraffe, elephant, monkey, snake, tiger, tall, short, long
en.cum: go to the library / work at a hospital / take a bus / has got a long tail / on Sunday afternoon
en.cau: [Dạng Starters Listening Part 4 – nghe và tô màu] Colour the bus yellow. Colour the giraffe's neck orange. / [Dạng Starters Reading Part 2 – nhìn tranh, viết yes / no] The monkey has got a long tail. (yes) The snake has got legs. (no) / [Dạng Starters Reading Part 4 – điền từ] I go to the ___ to see animals. (zoo) / Where does the doctor work? At the hospital.
en.truyen: Test Story · Sunday Afternoon — On Sunday afternoon, Anna and her dad take a bus to the zoo. They see a tall giraffe and a long snake. Then they go to the library to read. Anna's dad is a doctor, but on Sunday he doesn't work.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Cambridge Pre A1 Starters listening practice places transport animals"

zh.tu: Ôn (từ trong đề): 商店 shāngdiàn, 公园 gōngyuán, 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 医院 yīyuàn, 医生 yīshēng, 厨师 chúshī, 司机 sījī, 公共汽车 gōnggòng qìchē, 自行车 zìxíngchē, 飞机 fēijī, 火车 huǒchē, 长颈鹿 chángjǐnglù, 大象 dàxiàng, 猴子 hóuzi, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 高 gāo, 矮 ǎi, 钱 qián
zh.cum: 去动物园 qù dòngwùyuán / 在医院工作 zài yīyuàn gōngzuò / 坐飞机 zuò fēijī / 多少钱 duōshao qián / 星期天下午 xīngqītiān xiàwǔ
zh.cau: [Dạng YCT2 听力 – nghe chọn tranh đúng/sai] 他坐飞机去北京。(Tā zuò fēijī qù Běijīng.) / [Dạng YCT2 听力 – nghe hội thoại chọn tranh] 你妈妈做什么工作？她是医生。(Nǐ māma zuò shénme gōngzuò? Tā shì yīshēng.) / [Dạng YCT2 阅读 – nối câu hỏi với câu trả lời] 你怎么去上学？— 我走路去。(Nǐ zěnme qù shàngxué? — Wǒ zǒulù qù.) / 这个熊猫多少钱？(Zhège xióngmāo duōshao qián?)
zh.truyen: 星期天下午 — 星期天下午，Anna和爸爸坐公共汽车去动物园。他们看长颈鹿和蛇。然后他们去图书馆看书。Anna的爸爸是医生，可是星期天他不工作。（Xīngqītiān xiàwǔ, Anna hé bàba zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù dòngwùyuán. Tāmen kàn chángjǐnglù hé shé. Ránhòu tāmen qù túshūguǎn kàn shū. Anna de bàba shì yīshēng, kěshì xīngqītiān tā bù gōngzuò.）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "YCT2 听力 练习 少儿汉语考试二级"

web.label: Ngày 76. Ôn chặng 2 · Chuyển ngữ và giải đố tổng hợp (NL1–NL8, PS-1 → PS-3)

en.tu: Ôn: place, thing, part, also, then, first, busy, dark, job, love, don't worry, oh dear, easy, round, boy, trip, lorry, truck, bear, zebra, lion, so, very, swing, a lot of
en.cum: a busy part of town / love my job / an easy trip / a lot of animals / so tall
en.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí] Xiaomei: "我爸爸坐火车去上海工作。" → Xiaomei's dad takes a train to Shanghai to work. / [PS-3] Leo doesn't take a bus. The boy on the bike is Leo. / Anna's mom is not a doctor. She works at a school. What does Anna's mom do? She is a teacher. / Oh dear! – Don't worry!
en.truyen: Who Goes Where? — Leo, Anna and Bông go to three places: the zoo, the library and the hospital. Anna doesn't go to the zoo. Bông goes to the hospital. Her mum is a nurse. Leo takes a bus to the zoo. Where does Anna go? To the library!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "logic puzzle for kids who goes where"

zh.tu: Ôn: 地方 dìfang, 东西 dōngxi, 人 rén, 零 líng, 然后 ránhòu, 散步 sànbù, 大家 dàjiā, 比 bǐ, 没关系 méi guānxi, 走 zǒu, 呢 ne, 不客气 bú kèqi, 斑马 bānmǎ, 狮子 shīzi, 熊 xióng, 没有 méiyǒu, 可是 kěshì
zh.cum: 一个人 yí ge rén / 爱我的工作 ài wǒ de gōngzuò / 你呢 nǐ ne / 有很多动物 yǒu hěn duō dòngwù / 比我高 bǐ wǒ gāo
zh.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí] Leo: "My mom rides a motorbike to work." → Leo的妈妈骑摩托车去上班。(Leo de māma qí mótuōchē qù shàngbān.) / [PS-3] Anna不去动物园。(Anna bú qù dòngwùyuán.) / Bông去医院，她妈妈是护士。(Bông qù yīyuàn, tā māma shì hùshi.) / 哥哥比我高。(Gēge bǐ wǒ gāo.)
zh.truyen: 谁去哪儿？ — Leo、Anna和Bông去三个地方：动物园、图书馆和医院。Anna不去动物园。Bông去医院，她妈妈是护士。Leo坐公共汽车去动物园。Anna去哪儿？她去图书馆！（Leo, Anna hé Bông qù sān ge dìfang: dòngwùyuán, túshūguǎn hé yīyuàn. Anna bú qù dòngwùyuán. Bông qù yīyuàn, tā māma shì hùshi. Leo zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù dòngwùyuán. Anna qù nǎr? Tā qù túshūguǎn!）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "儿童 逻辑 推理 谁去哪儿 中文"

en.flash: Từ trong bài kiểm tra: home, shop, park, zoo, library, hospital, restaurant, doctor, teacher, chef, driver, nurse, student, bus, bike, car, train, plane, taxi, elephant, giraffe, monkey, snake, tiger, lion, tall, short, long, big, small
en.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nghe (≤30 phút, dạng Starters Listening): nghe tên và nối người với nơi chốn (Anna – library, Leo – zoo, Bông – hospital); nghe chọn tranh 5 câu (How does she go to school? She takes a bus.). 2) Kiểm tra đọc (dạng Starters Reading): nhìn tranh viết yes / no (The giraffe is short. – no); điền từ: The chef works at a ___. (restaurant). 3) Nói theo cặp (dạng Starters Speaking): cô chỉ bản đồ hỏi Where are you going? / What does your dad do? / How do you go to school? / What animal is it?
en.truyen: Bông's Busy Week — On Monday morning, Bông takes a bus to school. On Wednesday afternoon, she walks to the library to study English. Her dad is a driver. He drives a taxi. On Saturday, they go to the zoo. The elephant has got a long nose!
en.baihat: Hát cả lớp sau bài kiểm tra: Where Are You Going? (đoạn Zoo): Where are you going? / To the zoo! / I go to the zoo to see animals. / See, see, see! · Long, Long, Long (đoạn 2): The tiger is big, the snake is long, / the monkey is small and cute, / the giraffe is tall, so very tall – / Hello, hello, zoo!

zh.flash: Từ trong bài kiểm tra: 家 jiā, 商店 shāngdiàn, 公园 gōngyuán, 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 医院 yīyuàn, 饭店 fàndiàn, 医生 yīshēng, 老师 lǎoshī, 厨师 chúshī, 司机 sījī, 学生 xuéshēng, 公共汽车 gōnggòng qìchē, 自行车 zìxíngchē, 汽车 qìchē, 火车 huǒchē, 飞机 fēijī, 大象 dàxiàng, 长颈鹿 chángjǐnglù, 猴子 hóuzi, 蛇 shé, 老虎 lǎohǔ, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 高 gāo, 矮 ǎi
zh.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nghe (≤30 phút, dạng YCT2 听力): nghe câu, chọn tranh đúng/sai (他骑自行车去上学。); nghe hội thoại chọn tranh (你爸爸在哪儿工作？他在饭店工作。). 2) Kiểm tra đọc (dạng YCT2 阅读): nối chữ Hán với tranh (医院, 动物园, 火车, 长颈鹿); chọn câu trả lời đúng: 你去哪儿？— A. 我去公园。 B. 我是医生。 3) Nói theo cặp: hỏi – đáp 3 câu bằng tiếng Trung theo tranh bản đồ; chép 4 chữ Hán do cô đọc: 家 车 高 工.
zh.truyen: Bông的一个星期 — 星期一早上，Bông坐公共汽车去上学。星期三下午，她走路去图书馆学习。她爸爸是司机，他开出租车。星期六，他们去动物园。大象的鼻子很长！（Xīngqīyī zǎoshang, Bông zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù shàngxué. Xīngqīsān xiàwǔ, tā zǒulù qù túshūguǎn xuéxí. Tā bàba shì sījī, tā kāi chūzūchē. Xīngqīliù, tāmen qù dòngwùyuán. Dàxiàng de bízi hěn cháng!）
zh.baihat: Hát cả lớp sau bài kiểm tra: 你去哪儿？(đoạn Zoo): 你去哪儿？/ 去动物园！/ 我去动物园看动物。/ 看，看，看！ · 长长长 (đoạn 2): 老虎很大，蛇很长，/ 小猴子很可爱，/ 长颈鹿很高，高又高——/ 你好，动物园！

blocks.title: Unit 9 · At the farm · 在农场

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 39. Unit 9 · At the farm – Ở nông trại · Gọi tên con vật, tiếng kêu hai nước; tô 牛

web.label: Ngày 77. Unit 9 · Con vật nông trại (nhóm 1a)

en.tu: Mới: pig, chicken, cow, sheep (one sheep – two sheep), farm | Ôn: animal, dog, cat, bird, farmer
en.cum: Mới: on the farm / oink oink / moo moo / baa baa / quack quack
en.cau: There is a pig on our farm. / What animal is this? – This is a cow. / Look! Two sheep! (sheep: số ít và số nhiều giống nhau)
en.truyen: Our Farm — This is our farm. There is a pig. There is a cow. There are two sheep and a chicken. The pig says, "Oink oink!" The cow says, "Moo!"
en.video: The Animals On The Farm – Super Simple Songs – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zXEq-QO3xTg

zh.tu: Mới: 猪 zhū, 鸡 jī, 牛 niú, 羊 yáng, 农场 nóngchǎng | Ôn: 动物 dòngwù, 狗 gǒu, 猫 māo, 鸟 niǎo
zh.cum: Mới: 在农场 zài nóngchǎng / 哼哼 hēnghēng / 哞 mōu / 咩 miē / 嘎嘎 gāgā
zh.cau: 农场里有一只猪。(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì zhī zhū.) / 这是什么动物？这是牛。(Zhè shì shénme dòngwù? Zhè shì niú.) / 看！两只羊！(Kàn! Liǎng zhī yáng!)
zh.truyen: 我们的农场 — 这是我们的农场。农场里有一只猪、一头牛、两只羊和一只鸡。小猪说：“哼哼！”牛说：“哞！”(Zhè shì wǒmen de nóngchǎng. Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì zhī zhū, yì tóu niú, liǎng zhī yáng hé yì zhī jī. Xiǎo zhū shuō: “Hēnghēng!” Niú shuō: “Mōu!”)
zh.video: 麦叔叔有个农场 – Giggling Panda – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eI1fsaFL5_w

web.label: Ngày 78. Unit 9 · Con vật nông trại (nhóm 1b) – tiếng kêu hai nước

en.tu: Mới: horse, goat, barn, cute | Ôn: duck, pig, chicken, cow, sheep, rabbit
en.cum: Mới: in the barn / a cute duck / a horse and a goat / NL9: oink ↔ 哼哼, moo ↔ 哞, baa ↔ 咩, quack ↔ 嘎嘎
en.cau: The horse is in the barn. / What animal is this? – This is a goat. / The duck is cute.
en.truyen: In the Barn — Look at the barn! The horse is in the barn. There is a goat in the barn. The duck says, "Quack quack!" The duck is cute.
en.video: Old MacDonald Had A Farm – Super Simple Songs – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_6HzoUcx3eo

zh.tu: Mới: 马 mǎ, 鸭子 yāzi, 山羊 shānyáng, 可爱 kě'ài | Ôn: 猪 zhū, 鸡 jī, 牛 niú, 羊 yáng, 兔子 tùzi
zh.cum: Mới: 一匹马 yì pǐ mǎ / 一只鸭子 yì zhī yāzi / 一只山羊 yì zhī shānyáng / 很可爱 hěn kě'ài
zh.cau: 马在农场里。(Mǎ zài nóngchǎng lǐ.) / 这是什么动物？这是山羊。(Zhè shì shénme dòngwù? Zhè shì shānyáng.) / 鸭子很可爱。(Yāzi hěn kě'ài.)
zh.truyen: 农场里的马 — 看，这是农场。农场里有一匹马和一只山羊。鸭子说：“嘎嘎！”鸭子很可爱。(Kàn, zhè shì nóngchǎng. Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì pǐ mǎ hé yì zhī shānyáng. Yāzi shuō: “Gāgā!” Yāzi hěn kě'ài.)
zh.video: 农场动物 – ChineseClass365 中文加油站 – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wQ2Q__242uQ

en.flash: Mới: pig, chicken, cow, sheep, farm, horse, goat, barn, cute | Ôn: duck, animal, dog, cat, rabbit
en.slide: 1) Nghe tiếng kêu chọn con vật (4 câu): oink → pig / moo → cow / baa → sheep / quack → duck. 2) Nhìn tranh chuồng trại chọn từ (6 tranh): pig / chicken / cow / sheep / horse / goat. 3) Trò Tiếng kêu hai nước: cô kêu "moo" hoặc “咩咩”, con giơ thẻ và nói: This is a cow. / This is a sheep.
en.truyen: Our Farm — Look! This is our farm. There is a pig and a cow. There are two sheep and a goat. The horse is in the barn. The chicken and the duck are cute. "Oink! Moo! Baa! Quack!"
en.baihat: On Our Farm (giai điệu Old MacDonald Had a Farm), đoạn Pig và Cow: On our farm there is a pig, / oink, oink, oink! / The pig is fat and very cute, / oink, oink, oink! // On our farm there is a cow, / moo, moo, moo! / The cow is big and gives us milk, / moo, moo, moo! · Vè: Pig is fat and cow is big, / Horse can run and dance a jig!

zh.flash: Mới: 猪 zhū, 鸡 jī, 牛 niú, 羊 yáng, 农场 nóngchǎng, 马 mǎ, 鸭子 yāzi, 山羊 shānyáng, 可爱 kě'ài | Ôn: 动物 dòngwù, 狗 gǒu, 猫 māo, 兔子 tùzi
zh.slide: 1) Nối tiếng kêu Anh – Trung (NL9, 4 cặp): oink – 哼哼 / moo – 哞 / baa – 咩 / quack – 嘎嘎. 2) Nghe chọn tranh (6 câu): 猪 / 鸡 / 牛 / 羊 / 马 / 鸭子. 3) Tô 牛 (niú): đầu bò nhìn thẳng có hai sừng, 4 nét phẩy – ngang – ngang – sổ; tìm 牛 trong 牛奶.
zh.truyen: 我们的农场 — 看！这是我们的农场。农场里有猪、牛、两只羊和一只山羊。马在农场里。小鸡和鸭子很可爱。“哼哼！哞！咩！嘎嘎！”(Kàn! Zhè shì wǒmen de nóngchǎng. Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu zhū, niú, liǎng zhī yáng hé yì zhī shānyáng. Mǎ zài nóngchǎng lǐ. Xiǎo jī hé yāzi hěn kě'ài. “Hēnghēng! Mōu! Miē! Gāgā!”)
zh.baihat: 农场里 (giai điệu Old MacDonald Had a Farm), đoạn 猪 và 牛: 农场里有一只猪，/ 哼哼哼！/ 小猪胖胖很可爱，/ 哼哼哼！(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì zhī zhū, hēng hēng hēng! Xiǎo zhū pàngpàng hěn kě'ài, hēng hēng hēng!) // 农场里有一头牛，/ 哞哞哞！/ 大大的牛给牛奶，/ 哞哞哞！(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì tóu niú, mōu mōu mōu! Dàdà de niú gěi niúnǎi, mōu mōu mōu!)

en.tu: Mới: fat, thin, pretty, ugly | Ôn: tall, short, very, elephant, giraffe
en.cum: Mới: very fat / very thin / very pretty / a fat pig / a thin sheep
en.cau: The pig is fat. / The sheep is very thin. / The giraffe is tall, but the pig is short. (nối Unit 8)
en.truyen: Fat and Thin — On the farm, the pig is very fat. The sheep is very thin. The pig says, "I am fat!" The sheep says, "I am thin!" They are good friends.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "fat and thin opposites song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 胖 pàng, 瘦 shòu, 漂亮 piàoliang, 丑 chǒu | Ôn: 大象 dàxiàng, 长颈鹿 chángjǐnglù, 矮 ǎi, 短 duǎn, 高 gāo
zh.cum: Mới: 很胖 hěn pàng / 很瘦 hěn shòu / 很漂亮 hěn piàoliang / 很丑 hěn chǒu
zh.cau: 猪很胖。(Zhū hěn pàng.) / 羊很瘦。(Yáng hěn shòu.) / 长颈鹿很高，小猪很矮。(Chángjǐnglù hěn gāo, xiǎo zhū hěn ǎi.) (nối Unit 8)
zh.truyen: 胖和瘦 — 农场里的猪很胖，羊很瘦。小猪说：“我很胖！”小羊说：“我很瘦！”它们是好朋友。(Nóngchǎng lǐ de zhū hěn pàng, yáng hěn shòu. Xiǎo zhū shuō: “Wǒ hěn pàng!” Xiǎo yáng shuō: “Wǒ hěn shòu!” Tāmen shì hǎo péngyou.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "胖 瘦 反义词 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 80. Unit 9 · Già – trẻ, nhỏ bé (nhóm 2b) – nối Unit 8

en.tu: Mới: young, old, mat, a little | Ôn: tiger, lion, neck, snake, have got
en.cum: Mới: an old horse / a young farmer / a little duckling / on the mat
en.cau: The horse is old. / The farmer is young. / The pig is on the mat. / The tiger has got a long tail. (nối Unit 8)
en.truyen: The Old Horse — The horse is old. He sits on a yellow mat. A little duckling runs and jumps on the mat. "Sorry!" says the duckling. "Don't worry," says the old horse.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "old and young opposites for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 年轻 niánqīng, 老 lǎo, 对不起 duìbuqǐ, 后 hòu | Ôn: 老虎 lǎohǔ, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 脖子 bózi, 尾巴 wěiba, 蛇 shé
zh.cum: Mới: 很老 hěn lǎo / 很年轻 hěn niánqīng / 小鸭子 xiǎo yāzi / 后来 hòulái / 对不起 duìbuqǐ
zh.cau: 这匹马很老。(Zhè pǐ mǎ hěn lǎo.) / 妈妈很年轻。(Māma hěn niánqīng.) / 对不起，小鸭子！(Duìbuqǐ, xiǎo yāzi!) / 老虎的尾巴很长。(Lǎohǔ de wěiba hěn cháng.) (nối Unit 8)
zh.truyen: 老马 — 这匹马很老。后来，一只小鸭子跑过来。小鸭子说：“对不起！”老马说：“没关系！”(Zhè pǐ mǎ hěn lǎo. Hòulái, yì zhī xiǎo yāzi pǎo guòlai. Xiǎo yāzi shuō: “Duìbuqǐ!” Lǎo mǎ shuō: “Méi guānxi!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "老 年轻 反义词 儿童中文"

en.flash: Mới: fat, thin, pretty, ugly, young, old, mat, a little | Ôn: pig, sheep, horse, tall, short
en.slide: 1) Trò Trái nghĩa (4 cặp): fat – thin / young – old / ugly – pretty / tall – short; cô nói một từ, con nói từ ngược lại. 2) Nhìn tranh chọn câu đúng (4 câu): The pig is fat. / The sheep is thin. / The horse is old. / The duckling is pretty. 3) Kéo thả con vật theo câu nghe (3 câu): The pig is on the mat. / The little duckling is on the mat. / The old horse is in the barn.
en.truyen: On the Yellow Mat — There is a fat pig on our farm. He sits all day on a yellow mat. The sheep is very thin. The horse is old. A little duckling comes. "Sorry!" says the duckling. "Don't worry!" says the pig. We say kind words to our friends.
en.baihat: On Our Farm, đoạn Sheep: On our farm there is a sheep, / baa, baa, baa! / The sheep is thin and very cute, / baa, baa, baa! · Vè ôn: Pig is fat and cow is big, / Horse can run and dance a jig!

zh.flash: Mới: 胖 pàng, 瘦 shòu, 漂亮 piàoliang, 丑 chǒu, 年轻 niánqīng, 老 lǎo, 对不起 duìbuqǐ, 后 hòu | Ôn: 猪 zhū, 羊 yáng, 马 mǎ, 高 gāo, 矮 ǎi
zh.slide: 1) Trò Trái nghĩa đổi tiếng (4 lượt): cô nói 瘦, con nói "fat"; cô nói "young", con nói 老; cô nói 漂亮, con nói "ugly". 2) Bắt bẫy NL4 (3 câu): young duckling → 小鸭子 hay 年轻鸭子? (đáp án 小鸭子; 年轻 dùng cho người: 妈妈很年轻。) 3) Chép 牛 trong 牛奶; tô 羊 (yáng): đầu cừu sừng cong, 6 nét chấm – phẩy – ngang – ngang – ngang – sổ.
zh.truyen: 黄垫子 — 我们的农场里有一只胖胖的猪。它一天都坐在黄垫子上。小羊很瘦，马很老。后来，一只小鸭子跑过来，说：“对不起！”小猪说：“没关系！”(Wǒmen de nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì zhī pàngpàng de zhū. Tā yì tiān dōu zuò zài huáng diànzi shàng. Xiǎo yáng hěn shòu, mǎ hěn lǎo. Hòulái, yì zhī xiǎo yāzi pǎo guòlai, shuō: “Duìbuqǐ!” Xiǎo zhū shuō: “Méi guānxi!”)
zh.baihat: 农场里, đoạn 羊: 农场里有一只羊，/ 咩咩咩！/ 小羊瘦瘦很可爱，/ 咩咩咩！(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì zhī yáng, miē miē miē! Xiǎo yáng shòushòu hěn kě'ài, miē miē miē!) · Vè ZH: 小猪胖胖，小羊瘦瘦，/ 老马老马慢慢走！(Xiǎo zhū pàngpàng, xiǎo yáng shòushòu, lǎo mǎ lǎo mǎ mànmàn zǒu!)

web.label: Ngày 81. Unit 9 · Vịt con và thiên nga (nhóm 3) – ôn tuần, PS-1

en.tu: Mới: swan, middle, duckling, grey | Ôn: big, small, milk, white, first, farmer
en.cum: Mới: a white swan / a grey duckling / lots of animals / cute animals / in the middle
en.cau: The animals are cute. / The duckling is pretty. / The cow gives us milk. / The pig is first. The horse is in the middle. / PS-1: “猪不瘦，它很胖。” → Is the pig fat or thin?
en.truyen: The Grey Duckling — The farmer has got lots of animals. The ducklings are cute. One little duckling is grey. One day, the grey duckling sees a big white swan. "Wow! The swan is pretty!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "The Ugly Duckling story for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 天鹅 tiān'é, 第一 dì-yī, 旁边 pángbiān, 中间 zhōngjiān | Ôn: 大 dà, 小 xiǎo, 牛奶 niúnǎi, 白 bái
zh.cum: Mới: 白天鹅 bái tiān'é / 动物们 dòngwùmen / 可爱的动物 kě'ài de dòngwù / 在羊的旁边 zài yáng de pángbiān / 第一个 dì-yī gè
zh.cau: 动物们很可爱。(Dòngwùmen hěn kě'ài.) / 小鸭子很漂亮。(Xiǎo yāzi hěn piàoliang.) / 牛给我们牛奶。(Niú gěi wǒmen niúnǎi.) / 猪是第一个，马在中间。(Zhū shì dì-yī gè, mǎ zài zhōngjiān.)
zh.truyen: 灰色的小鸭子 — 农场里有很多动物。小鸭子们很可爱。有一只小鸭子是灰色的。它的旁边有一只大白天鹅。“哇！天鹅真漂亮！”(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō dòngwù. Xiǎo yāzimen hěn kě'ài. Yǒu yì zhī xiǎo yāzi shì huīsè de. Tā de pángbiān yǒu yì zhī dà bái tiān'é. “Wa! Tiān'é zhēn piàoliang!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "丑小鸭 儿童故事 动画"

en.tu: Ôn: pig, chicken, cow, sheep, horse, goat, duck, barn, farm, cute
en.cum: Ôn: on the farm / in the barn / oink oink / moo moo / baa baa / quack quack
en.cau: The sheep is thin. / There is a cow on our farm. / This farm is ours. Their horse is old. / The white duck is hers.
en.truyen: Whose Farm? — Leo: "Is this your farm?" Xiaomei: "Yes! This farm is ours." Leo: "Their horse is old. Is the white duck yours?" Xiaomei: "No, the white duck is hers. It is Anna's."
en.video: Góc Luyện thêm: Lật thẻ tìm đôi con vật – tiếng kêu · Old MacDonald Had A Farm – Super Simple Songs – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_6HzoUcx3eo

zh.tu: Ôn: 猪 zhū, 鸡 jī, 牛 niú, 羊 yáng, 马 mǎ, 鸭子 yāzi, 山羊 shānyáng, 农场 nóngchǎng, 可爱 kě'ài
zh.cum: Ôn: 一只猪 yì zhī zhū / 一头牛 yì tóu niú / 一匹马 yì pǐ mǎ / 两只羊 liǎng zhī yáng / Xếp vào nhóm: cho sữa (牛 niú, 羊 yáng) · cho trứng (鸡 jī, 鸭子 yāzi) · khác (猪 zhū, 马 mǎ)
zh.cau: 小羊很瘦。(Xiǎo yáng hěn shòu.) / 农场里有一头牛。(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì tóu niú.) / 来，我们去农场！(Lái, wǒmen qù nóngchǎng!)
zh.truyen: 谁的农场？ — Leo：“这是你的农场吗？”Xiaomei：“是！这是我们的农场。”Leo：“他们的马很老。白鸭子是你的吗？”Xiaomei：“不是，白鸭子是Anna的。”(Leo: “Zhè shì nǐ de nóngchǎng ma?” Xiaomei: “Shì! Zhè shì wǒmen de nóngchǎng.” Leo: “Tāmen de mǎ hěn lǎo. Bái yāzi shì nǐ de ma?” Xiaomei: “Bú shì, bái yāzi shì Anna de.”)
zh.video: 麦叔叔有个农场 – Giggling Panda – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eI1fsaFL5_w

en.flash: Mới: swan, middle, duckling, grey | Ôn: farm, cute, milk, big, small, white, pig, horse
en.slide: 1) Kể truyện bằng tranh (5 tranh): sau mỗi câu con giơ gương mặt vịt con vui hoặc buồn. 2) Câu hỏi suy nghĩ: If you are the chicken, what do you say? – con chọn "You are ugly!" hay "You are my friend!" và giải thích vì sao. 3) Âm /ʃ/ và /tʃ/: nghe chọn sheep hay chicken (6 từ: sheep, ship, she, chicken, chair, chips).
en.truyen: The Ugly Duckling (truyện đọc thêm, cô kể bằng tranh) — On the farm, the ducklings are cute. One little duckling is grey. "You are ugly!" say the chickens. The little duckling is sad. He goes away. One day, he is a big white swan. He is very pretty!
en.baihat: Limerick: There was a pig who was very fat, / He sat all day on a yellow mat! (vần fat – mat) · On Our Farm cả bài: On our farm there is a pig, / oink, oink, oink! / The pig is fat and very cute, / oink, oink, oink! // On our farm there is a sheep, / baa, baa, baa! / The sheep is thin and very cute, / baa, baa, baa! // On our farm there is a cow, / moo, moo, moo! / The cow is big and gives us milk, / moo, moo, moo!

zh.flash: Mới: 天鹅 tiān'é, 第一 dì-yī, 旁边 pángbiān, 中间 zhōngjiān | Ôn: 农场 nóngchǎng, 可爱 kě'ài, 牛奶 niúnǎi, 白 bái, 马 mǎ, 羊 yáng
zh.slide: 1) Thanh điệu (4 câu): nghe chọn 猪 zhū (1) / 牛 niú (2) / 马 mǎ (3) / 瘦 shòu (4). 2) Xếp thẻ chuồng 3 ô theo câu nghe: 牛是第一个。马在中间。羊在马的旁边。 3) Tô 马 (mǎ): con ngựa phi, 3 nét ngang gập – sổ gập gập móc – ngang; chép 羊 vào ô.
zh.truyen: 丑小鸭（cô kể bằng tranh）— 农场里的小鸭子很可爱。有一只小鸭子是灰色的。小鸡们说：“你很丑！”小鸭子很难过，它走了。后来，它变成了一只白天鹅，很漂亮！(Nóngchǎng lǐ de xiǎo yāzi hěn kě'ài. Yǒu yì zhī xiǎo yāzi shì huīsè de. Xiǎo jīmen shuō: “Nǐ hěn chǒu!” Xiǎo yāzi hěn nánguò, tā zǒu le. Hòulái, tā biànchéngle yì zhī bái tiān'é, hěn piàoliang!)
zh.baihat: Limerick ZH: 小鸡小鸭真可爱，/ 叽叽嘎嘎跑过来！(Xiǎo jī xiǎo yā zhēn kě'ài, jījī gāgā pǎo guòlai!) (vần ài – lái) · 农场里 cả bài: 农场里有一只猪，/ 哼哼哼！/ 小猪胖胖很可爱，/ 哼哼哼！(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì zhī zhū, hēng hēng hēng! Xiǎo zhū pàngpàng hěn kě'ài, hēng hēng hēng!) // 农场里有一只羊，/ 咩咩咩！/ 小羊瘦瘦很可爱，/ 咩咩咩！(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì zhī yáng, miē miē miē! Xiǎo yáng shòushòu hěn kě'ài, miē miē miē!) // 农场里有一头牛，/ 哞哞哞！/ 大大的牛给牛奶，/ 哞哞哞！(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì tóu niú, mōu mōu mōu! Dàdà de niú gěi niúnǎi, mōu mōu mōu!)

en.cum: Ôn: very fat / very thin / an old horse / a little duckling / on the mat — Điền chỗ trống cả cụm: The pig is ___ (very fat).

zh.tu: Ôn: 农场 nóngchǎng, 可爱 kě'ài, 天鹅 tiān'é, 第一 dì-yī, 旁边 pángbiān, 中间 zhōngjiān, 牛奶 niúnǎi

zh.cau: 你是我的朋友！(Nǐ shì wǒ de péngyou!) / 小鸭子很高兴。(Xiǎo yāzi hěn gāoxìng.) / PS-3: 三只动物：猪、羊、马。一只很胖，一只很瘦，一只很老。马很老。羊不胖。(Sān zhī dòngwù: zhū, yáng, mǎ. Yì zhī hěn pàng, yì zhī hěn shòu, yì zhī hěn lǎo. Mǎ hěn lǎo. Yáng bú pàng.) → Which animal is fat?
zh.truyen: Truyện 2: 丑小鸭（新结尾）— 农场里的小鸭子很可爱。有一只小鸭子是灰色的。小鸡们说：“你很丑！”小鸭子很难过。然后小鸡们说：“对不起！你是我的朋友！”小鸭子很高兴。后来，它变成了一只白天鹅，很漂亮！(Nóngchǎng lǐ de xiǎo yāzi hěn kě'ài. Yǒu yì zhī xiǎo yāzi shì huīsè de. Xiǎo jīmen shuō: “Nǐ hěn chǒu!” Xiǎo yāzi hěn nánguò. Ránhòu xiǎo jīmen shuō: “Duìbuqǐ! Nǐ shì wǒ de péngyou!” Xiǎo yāzi hěn gāoxìng. Hòulái, tā biànchéngle yì zhī bái tiān'é, hěn piàoliang!)
zh.video: 麦叔叔有个农场 – Giggling Panda – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eI1fsaFL5_w (nghe liền với Old MacDonald)

en.flash: Ôn: pig, chicken, cow, sheep, horse, goat, duck, farm, barn, cute, fat, thin, young, old, ugly, pretty, swan, middle, mat, a little
en.slide: 1) Diễn truyện đổi kết: con đóng vai gà con, nói lời tử tế "Sorry! You are my friend!". 2) Người nông dân nhí (NL6): con giới thiệu chuồng bằng 2 câu (This is our farm. The pig is fat.), khách hỏi tiếng nào con đáp tiếng đó. 3) PS-3 trên lớp: chuồng 3 ô, manh mối tiếng Trung “猪不是第一个。”“牛在羊的旁边。”“羊不在中间。” → Which animal is in the middle? (con xếp thẻ trên bàn; đáp án: the cow).
en.truyen: The Ugly Duckling (đọc và diễn) — On the farm, the ducklings are cute. One little duckling is grey. "You are ugly!" say the chickens. The little duckling is sad. Then the chickens say, "Sorry! You are my friend!" The little duckling is happy. One day, he is a big white swan. He is very pretty!
en.baihat: On Our Farm cả bài (biểu diễn): On our farm there is a pig, / oink, oink, oink! / The pig is fat and very cute, / oink, oink, oink! // On our farm there is a sheep, / baa, baa, baa! / The sheep is thin and very cute, / baa, baa, baa! // On our farm there is a cow, / moo, moo, moo! / The cow is big and gives us milk, / moo, moo, moo! · Biểu diễn vè: Pig is fat and cow is big, / Horse can run and dance a jig! · Limerick: There was a pig who was very fat, / He sat all day on a yellow mat! (vần fat – mat)

zh.flash: Ôn: 猪 zhū, 鸡 jī, 牛 niú, 羊 yáng, 马 mǎ, 鸭子 yāzi, 农场 nóngchǎng, 可爱 kě'ài, 胖 pàng, 瘦 shòu, 年轻 niánqīng, 老 lǎo, 丑 chǒu, 漂亮 piàoliang, 天鹅 tiān'é, 第一 dì-yī, 旁边 pángbiān, 对不起 duìbuqǐ
zh.slide: 1) Đọc truyện có pinyin, sau mỗi câu chọn gương mặt vịt con (5 câu). 2) Giới thiệu chuồng bằng tiếng Trung: 这是我们的农场。小猪很胖。小羊很瘦。老马很老。 3) Giá trị và bản đồ: chê bạn xấu làm bạn buồn; nông trại cho sữa, trứng; thêm nông trại ngoại ô vào Bản đồ thành phố, chép 牛 羊 马 vào ô.
zh.truyen: 丑小鸭（đọc và diễn）— 农场里的小鸭子很可爱。有一只小鸭子是灰色的。小鸡们说：“你很丑！”小鸭子很难过。然后小鸡们说：“对不起！你是我的朋友！”小鸭子很高兴。后来，它变成了一只白天鹅，很漂亮！(Nóngchǎng lǐ de xiǎo yāzi hěn kě'ài. Yǒu yì zhī xiǎo yāzi shì huīsè de. Xiǎo jīmen shuō: “Nǐ hěn chǒu!” Xiǎo yāzi hěn nánguò. Ránhòu xiǎo jīmen shuō: “Duìbuqǐ! Nǐ shì wǒ de péngyou!” Xiǎo yāzi hěn gāoxìng. Hòulái, tā biànchéngle yì zhī bái tiān'é, hěn piàoliang!)
zh.baihat: 农场里 cả bài (biểu diễn): 农场里有一只猪，/ 哼哼哼！/ 小猪胖胖很可爱，/ 哼哼哼！(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì zhī zhū, hēng hēng hēng! Xiǎo zhū pàngpàng hěn kě'ài, hēng hēng hēng!) // 农场里有一只羊，/ 咩咩咩！/ 小羊瘦瘦很可爱，/ 咩咩咩！(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì zhī yáng, miē miē miē! Xiǎo yáng shòushòu hěn kě'ài, miē miē miē!) // 农场里有一头牛，/ 哞哞哞！/ 大大的牛给牛奶，/ 哞哞哞！(Nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yì tóu niú, mōu mōu mōu! Dàdà de niú gěi niúnǎi, mōu mōu mōu!) · Vè ZH: 小猪胖胖，小羊瘦瘦，/ 老马老马慢慢走！(Xiǎo zhū pàngpàng, xiǎo yáng shòushòu, lǎo mǎ lǎo mǎ mànmàn zǒu!) · Limerick ZH: 小鸡小鸭真可爱，/ 叽叽嘎嘎跑过来！(Xiǎo jī xiǎo yā zhēn kě'ài, jījī gāgā pǎo guòlai!) (vần ài – lái)

web.label: Ngày 85. Unit 10 · Cảnh vật ban ngày (nhóm 1a)

en.tu: Mới: tree, flower, grass, stone | Ôn: park, garden, forest, frog, bird
en.cum: Mới: a big tree / a flower / green grass / a big stone
en.cau: What can you see? – I can see a big tree. / I can see a flower. / The frog is on a big stone.
en.truyen: In the Park — Bông goes to the park. "What can you see?" asks Mom. "I can see a big tree and a flower," says Bông. A little frog is on a big stone. "Hello, frog!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "nature vocabulary song for kids tree flower grass"

zh.tu: Mới: 树 shù, 花 huā, 草 cǎo, 石头 shítou, 看见 kànjiàn | Ôn: 公园 gōngyuán, 鸟 niǎo, 绿 lǜ
zh.cum: Mới: 一棵大树 yì kē dà shù / 一朵花 yì duǒ huā / 绿绿的草 lǜlǜ de cǎo / 一块大石头 yí kuài dà shítou (từ đếm 棵, 朵, 块 chỉ nghe, chưa kiểm tra)
zh.cau: 你看见了什么？(Nǐ kànjiànle shénme?) / 我看见了一棵大树。(Wǒ kànjiànle yì kē dà shù.) / 我看见了一朵花。(Wǒ kànjiànle yì duǒ huā.)
zh.truyen: 在公园 — Bông去公园。妈妈问：“你看见了什么？”Bông说：“我看见了一棵大树和一朵花。”一只小鸟在大石头上。“小鸟，你好！”(Bông qù gōngyuán. Māma wèn: “Nǐ kànjiànle shénme?” Bông shuō: “Wǒ kànjiànle yì kē dà shù hé yì duǒ huā.” Yì zhī xiǎo niǎo zài dà shítou shàng. “Xiǎo niǎo, nǐ hǎo!”)
zh.video: The Nature Song 大自然 – Cool Panda Chinese Learning – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H2L43Sb7VSY

web.label: Ngày 86. Unit 10 · Sông, núi, biển (nhóm 1b)

en.tu: Mới: river, mountain, beach, sea, too | Ôn: tree, flower, swim, boat, fish
en.cum: Mới: a river / a mountain / on the beach / in the sea
en.cau: I can see a mountain. I can see a river, too. / We are on the beach. / The fish swim in the sea.
en.truyen: At the Sea — Leo goes to the beach. He can see the sea. There are lots of fish in the sea. He can see a mountain, too. "I love the beach!" says Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "river mountain sea beach song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 河 hé, 山 shān, 条 tiáo, 大海 dàhǎi, 海边 hǎibiān | Ôn: 树 shù, 花 huā, 游泳 yóuyǒng, 鱼 yú
zh.cum: Mới: 一条河 yì tiáo hé / 一座山 yí zuò shān / 在海边 zài hǎibiān / 在大海里 zài dàhǎi lǐ
zh.cau: 我看见了一座山。(Wǒ kànjiànle yí zuò shān.) / 那里还有一条河。(Nàlǐ hái yǒu yì tiáo hé.) / 鱼在大海里游泳。(Yú zài dàhǎi lǐ yóuyǒng.)
zh.truyen: 在海边 — Leo去海边。他看见了大海。大海里有很多鱼。那里还有一座山。Leo说：“我爱海边！”(Leo qù hǎibiān. Tā kànjiànle dàhǎi. Dàhǎi lǐ yǒu hěn duō yú. Nàlǐ hái yǒu yí zuò shān. Leo shuō: “Wǒ ài hǎibiān!”)
zh.video: 美丽的大自然（二）– JellybeanKids – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZB7dE4PL3cM

en.flash: Mới: tree, flower, grass, stone, river, mountain, beach, sea | Ôn: park, garden, forest, fish
en.slide: 1) Trò Ống nhòm: con nhìn qua ống giấy, nói I can see a tree. / I can see a river. (6 tranh: tree, flower, grass, stone, river, mountain). 2) Nghe chọn tranh (4 câu): a big tree / a flower / a river / a mountain. 3) Dán tranh phong cảnh chung: cô nói "a big stone", "the sea", con dán vào tranh.
en.truyen: The Camping Trip — Bông's family goes to the mountain. "What can you see?" asks Dad. "I can see a big tree," says Bông. "I can see a flower and a big stone." There is a river, too. "Look! A fish!"
en.baihat: Look Up High – nghe lần đầu: Look Up High (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star): Look up high into the sky, / Sun and moon and stars go by, / Mountain tall and river long, / Trees and flowers sing a song, / Look up high into the sky, / Sun and moon and stars go by! · Vè nghe trước: Sun in the day, moon at night, / Stars in the sky, shining bright!

zh.flash: Mới: 树 shù, 花 huā, 草 cǎo, 石头 shítou, 看见 kànjiàn, 河 hé, 山 shān, 条 tiáo, 大海 dàhǎi | Ôn: 公园 gōngyuán, 鱼 yú, 鸟 niǎo
zh.slide: 1) NL9 – từ đếm (nghe, chưa kiểm tra): nối 一棵 – 树 / 一朵 – 花 / 一条 – 河 / 一座 – 山; tiếng Anh chỉ dùng a / the. 2) Nghe chọn đúng (6 câu): 树 / 花 / 草 / 石头 / 河 / 山. 3) Tô 山 (shān): ba đỉnh núi, 3 nét sổ – sổ gập – sổ.
zh.truyen: 去山上 — Bông一家去山上。爸爸问：“你看见了什么？”Bông说：“我看见了一棵大树，还有一朵花和一块大石头。”那里还有一条河。“看！一条鱼！”(Bông yì jiā qù shān shàng. Bàba wèn: “Nǐ kànjiànle shénme?” Bông shuō: “Wǒ kànjiànle yì kē dà shù, hái yǒu yì duǒ huā hé yí kuài dà shítou.” Nàlǐ hái yǒu yì tiáo hé. “Kàn! Yì tiáo yú!”)
zh.baihat: 抬头看看大天空 (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star): 抬头看看大天空，/ 太阳月亮和星星，/ 高高的山长长河，/ 小树小花和小草，/ 抬头看看大天空，/ 太阳月亮和星星！(Táitóu kànkan dà tiānkōng, tàiyáng yuèliang hé xīngxing, gāogāo de shān chángcháng hé, xiǎo shù xiǎo huā hé xiǎo cǎo, táitóu kànkan dà tiānkōng, tàiyáng yuèliang hé xīngxing!) · Vè ZH: 山上有树，树下有花，/ 河边有草，草上有娃！(Shān shàng yǒu shù, shù xià yǒu huā, hé biān yǒu cǎo, cǎo shàng yǒu wá!)

web.label: Ngày 87. Unit 10 · Bầu trời (nhóm 2a) – nối Unit 9

en.tu: Mới: sun, moon, star (stars), sky | Ôn: farm, cow, horse, sheep, pretty
en.cum: Mới: in the sky / the moon and the stars / see the sun / bright stars
en.cau: I can see the moon and the stars. / The sun is in the sky. / The sun is over the farm. The cow and the sheep can see it. (nối Unit 9)
en.truyen: Good Morning, Farm — The sun is in the sky. The cow says, "Moo!" The sheep says, "Baa!" The old horse can see the sun. "Good morning, sun!" The sky is pretty.
en.video: The Sun, Moon & Stars Song – English Through Music – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iF_ukhQrsiE

zh.tu: Mới: 太阳 tàiyáng, 月亮 yuèliang, 星星 xīngxing, 天空 tiānkōng | Ôn: 农场 nóngchǎng, 牛 niú, 马 mǎ, 羊 yáng, 漂亮 piàoliang
zh.cum: Mới: 在天空中 zài tiānkōng zhōng / 月亮和星星 yuèliang hé xīngxing / 看见太阳 kànjiàn tàiyáng / 亮晶晶的星星 liàngjīngjīng de xīngxing
zh.cau: 我看见了月亮和星星。(Wǒ kànjiànle yuèliang hé xīngxing.) / 太阳在天空中。(Tàiyáng zài tiānkōng zhōng.) / 农场里的老马看见了太阳。(Nóngchǎng lǐ de lǎo mǎ kànjiànle tàiyáng.) (nối Unit 9)
zh.truyen: 农场的早上 — 太阳在天空中。牛说：“哞！”羊说：“咩！”老马看见了太阳：“太阳，早上好！”天空很漂亮。(Tàiyáng zài tiānkōng zhōng. Niú shuō: “Mōu!” Yáng shuō: “Miē!” Lǎo mǎ kànjiànle tàiyáng: “Tàiyáng, zǎoshang hǎo!” Tiānkōng hěn piàoliang.)
zh.video: The Nature Song 大自然 – Cool Panda Chinese Learning – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H2L43Sb7VSY

web.label: Ngày 88. Unit 10 · Ngày và đêm (nhóm 2b) – nối Unit 9

en.tu: Mới: night, cloud, in the day, at night | Ôn: evening, cloudy, sunny, swan, chicken
en.cum: Mới: in the day / at night / a white cloud / a little cloud
en.cau: You can see the sun in the day. / You can see the moon at night. / There is a fat white cloud in the sky. It is like a swan! (nối Unit 9)
en.truyen: The Cloud Swan — It is sunny. There is a white cloud in the sky. "Look! It is a swan!" says Anna. At night, the cloud goes away. Anna can see the moon.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "day and night song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 白天 báitiān, 可以 kěyǐ, 白云 báiyún, 亮晶晶 liàngjīngjīng | Ôn: 晚上 wǎnshang, 云 yún, 天鹅 tiān'é, 胖 pàng, 鸡 jī
zh.cum: Mới: 在白天 zài báitiān / 在晚上 zài wǎnshang / 一朵白云 yì duǒ báiyún / 可以看见 kěyǐ kànjiàn
zh.cau: 白天可以看见太阳。(Báitiān kěyǐ kànjiàn tàiyáng.) / 晚上可以看见月亮。(Wǎnshang kěyǐ kànjiàn yuèliang.) / 天空中有一朵胖胖的白云，像一只天鹅！(Tiānkōng zhōng yǒu yì duǒ pàngpàng de báiyún, xiàng yì zhī tiān'é!) (nối Unit 9)
zh.truyen: 白云天鹅 — 今天天气很好。天空中有一朵白云。Anna说：“看！是一只天鹅！”晚上，白云走了。Anna看见了月亮。(Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo. Tiānkōng zhōng yǒu yì duǒ báiyún. Anna shuō: “Kàn! Shì yì zhī tiān'é!” Wǎnshang, báiyún zǒu le. Anna kànjiànle yuèliang.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "白天 晚上 儿歌 太阳 月亮"

en.flash: Mới: sun, moon, star, sky, night, cloud, in the day, at night | Ôn: evening, morning, sunny, farm
en.slide: 1) Trò Ngày hay đêm?: cô nói từ, con đứng dưới bảng mặt trời hoặc mặt trăng (8 từ: sun, moon, stars, sky, cloud, night, morning, evening). 2) Nghe chọn câu đúng với tranh (4 câu): I can see the moon and the stars. / The sun is in the sky. / You can see the sun in the day. / You can see the moon at night. 3) Đọc vè theo nhịp vỗ tay: Sun in the day, moon at night.
en.truyen: Day and Night — In the day, the sun is in the sky. Anna can see a white cloud. At night, the cloud goes away. Anna can see the moon and the stars. "Good night, moon!" says Anna.
en.baihat: Look Up High – hát cùng: Look Up High (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star): Look up high into the sky, / Sun and moon and stars go by, / Mountain tall and river long, / Trees and flowers sing a song, / Look up high into the sky, / Sun and moon and stars go by! · Vè EN: Sun in the day, moon at night, / Stars in the sky, shining bright!

zh.flash: Mới: 太阳 tàiyáng, 月亮 yuèliang, 星星 xīngxing, 天空 tiānkōng, 白天 báitiān, 可以 kěyǐ, 白云 báiyún | Ôn: 晚上 wǎnshang, 早上 zǎoshang, 云 yún
zh.slide: 1) Bắt bẫy NL4 (3 câu): 星期 có phải là "stars" không? (không, 星期 là tuần; ngôi sao là 星星; hai từ chung chữ 星). 2) Xếp vào nhóm Ngày hay đêm? (6 thẻ): 太阳, 白云, 白天 / 月亮, 星星, 晚上. 3) Chép 山; tô 木 (mù): thân, cành, rễ, 4 nét ngang – sổ – phẩy – mác.
zh.truyen: 白天和晚上 — 白天，太阳在天空中。Anna看见了一朵白云。晚上，白云走了。Anna看见了月亮和星星。Anna说：“月亮，晚安！”(Báitiān, tàiyáng zài tiānkōng zhōng. Anna kànjiànle yì duǒ báiyún. Wǎnshang, báiyún zǒu le. Anna kànjiànle yuèliang hé xīngxing. Anna shuō: “Yuèliang, wǎn'ān!”)
zh.baihat: 抬头看看大天空 (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star): 抬头看看大天空，/ 太阳月亮和星星，/ 高高的山长长河，/ 小树小花和小草，/ 抬头看看大天空，/ 太阳月亮和星星！(Táitóu kànkan dà tiānkōng, tàiyáng yuèliang hé xīngxing, gāogāo de shān chángcháng hé, xiǎo shù xiǎo huā hé xiǎo cǎo, táitóu kànkan dà tiānkōng, tàiyáng yuèliang hé xīngxing!) · Vè ZH ôn: 山上有树，树下有花，/ 河边有草，草上有娃！(Shān shàng yǒu shù, shù xià yǒu huā, hé biān yǒu cǎo, cǎo shàng yǒu wá!)

web.label: Ngày 89. Unit 10 · Đi chơi lúc nào, ở đâu (nhóm 3, nối Unit 1, 3, 5) – ôn tuần, PS-1

en.tu: Mới: see, through, into, nature, pick | Ôn: Saturday, morning, evening, nine o'clock, park, mountain
en.cum: Mới: go to the mountain / on Saturday morning / at nine in the evening / walk through the trees / Hi! – Pardon?
en.cau: In the day, I can see the sun. / In the evening, she can see the stars. / On Saturday, we go to the mountain. / We walk through the trees and into the park. / PS-1: “我没看见月亮，我看见了太阳。” → Is it day or night?
en.truyen: Saturday Morning — On Saturday morning, Leo and Dad go to the mountain. They walk through the trees. "Hi, Leo!" says Bông. "Pardon?" says Leo. "Hi!" says Bông again. They go into the park together. "We love nature!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "What can you see song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 还 hái, 爬山 páshān, 大自然 dàzìrán, 摘 zhāi | Ôn: 星期六 xīngqīliù, 早上 zǎoshang, 晚上 wǎnshang, 九点 jiǔ diǎn, 公园 gōngyuán
zh.cum: Mới: 去山上 qù shān shàng / 星期六早上 xīngqīliù zǎoshang / 晚上九点 wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn / 去爬山 qù páshān — chống lỗi: 星期 là tuần, ngôi sao là 星星
zh.cau: 白天，我看见了太阳。(Báitiān, wǒ kànjiànle tàiyáng.) / 晚上，Bông看见了星星。(Wǎnshang, Bông kànjiànle xīngxing.) / 星期六，我们去山上。(Xīngqīliù, wǒmen qù shān shàng.) / 我们还去公园。(Wǒmen hái qù gōngyuán.)
zh.truyen: 星期六早上 — 星期六早上，Leo和爸爸去爬山。山上有很多树。Bông说：“Leo，你好！”Leo说：“什么？”Bông又说：“你好！”他们还一起去公园。“我们爱大自然！”(Xīngqīliù zǎoshang, Leo hé bàba qù páshān. Shān shàng yǒu hěn duō shù. Bông shuō: “Leo, nǐ hǎo!” Leo shuō: “Shénme?” Bông yòu shuō: “Nǐ hǎo!” Tāmen hái yìqǐ qù gōngyuán. “Wǒmen ài dàzìrán!”)

en.tu: Ôn: tree, flower, grass, stone, river, mountain, beach, sea
en.cum: Ôn: a big tree / a flower / a river / a mountain / on the beach — Xếp vào nhóm: grows (tree, flower, grass) / doesn't grow (stone, river, mountain)
en.cau: I can see a river. / The flower is pretty. (ôn Unit 9) / There are lots of flowers. They are not ours. They are theirs.
en.truyen: Whose Flowers? — Leo and Anna are on the mountain. There are lots of flowers. "Can I pick them?" asks Leo. "No! They are not ours. They are theirs," says Anna. Anna looks at the two farmers. "OK!" says Leo.

zh.tu: Ôn: 树 shù, 花 huā, 草 cǎo, 石头 shítou, 河 hé, 山 shān, 看见 kànjiàn, 大海 dàhǎi
zh.cum: Ôn: 一棵大树 yì kē dà shù / 一朵花 yì duǒ huā / 一条河 yì tiáo hé / 一座山 yí zuò shān — Xếp vào nhóm: mọc lên (树, 花, 草) / không mọc (石头, 河, 山)
zh.cau: 我看见了一条河。(Wǒ kànjiànle yì tiáo hé.) / 花很漂亮。(Huā hěn piàoliang.) (ôn Unit 9) / 山上有很多花。(Shān shàng yǒu hěn duō huā.)
zh.truyen: 谁的花？ — Leo和Anna在山上。山上有很多花。Leo问：“我可以摘花吗？”Anna说：“不可以！花不是我们的。”Leo说：“好！”(Leo hé Anna zài shān shàng. Shān shàng yǒu hěn duō huā. Leo wèn: “Wǒ kěyǐ zhāi huā ma?” Anna shuō: “Bù kěyǐ! Huā bú shì wǒmen de.” Leo shuō: “Hǎo!”)

en.flash: Mới: see, through, into | Ôn: tree, flower, grass, stone, river, mountain, Saturday, morning, evening
en.slide: 1) Đêm cắm trại: cô tắt đèn giả ban đêm, con giơ thẻ những gì nhìn thấy và nói I can see the moon. / I can see the stars. 2) Nói theo vần limerick (tree – me), con chỉ tranh theo lời. 3) Âm /st/ trong stars, stone, story: nghe chọn từ có /st/ (6 từ: stars, stone, sun, story, sky, sea).
en.truyen: A Night on the Mountain (truyện đọc thêm, cô kể khi tắt đèn) — It is Saturday. Bông's family is on the mountain. It is nine o'clock in the evening. Bông looks at the sky. She can see the moon. She can see lots of stars, too. "Good night, stars!"
en.baihat: Limerick: I see a flower, I see a tree, / I see a river – and it sees me! (vần tree – me) · Look Up High cả bài: Look Up High (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star): Look up high into the sky, / Sun and moon and stars go by, / Mountain tall and river long, / Trees and flowers sing a song, / Look up high into the sky, / Sun and moon and stars go by!

zh.flash: Mới: 还 hái, 爬山 páshān | Ôn: 树 shù, 花 huā, 草 cǎo, 石头 shítou, 河 hé, 山 shān, 看见 kànjiàn, 星期六 xīngqīliù, 九点 jiǔ diǎn
zh.slide: 1) Bốn thanh qua cảnh vật (4 câu): nghe chọn 山 shān (1) / 河 hé (2) / 草 cǎo (3) / 树 shù (4). 2) Dán tranh phong cảnh chung theo lời cô: 一棵大树 / 一条河 / 一座山 / 一朵花. 3) Chép 木; tô 石 (shí): vách núi 厂 và hòn đá 口, 5 nét ngang – phẩy – sổ – ngang gập – ngang.
zh.truyen: 山上的晚上（cô kể khi tắt đèn）— 今天星期六。Bông一家在山上。现在晚上九点。Bông看天空。她看见了月亮，还看见了很多星星。“星星，晚安！”(Jīntiān xīngqīliù. Bông yì jiā zài shān shàng. Xiànzài wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn. Bông kàn tiānkōng. Tā kànjiànle yuèliang, hái kànjiànle hěn duō xīngxing. “Xīngxing, wǎn'ān!”)
zh.baihat: Limerick ZH: 天上星星亮晶晶，/ 月亮弯弯照山林！(Tiān shàng xīngxing liàngjīngjīng, yuèliang wānwān zhào shānlín!) (vần jīng – lín) · 抬头看看大天空 (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star): 抬头看看大天空，/ 太阳月亮和星星，/ 高高的山长长河，/ 小树小花和小草，/ 抬头看看大天空，/ 太阳月亮和星星！(Táitóu kànkan dà tiānkōng, tàiyáng yuèliang hé xīngxing, gāogāo de shān chángcháng hé, xiǎo shù xiǎo huā hé xiǎo cǎo, táitóu kànkan dà tiānkōng, tàiyáng yuèliang hé xīngxing!)

web.label: Ngày 91. Unit 10 · Đảo ôn ngày 87–88 – vòng Câu + nghe, truyện 1, PS-2

en.tu: Ôn: sun, moon, star, sky, night, cloud, in the day, at night
en.cum: Ôn: in the sky / the moon and the stars / see the sun / a white cloud — Điền chỗ trống cả cụm: I can see ___ (the moon and the stars).
en.cau: You can see the sun in the day. / You can see the moon at night. / PS-2: “白天可以看见太阳，晚上可以看见月亮。” → It's nine o'clock in the evening. What can you see?
en.truyen: Truyện 1: On the Mountain — Bông's family goes to the mountain. In the day, Bông can see the sun, trees and flowers. There is a river, too. In the evening, she can see the moon and the stars in the sky.

zh.tu: Ôn: 太阳 tàiyáng, 月亮 yuèliang, 星星 xīngxing, 天空 tiānkōng, 白天 báitiān, 可以 kěyǐ, 白云 báiyún
zh.cum: Ôn: 在天空中 zài tiānkōng zhōng / 月亮和星星 yuèliang hé xīngxing / 看见太阳 kànjiàn tàiyáng — Điền chỗ trống: 我看见了___。(月亮和星星)
zh.cau: 白天可以看见太阳。(Báitiān kěyǐ kànjiàn tàiyáng.) / 晚上可以看见月亮。(Wǎnshang kěyǐ kànjiàn yuèliang.) / NL5: nghe truyện ZH → What can Bông see in the evening?
zh.truyen: Truyện 1: 在山上 — Bông一家去山上。白天，Bông看见了太阳、树和花。那里还有一条河。晚上，她看见了天空中的月亮和星星。(Bông yì jiā qù shān shàng. Báitiān, Bông kànjiànle tàiyáng, shù hé huā. Nàlǐ hái yǒu yì tiáo hé. Wǎnshang, tā kànjiànle tiānkōng zhōng de yuèliang hé xīngxing.)

en.tu: Ôn: see, Saturday, morning, evening, mountain, flower, river, stars
en.cum: Ôn: the moon and the stars in the sky / go to the mountain on Saturday morning / go to the mountain to see the stars
en.cau: Don't pick the flowers. / We love nature. / PS-3: Three photos. “A照片没有山。”“C照片是晚上。” → Which photo has the moon?
en.truyen: Truyện 2: On the Mountain – thêm câu — On Saturday morning, Bông's family goes to the mountain. In the day, Bông can see the sun, trees and flowers. There is a river, too. Bông doesn't pick the flowers. In the evening, she can see the moon and the stars in the sky.

zh.tu: Ôn: 看见 kànjiàn, 星期六 xīngqīliù, 早上 zǎoshang, 晚上 wǎnshang, 山 shān, 花 huā, 河 hé, 星星 xīngxing
zh.cum: Ôn: 天空中的月亮和星星 tiānkōng zhōng de yuèliang hé xīngxing / 星期六早上去山上 xīngqīliù zǎoshang qù shān shàng / 去山上看星星 qù shān shàng kàn xīngxing
zh.cau: 不要摘花。(Bú yào zhāi huā.) / 我们爱大自然。(Wǒmen ài dàzìrán.) / PS-3: A照片没有山。C照片是晚上。(A zhàopiàn méiyǒu shān. C zhàopiàn shì wǎnshang.) → Which photo has the moon?
zh.truyen: Truyện 2: 在山上（加句）— 星期六早上，Bông一家去山上。白天，Bông看见了太阳、树和花。那里还有一条河。Bông不摘花。晚上，她看见了天空中的月亮和星星。(Xīngqīliù zǎoshang, Bông yì jiā qù shān shàng. Báitiān, Bông kànjiànle tàiyáng, shù hé huā. Nàlǐ hái yǒu yì tiáo hé. Bông bù zhāi huā. Wǎnshang, tā kànjiànle tiānkōng zhōng de yuèliang hé xīngxing.)

en.flash: Ôn: tree, flower, grass, stone, river, mountain, beach, sea, sun, moon, star, sky, night, cloud, see, Saturday, morning, evening
en.slide: 1) Đọc và diễn On the Mountain: con đóng vai Bông, chỉ lên trời khi nói The moon and the stars. 2) Kể chuyến đi (NL6): kể cho Leo bằng tiếng Anh: On Saturday, I go to the park. I can see a big tree. 3) PS-3 trên lớp: 3 bức ảnh cắm trại, manh mối "There is no river in photo A." "Photo C is at night." "You can see the river in the day." → “哪张照片有河？” (đáp án: B).
en.truyen: On the Mountain (đọc và diễn) — On Saturday morning, Bông's family goes to the mountain. In the day, Bông can see the sun, trees and flowers. There is a river, too. Bông doesn't pick the flowers. In the evening, she can see the moon and the stars in the sky.
en.baihat: Look Up High cả bài (biểu diễn, làm động tác chỉ trời, núi, sông, hoa): Look Up High (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star): Look up high into the sky, / Sun and moon and stars go by, / Mountain tall and river long, / Trees and flowers sing a song, / Look up high into the sky, / Sun and moon and stars go by! · Biểu diễn vè: Sun in the day, moon at night, / Stars in the sky, shining bright! · Limerick: I see a flower, I see a tree, / I see a river – and it sees me! (vần tree – me)

zh.flash: Ôn: 树 shù, 花 huā, 草 cǎo, 石头 shítou, 河 hé, 山 shān, 太阳 tàiyáng, 月亮 yuèliang, 星星 xīngxing, 天空 tiānkōng, 白天 báitiān, 看见 kànjiàn, 可以 kěyǐ, 条 tiáo
zh.slide: 1) Đọc truyện có pinyin, kéo vật vào cột 白天 hoặc 晚上 (6 thẻ: 太阳, 树, 花, 河, 月亮, 星星). 2) Kể chuyến đi cho Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (NL6): 星期六，我去……我看见了…… 3) Giá trị và bản đồ: không hái hoa, không xả rác xuống sông; thêm núi, sông vào Bản đồ thành phố, chép 山 木 石.
zh.truyen: 在山上（đọc và diễn）— 星期六早上，Bông一家去山上。白天，Bông看见了太阳、树和花。那里还有一条河。Bông不摘花。晚上，她看见了天空中的月亮和星星。(Xīngqīliù zǎoshang, Bông yì jiā qù shān shàng. Báitiān, Bông kànjiànle tàiyáng, shù hé huā. Nàlǐ hái yǒu yì tiáo hé. Bông bù zhāi huā. Wǎnshang, tā kànjiànle tiānkōng zhōng de yuèliang hé xīngxing.)
zh.baihat: 抬头看看大天空 (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star): 抬头看看大天空，/ 太阳月亮和星星，/ 高高的山长长河，/ 小树小花和小草，/ 抬头看看大天空，/ 太阳月亮和星星！(Táitóu kànkan dà tiānkōng, tàiyáng yuèliang hé xīngxing, gāogāo de shān chángcháng hé, xiǎo shù xiǎo huā hé xiǎo cǎo, táitóu kànkan dà tiānkōng, tàiyáng yuèliang hé xīngxing!) · Vè ZH: 山上有树，树下有花，/ 河边有草，草上有娃！(Shān shàng yǒu shù, shù xià yǒu huā, hé biān yǒu cǎo, cǎo shàng yǒu wá!) · Limerick ZH: 天上星星亮晶晶，/ 月亮弯弯照山林！(Tiān shàng xīngxing liàngjīngjīng, yuèliang wānwān zhào shānlín!) (vần jīng – lín)

web.label: Ngày 93. Unit 11 · Sáu vị trí quanh cái hộp (nhóm 1a)

en.tu: Mới: box, top, front (in front of), next (next to), behind | Ôn: on, under, in, me, ball
en.cum: Mới: in the box / on top of the box / in front of me / behind me / next to me
en.cau: Where is the cat? – The cat is next to me. / The ball is in the box. / The ball is on top of the box. / The ball is behind me.
en.truyen: Where Is the Ball? — Leo has got a red ball. "Where is my ball?" Is it in the box? No. Is it behind me? No. Look! The ball is on top of the box!
en.video: In Front of, Behind, Between – Maple Leaf Learning – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xERTESWbqhU

zh.tu: Mới: 盒子 hézi, 上边 shàngbian, 里面 lǐmiàn, 前面 qiánmiàn, 后面 hòumiàn | Ôn: 上 shàng, 下 xià, 旁边 pángbiān, 球 qiú
zh.cum: Mới: 在盒子里面 zài hézi lǐmiàn / 在盒子上边 zài hézi shàngbian / 我前面 wǒ qiánmiàn / 我后面 wǒ hòumiàn / 我旁边 wǒ pángbiān
zh.cau: 猫在哪儿？猫在我旁边。(Māo zài nǎr? Māo zài wǒ pángbiān.) / 球在盒子里面。(Qiú zài hézi lǐmiàn.) / 球在盒子上边。(Qiú zài hézi shàngbian.) / 球在我后面。(Qiú zài wǒ hòumiàn.)
zh.truyen: 球在哪儿？ — Leo有一个红色的球。“我的球在哪儿？”在盒子里面吗？不在。在我后面吗？不在。看！球在盒子上边！(Leo yǒu yí gè hóngsè de qiú. “Wǒ de qiú zài nǎr?” Zài hézi lǐmiàn ma? Bú zài. Zài wǒ hòumiàn ma? Bú zài. Kàn! Qiú zài hézi shàngbian!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "前面 后面 里面 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 94. Unit 11 · Gấu bông đi đâu? (nhóm 1b)

en.tu: Mới: teddy (teddy bear), put, stand, stop | Ôn: chair, table, under, next to
en.cum: Mới: put my teddy in front / stand behind Leo / under my chair / time to stop
en.cau: I put my teddy next to me. / Stand behind Leo! / Stand in front of Anna! / Stop!
en.truyen: Teddy Game — Anna has got a teddy bear. "I put my teddy under my chair," says Anna. "Now stand behind me, Leo!" Leo stands behind Anna. "Stop! Well done!"
en.video: In On Under Song – English Vitamin Bubbles – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dupaTS-c8Xc (ôn on, under)

zh.tu: Mới: 小熊 xiǎoxióng, 放 fàng, 站 zhàn, 前 qián | Ôn: 椅子 yǐzi, 桌子 zhuōzi, 下 xià, 旁边 pángbiān
zh.cum: Mới: 放在我前面 fàng zài wǒ qiánmiàn / 站在Leo后面 zhàn zài Leo hòumiàn / 放在椅子下面 fàng zài yǐzi xiàmiàn / 往前走 wǎng qián zǒu
zh.cau: 小熊放在我旁边。(Xiǎoxióng fàng zài wǒ pángbiān.) / 站在Leo后面！(Zhàn zài Leo hòumiàn!) / 站在Xiaomei前面！(Zhàn zài Xiaomei qiánmiàn!) / 往前走！(Wǎng qián zǒu!)
zh.truyen: 小熊游戏 — Anna有一只小熊。Anna说：“我把小熊放在椅子下面。Leo，站在我后面！”Leo站在Anna后面。“好！真棒！”(Anna yǒu yì zhī xiǎoxióng. Anna shuō: “Wǒ bǎ xiǎoxióng fàng zài yǐzi xiàmiàn. Leo, zhàn zài wǒ hòumiàn!” Leo zhàn zài Anna hòumiàn. “Hǎo! Zhēn bàng!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "小熊 在哪里 儿歌 方位"

en.flash: Mới: box, top, front, next, behind, teddy, put, stand, stop | Ôn: on, under, in, chair
en.slide: 1) Trò Gấu đi đâu?: cô nói vị trí, con đặt gấu bông đúng chỗ quanh cái hộp (6 lệnh: in the box / on top of the box / under the box / behind the box / in front of the box / next to the box). 2) Trò Người xếp hàng: Stand behind Leo! / Stand in front of Anna! / Stand next to me! – Stop! 3) Nhìn tranh chọn câu đúng (4 câu): The cat is next to me. / The ball is in the box. / The teddy is under the chair. / The teddy is behind me.
en.truyen: Teddy and the Box — Bông has got a teddy bear and a box. She puts her teddy in the box. Then she puts it on top of the box. "Where is my teddy now?" It is behind the box! "Stop, teddy!" Bông laughs.
en.baihat: In Front, Behind (giai điệu Here We Go Looby Loo): I put my teddy in front, / I put my teddy behind, / I put my teddy next to me, / and under my chair – so fine! // I put my teddy in the box, / I put my teddy on top, / I put my teddy next to you, / and now it is time to stop! (hát đoạn 1, con cầm gấu bông đặt theo lời) · Vè: In the box and on the chair, / Next to me and over there!

zh.flash: Mới: 盒子 hézi, 上边 shàngbian, 里面 lǐmiàn, 前面 qiánmiàn, 后面 hòumiàn, 小熊 xiǎoxióng, 放 fàng, 站 zhàn, 前 qián | Ôn: 上 shàng, 下 xià, 旁边 pángbiān, 椅子 yǐzi
zh.slide: 1) Trò Gấu đi đâu? bằng tiếng Trung (6 lệnh): 放在盒子里面 / 放在盒子上边 / 放在盒子下面 / 放在盒子后面 / 放在盒子前面 / 放在盒子旁边. 2) Trò Người xếp hàng: 站在Xiaomei前面！/ 站在Leo后面！ 3) Tô 上 (shàng): quả bóng nằm trên mặt bàn, 3 nét sổ – ngang – ngang; tô 下 (xià): quả bóng lăn xuống dưới, 3 nét ngang – sổ – chấm.
zh.truyen: 小熊和盒子 — Bông有一只小熊和一个盒子。她把小熊放在盒子里面，然后放在盒子上边。“我的小熊在哪儿？”小熊在盒子后面！Bông笑了。(Bông yǒu yì zhī xiǎoxióng hé yí gè hézi. Tā bǎ xiǎoxióng fàng zài hézi lǐmiàn, ránhòu fàng zài hézi shàngbian. “Wǒ de xiǎoxióng zài nǎr?” Xiǎoxióng zài hézi hòumiàn! Bông xiào le.)
zh.baihat: 前面，后面 (giai điệu Here We Go Looby Loo): 小熊放在我前面，/ 小熊放在我后面，/ 小熊放在我旁边，/ 再放到椅子下面！(Xiǎoxióng fàng zài wǒ qiánmiàn, xiǎoxióng fàng zài wǒ hòumiàn, xiǎoxióng fàng zài wǒ pángbiān, zài fàng dào yǐzi xiàmiàn!) // 小熊放在盒子里，/ 小熊放在盒子上，/ 小熊放在你旁边，/ 好啦好啦不要忙！(Xiǎoxióng fàng zài hézi lǐ, xiǎoxióng fàng zài hézi shàng, xiǎoxióng fàng zài nǐ pángbiān, hǎo la hǎo la bú yào máng!) (hát đoạn 1)

en.tu: Mới: house, there (there is / there are), near, far | Ôn: tree, flower, river, mountain, sky
en.cum: Mới: behind our house / in front of our house / next to the river / near our house / far from the mountain
en.cau: There is a tree behind our house. / There are flowers in front of our house. / The river is near. The mountain is far. (nối Unit 10)
en.truyen: Xiaomei's Picture — Xiaomei draws her house. There is a tree behind the house. There are flowers in front of the house. The river is near the house. The mountain is far. "I love my house!"

zh.tu: Mới: 家 jiā (我们家), 有 yǒu (nơi + 有 + vật), 近 jìn, 远 yuǎn | Ôn: 树 shù, 花 huā, 河 hé, 山 shān, 天空 tiānkōng
zh.cum: Mới: 我们家后面 wǒmen jiā hòumiàn / 我们家前面 wǒmen jiā qiánmiàn / 在河旁边 zài hé pángbiān / 离家很近 lí jiā hěn jìn / 离山很远 lí shān hěn yuǎn
zh.cau: 我们家后面有树。(Wǒmen jiā hòumiàn yǒu shù.) / 我们家前面有花。(Wǒmen jiā qiánmiàn yǒu huā.) / 河很近，山很远。(Hé hěn jìn, shān hěn yuǎn.) (nối Unit 10)
zh.truyen: Xiaomei的画 — Xiaomei画她的家。家后面有一棵树，家前面有花。河离家很近，山很远。“我爱我的家！”(Xiaomei huà tā de jiā. Jiā hòumiàn yǒu yì kē shù, jiā qiánmiàn yǒu huā. Hé lí jiā hěn jìn, shān hěn yuǎn. “Wǒ ài wǒ de jiā!”)

web.label: Ngày 96. Unit 11 · Mèo ở đâu? (nhóm 2b) – nối Unit 10

en.tu: Mới: floor (ground floor, first floor), fine, in the tree | Ôn: cat, dog, river, stars, moon
en.cum: Mới: in the tree / next to the river / on the floor / on the first floor
en.cau: The cat is in the tree. / The cat is next to the river. / The dog is on the floor. / How are you? – I'm fine, thank you.
en.truyen: The Cat in the Tree — "How are you, Leo?" "I'm fine, thanks. Where is my cat?" The cat isn't on the floor. It isn't next to the river. Look! The cat is in the tree, under the moon!

zh.tu: Mới: 忙 máng, 再 zài, 树上 shù shàng, 地上 dì shàng | Ôn: 猫 māo, 狗 gǒu, 河 hé, 月亮 yuèliang, 星星 xīngxing
zh.cum: Mới: 在树上 zài shù shàng / 在河旁边 zài hé pángbiān / 在地上 zài dì shàng / 在一楼 zài yī lóu
zh.cau: 猫在树上。(Māo zài shù shàng.) / 猫在河旁边。(Māo zài hé pángbiān.) / 狗在地上。(Gǒu zài dì shàng.) / 我很忙，再见！(Wǒ hěn máng, zàijiàn!)
zh.truyen: 树上的猫 — Leo很忙：“我的猫在哪儿？”猫不在地上，也不在河旁边。看！猫在树上，月亮在天空中！(Leo hěn máng: “Wǒ de māo zài nǎr?” Māo bú zài dì shàng, yě bú zài hé pángbiān. Kàn! Māo zài shù shàng, yuèliang zài tiānkōng zhōng!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "猫在哪里 儿歌 树上"

en.flash: Mới: house, there, near, far, floor, fine, in the tree | Ôn: tree, flower, river, cat, box
en.slide: 1) Tranh ngôi nhà quê của Xiaomei: nghe câu dán tranh đúng chỗ (4 câu): There is a tree behind our house. / There are flowers in front of our house. / The cat is in the tree. / The cat is next to the river. 2) Đúng hay sai? (4 câu, tranh chỉ đổi vị trí): The cat is on the floor. / The river is near the house. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: How are you? – I'm fine, thank you. / Where is the cat? – It's in the tree.
en.truyen: Xiaomei's House — Xiaomei's house is near a river. There is a big tree behind the house. There are flowers in front of the house. The mountain is far. "Where is the cat?" It isn't on the floor. It is in the tree!
en.baihat: In Front, Behind (giai điệu Here We Go Looby Loo): I put my teddy in front, / I put my teddy behind, / I put my teddy next to me, / and under my chair – so fine! // I put my teddy in the box, / I put my teddy on top, / I put my teddy next to you, / and now it is time to stop! (hát đoạn 2) · Vè EN ôn: In the box and on the chair, / Next to me and over there!

zh.flash: Mới: 家 jiā, 近 jìn, 远 yuǎn, 忙 máng, 再 zài, 树上 shù shàng | Ôn: 树 shù, 花 huā, 河 hé, 猫 māo, 盒子 hézi
zh.slide: 1) NL9 (S3): in the tree = 树上 (trên cây), không nói 树里; chọn câu đúng (3 câu): 猫在树上。/ 猫在树里。/ 猫在树下。 2) Trò Gấu đi đâu? với hộp, cây giấy, sông giấy: 放在树上 / 放在河旁边 / 放在盒子里. 3) Chép 上 下 vào ô.
zh.truyen: Xiaomei的家 — Xiaomei的家离河很近。家后面有一棵大树，家前面有花。山很远。“猫在哪儿？”猫不在地上，猫在树上！(Xiaomei de jiā lí hé hěn jìn. Jiā hòumiàn yǒu yì kē dà shù, jiā qiánmiàn yǒu huā. Shān hěn yuǎn. “Māo zài nǎr?” Māo bú zài dì shàng, māo zài shù shàng!)
zh.baihat: 前面，后面 (giai điệu Here We Go Looby Loo): 小熊放在我前面，/ 小熊放在我后面，/ 小熊放在我旁边，/ 再放到椅子下面！(Xiǎoxióng fàng zài wǒ qiánmiàn, xiǎoxióng fàng zài wǒ hòumiàn, xiǎoxióng fàng zài wǒ pángbiān, zài fàng dào yǐzi xiàmiàn!) // 小熊放在盒子里，/ 小熊放在盒子上，/ 小熊放在你旁边，/ 好啦好啦不要忙！(Xiǎoxióng fàng zài hézi lǐ, xiǎoxióng fàng zài hézi shàng, xiǎoxióng fàng zài nǐ pángbiān, hǎo la hǎo la bú yào máng!) (hát đoạn 2) · Vè ZH: 前面是山，后面是河，/ 旁边小树唱着歌！(Qiánmiàn shì shān, hòumiàn shì hé, pángbiān xiǎo shù chàngzhe gē!)

en.tu: Mới: between, over there, hide, behind the door | Ôn: where, look, chair, sofa, bed, window
en.cum: Mới: behind our house / there is a tree / under the chair / between the sofa and the bed
en.cau: There is a tree behind our house. / There are flowers in front of our house. / There is a river next to our house. / The cat is between the sofa and the bed. / PS-1: “猫不在树上，它在河旁边。” → Where is the cat?
en.truyen: Look Over There! — "Where is the teddy bear?" asks Bông. "Look over there!" says Leo. The teddy bear is between the sofa and the bed. The cat hides behind the door.

zh.tu: Mới: 那儿 nàr, 在……中间 zài…zhōngjiān, 箱子 xiāngzi, 躲 duǒ | Ôn: 哪儿 nǎr, 看 kàn, 椅子 yǐzi, 沙发 shāfā, 床 chuáng
zh.cum: Mới: 我们家后面 wǒmen jiā hòumiàn / 有树 yǒu shù / 椅子下面 yǐzi xiàmiàn / 沙发和床中间 shāfā hé chuáng zhōngjiān — chống lỗi: EN nói vật trước rồi nơi (There is a tree behind our house), ZH nói nơi trước rồi 有 vật (我们家后面有树)
zh.cau: 我们家后面有树。(Wǒmen jiā hòumiàn yǒu shù.) / 我们家前面有花。(Wǒmen jiā qiánmiàn yǒu huā.) / 我们家旁边有一条河。(Wǒmen jiā pángbiān yǒu yì tiáo hé.) / 猫在沙发和床中间。(Māo zài shāfā hé chuáng zhōngjiān.)
zh.truyen: 看那儿！ — Bông问：“小熊在哪儿？”Leo说：“看那儿！”小熊在沙发和床中间。猫躲在门后面。(Bông wèn: “Xiǎoxióng zài nǎr?” Leo shuō: “Kàn nàr!” Xiǎoxióng zài shāfā hé chuáng zhōngjiān. Māo duǒ zài mén hòumiàn.)

en.tu: Ôn: box, top, front, next, behind, teddy, put, stand, stop
en.cum: Ôn: in front of me / behind me / next to me / next to you / on top of the box
en.cau: The teddy bear is under the chair. / The teddy bear is in the box. / Our teddy is on top of the box.
en.truyen: Our Teddy — Leo and Anna have got one teddy bear. It is our teddy! Leo puts it in the box. Anna puts it on top of the box. "Stop! It's time to sleep, Teddy!" They put it next to the bed.

zh.tu: Ôn: 盒子 hézi, 上边 shàngbian, 里面 lǐmiàn, 前面 qiánmiàn, 后面 hòumiàn, 小熊 xiǎoxióng, 放 fàng, 站 zhàn
zh.cum: Ôn: 我前面 wǒ qiánmiàn / 我后面 wǒ hòumiàn / 我旁边 wǒ pángbiān / 你旁边 nǐ pángbiān — Xếp vào nhóm theo chữ chung: có 面 (前面, 后面, 里面) / không có 面 (上, 下, 旁边)
zh.cau: 小熊在椅子下面。(Xiǎoxióng zài yǐzi xiàmiàn.) / 小熊在盒子里。(Xiǎoxióng zài hézi lǐ.) / 我们的小熊在盒子上边。(Wǒmen de xiǎoxióng zài hézi shàngbian.)
zh.truyen: 我们的小熊 — Leo和Anna有一只小熊。Leo把小熊放在盒子里。Anna把小熊放在盒子上边。“好啦，不要忙！”他们把小熊放在床旁边。(Leo hé Anna yǒu yì zhī xiǎoxióng. Leo bǎ xiǎoxióng fàng zài hézi lǐ. Anna bǎ xiǎoxióng fàng zài hézi shàngbian. “Hǎo la, bú yào máng!” Tāmen bǎ xiǎoxióng fàng zài chuáng pángbiān.)
